Growing up, I was (and still am!) my sisters’ biggest cheerleader. If anyone messed with them, I had their backs. Through my role as a big sister, I learned that I loved being a leader and an advocate. That knowledge motivated me to become a journalist.

But for the past 12 years, instead of working for us, Congressman Scott Perry has been taking care of... himself, only being accountable to the Republican dark money and special interest groups. He even voted to throw out our votes and plotted to overturn our democracy. I’m running to fire Scott Perry and to show my neighbors in PA-10 that: “I’ve got your back.”

When my father passed away in 2019, he had two requests: **“Take care of your mother, and take care of each other.”** My dad would be proud that I’m running for Congress— proud that I’m stepping up to take care of not just my mom and sisters, but my friends and neighbors in Central Pennsylvania. I will fight for working families left behind by the high cost of gas and groceries. I will fight for the Black and Brown communities where schools are underfunded. body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38799%2E3422442%2EwZ6Wj_)
Derek,
Katie Porter here. You may have noticed that the emails I’m sending you look a bit different than the ones I used to send, and now say “Truth to Power” at the top. **That’s because while we didn’t advance out of California’s Senate primary a few weeks back, I’m not giving up our fight.**
My term serving CA-47 in the House runs through early January. And until then, I’ll be doing everything I can to get some of our top priority pieces of legislation across the finish line. That includes continuing to push leadership to take up a bill effectively banning Members of Congress from trading stocks; holding Big Oil accountable; and using the Oversight Committee to get real answers for the American people.
**I’m still focused on the future of our Congress, because I’ve seen how desperately we need to enact real change.** On the campaign trail, I heard from so many Californians who distrust the government and are losing faith in our democracy’s ability to deliver for them. **People see how beholden politicians are to their biggest donors and special interest groups. And they don’t like the end result.**
That’s why in 2020, as a freshman Member of Congress, I started Truth to Power. **Truth to Power is a “Leadership PAC” which is a campaign finance term that just means a political entity run by an elected official.**
Since 2020, Truth to Power has been able to spend over $500,000 directly supporting Democrats and has raised more than $125,000 directly into candidates’ campaigns. We’ve endorsed and supported Democrats who reject corporate PAC money and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people.
**Sunday, March 31, will mark Truth to Power’s first fundraising deadline since the end of our Senate campaign.**
Reporting a strong number will show pundits and politicians that we are ready to elect leaders who will reject corporate PAC money and act in the best interest of the American people, not big corporations. **Ahead of 3/31, is there anything you can give to Truth to Power to send a powerful message to corporate interests, and help us support Democrats in must-win races across the country?**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240327?refcode=em20240327-38799&refcode2=38799_3422442_wZ6Wj_&akid=38799%2E3422442%2EwZ6Wj_)
Thanks for considering,
Katie Porter

subject: FW: Putting it all together
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Daniels For Congress
body:
Dear Friend,
Our most important fundraising deadline of this campaign so far is on Sunday at midnight, and we wanted to make sure you didn't miss this important message from Shamaine about our recent endorsements.
All of us here at Team Daniels are proud of these endorsements because they reflect the priorities for which Shamaine has fought throughout her career, and we know that Shamaine will continue that fight in Congress.
The Democratic Primary is just under four weeks away, and we're supporting Shamaine because we believe that PA-10 needs to elect a Democrat who we KNOW shares our Democratic values. Addressing the issues we face is going to require elected leaders who will stand-up and do what's right. Shamaine is the ONLY candidate in PA-10 with a record of doing that as an activist, an attorney, and an elected official.
Can you pitch-in $25, $50, $100, $250, or whatever ou can afford to support a proud Democrat who will be a tireless advocate for the things that matter to us? Click here to make a contribution today! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Thanks for being part of our team!
Team Daniels
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Begin Forwarded Message
From: Shamaine Daniels <shamaine@danielsforcongress.org>
Date: March 27th, 2024
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Dear Friend,
Endorsements are something candidates for office talk about all the time, but what do our endorsements say about what kind of leader we will be in office? In my case, I think my endorsements say a lot about my values and priorities. You see, I believe that defeating Scott Perry is important, but who replaces him is just as important. I believe we need to elect a Democrat whom we KNOW shares our values, and who will fight for them in Congress.
My endorsements reflect not just my values, but the values of Democrats across the district. I hope that you agree, and that you will consider joining these organizations in supporting my campaign with a contribution before our critical end of quarter deadline on Sunday at midnight.
Make a contribution now by clicking here! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
I am proud to be endorsed by the National Organization for Women, the Latino Victory Fund, CASA in Action, and Second Generation.
I have spent most of my adult life fighting for a woman's right to choose. I started the fight as an activist with the National Organization for Women (NOW), and have stood with NOW ever since. Together, we've fought not just for a woman's right to choose, but also for economic justice, racial justice, LGBTQIA+ rights, and an end to violence against women.
As the only woman of color running for the Democratic nomination in PA-10 , these are not just the priorities I've fought for, many of these issues reflect the challenges and obstacles I've faced throughout my life and my career, and in Congress, I will work hard to remove these barriers so that others do not have to walk the same path.
I am proud to be endorsed by NOW in this campaign, and if these are your values too, I'm asking you to make a contribution to support our campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
I'm not just the only woman of color in this Democratic Primary, if elected, I will also be the first Latina to represent Pennsylvania in the U.S. House . My family immigrated to the United States when I was young. I am proud a proud American who is also proud of my Venezuelan heritage. I believe in the American Dream because my family and I lived it, and I want to make sure that the American Dream is alive and well for future generations of Americans, whether natural born or immigrants like me.
I also understand the immigration crisis in unique ways. I'm not just an immigrant myself, I spent much of my career as an immigration attorney. I understand what we need to do to fix our broken immigration system, and I understand that doing so is important not just for those seeking a better life here, but also for our country, our economy, and our future growth and prosperity.
For all of these reasons, I am proud to have the endorsement and support of The Latino Victory Fund, CASA in Action, and Second Generation.
These organizations are dedicated to advancing values and priorities to which I have dedicated much of my life. These aren't just my values, they are OUR values as Democrats, and in Congress I will fight hard for them.
I can't do that without your help. These organizations have stepped-up to support my candidacy because of my Democratic values, and my long history fighting for those values as an activist, attorney, and elected official and I'm asking you to do the same.
The PA Primary is just a month away, and our biggest fundraising deadline so far is this Sunday at midnight. Can you rush a contribution of $25, $50, $100, $250 or whatever you can afford to my campaign today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Thank you for your ongoing support for our campaign!
With gratitude,
Shamaine
DONATE NOW! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]

Daniels For Congress
2018 North 3rd Street
Harrisburg, PA 17102
United States

| In the warmth of our family home, where the laughter and camaraderie of board games often filled the room, my mother instilled in us a profound lesson. With each turn, we altered a single rule, a playful yet insightful exercise that illuminated the essence of rules and the power we possess to redefine them. [It's with this spirit of innovation and resilience that I step into the arena of political change. As a Black single mother, an advocate for environmental justice, a dedicated organizer in the heart of Tennessee, and a steadfast progressive, the path to securing the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate was anything but expected. clean_body: Will you sponsor a yard sign? | = Hi there team, I just launched my merch store (you should absolutely check it out if you haven't already 🤗) and I've already run into a bit of a problem. It's a good problem to have, but here's the deal: yard signs are in super high demand, but they're also super expensive to make. Yard signs are one of the best ways to get your name out there and with a primary this crowded, I need to paint the town Harry! So I'm wondering if you can chip in $16 (the amount it takes to make a yard sign) so I can make sure Maryland's 3rd District is covered corner to corner with Dunn for Congress! = | = | = ---|--- Like I said, this primary is really crowded – there's 22 candidates in the running! And as silly as it may sound, a yard sign could encourage a voter to look me up. They'd find out that I'm a Maryland native, a girl dad, and a former Capitol police officer who defended the Capitol and everyone in it with my bare hands on January 6. They'd find out I support abortion rights, voting rights and defending our country from far-right extremism. And maybe, (hopefully), they'd vote for me, or chip in to my campaign. Maybe they'd even buy a yard sign to support me! = = | = ---|--- = | = = | = -Harry 💙 = = | = = Harry Dunn for Congress PO Box 1449 Columbia, MD 21044 United States | mailto:info@harrydunnforcongress.com Paid for by Harry Dunn for Congress

Fellow American - My name is Nancy Mace.

I’m a high school dropout who started out working at Waffle House to pay the bills and put food on the table.

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also worked to earn my high school diploma taking classes at a technical college. **I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies — and I am a better woman because of it.**

Unlike a lot of folks in Washington, I’ve been working since I was 17. It’s clear Congress is in desperate need of people like me – someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other.

Someone who knows what it’s like to actually earn a living and make sacrifices.

name: Doug Lindner, LCV
subject: LCV members like you are making a HUGE difference to confirm pro-environment, pro-democracy judges
body:
Learn more about our latest victory >> |
---

** **
|
Peter -- I have big news to share. Our movement has just scored a HUGE win as the Senate has voted 50-47 to confirm President Biden's nominee Nicole Berner to the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit.

In her career before becoming a judge, Berner has been a leading lawyer for workers' rights and reproductive rights, has worked to advance voting rights, civil rights, and immigrants' rights, and has worked pro bono for children in abuse and neglect cases. She has been a leader for LGBTQ+ rights, and she is now the first openly LGBTQ+ judge ever to serve on the Fourth Circuit.

_**We 're reaching out today because we need you to know: victories like this only happen because of tireless advocacy from people like you, Peter. Thank you!**_

LCV members have sent _thousands of messages_ to Capitol Hill urging senators to confirm pro-democracy, pro-environment judges like Nicole Berner. Those messages haven't gone unnoticed; the judges getting appointed are now the most diverse and most committed to the public interest ever. Your advocacy really makes a difference.

As I'm sure you understand, for our environmental laws to be effective, we need judges who will enforce them. And as a right-wing supermajority controls the Supreme Court, **the stakes for our communities ' clean air and clean water, and for all people and communities to have an equal say in our democracy and be treated with justice before the law, have never been higher.**

To protect our environment and democracy, senators _must_ continue to prioritize confirming highly qualified, personally and professionally diverse nominees to every lifetime vacancy on the federal bench.

[You can help by taking action now. Tell your senators to move quickly to confirm pro-democracy, pro-environment judges like Nicole Berner. The future of our democracy and planet is at stake.](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/2zZrMpqw~)

body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
Heidi Ganahl introduces the Rocky Mountain Voice, a new conservative news media platform for Coloradans to be the VOICE of your VALUES.
| |
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| Hello, **Coming tomorrow:** Be sure to catch our coverage of the Douglas County Republican Women's 4th District forum for U.S. Congress from Lone Tree. So far, [Lauren Bobert](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and [Deborah Flora](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)'s signatures have been verified for the primary. In case you missed it, here's everything you need to know about the [special election ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)tomorrow to replace Buck. We'll also have some coverage on other congressional races this week. This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, March 27, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
# TODAY'S TOP STORIES
---
[**The Last Gasp of the Liberal Colorado Press**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) BY HEIDI GANAHL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
| [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
Gov. Jared Polis and his cronies are very mad that a [real newsman](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) is doing the job they refuse to do. We started Rocky Mountain Voice to report factual, real news, to allow Coloradans to have the knowledge to make better decisions — in government and culture, all in one place. We thought they’d eventually be scared of us, but we didn’t realize the establishment media would be quaking in their boots within the first two months! To do all this, we brought on [Brian Porter](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) as a knowledgeable, experienced newsman—because what Coloradans told me about every day in my 2022 gubernatorial campaign is that NO ONE is telling them the real story. Brian’s background in the media has the establishment upset because he was in their midst... [a truth-teller who hadn’t yet been corrupted](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). And they are terrified. He has been serving, to their sudden horror, as the president of the Colorado Press Association. Now, with him launching RMV, they learn he actually cares about the grassroots and that he wants to report facts. This mustn’t stand in liberal land, so last week, Polis and his media thugs put out a [whiny manifest](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) from their far-left hit piece machine, the Colorado Times Recorder, to pressure Brian to step down. I understand there are some fair, even conservative, people still in the association that pushed back, and to those, keep up the good fight! **[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

[**List of orphan oil and gas wells swells to more than 1,000 in Colorado as small operators abandon the state**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The [number of orphan wells](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in Colorado has exceeded 1,000, with a significant increase observed over the past four years.

* The Energy and Carbon Management Commission (ECMC) is taking over 358 wells from two defunct oil and gas companies, Omimex Petroleum and Chemco Exploration, and seizing bonds from them.

* A bill in the legislature, [Senate Bill 159](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), aims to enable the state to seek funds from former owners of abandoned wells to bolster the orphan well program.

* The [bill faces opposition](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) from industry groups like API-Colorado, citing retrospective nature and potential violation of the state constitution. Despite new financial assurance rules and funds from industry fees, fines, and federal sources, concerns persist about the adequacy of resources to address the growing orphan well problem, exacerbated by the failure of some operators to submit financial assurance plans.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**COMMENTARY: Walcher: Crying Crocodile Tears Over ‘Sue-and-Settle’**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[GREG WALCHER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* House Republicans have expressed concern over the EPA's use of [secretive "sue-and-settle" practices](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to implement policies favored by special interests, prompting investigations and proposed legislation.

* The sue-and-settle tactic, dating back to the Nixon era, involves [outside groups suing the government](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to compel enforcement actions, often resulting in back-room deals and court consent decrees with sealed details and costs.

* Rep. Bob Good and other Republican congressmen introduced the ["No Regulation Through Litigation Act"](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to disincentivize sue-and-settle practices, aiming to curb its misuse. The practice saw a surge during the Obama administration, with over 2,260 settlements during his second term, impacting federal land use and energy exploration policies.

* Despite criticism, little immediate action is expected from Congress, as many lawmakers, including lawyers and former government employees, have vested interests in the current system.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**George Brauchler qualifies for ballot in 23rd Judicial District**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* George Brauchler has successfully qualified for the Republican Party's primary ballot for [district attorney in the 23rd Judicial District](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). He is the only candidate to have petitioned for a spot on the ballot in the new 23rd Judicial District.

* Candidates must secure 1,000 verified signatures from their district, and Brauchler submitted 1,830 signatures, with 1,241 accepted by the Secretary of State.

* Brauchler expressed gratitude for the support his campaign has received, emphasizing his commitment to making the new 23rd Judicial District the safest in Colorado. A detailed record of all accepted and rejected signatures, along with reasons for each rejection, is available with the Secretary of State.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**Investigation continues into partial Main Street building collapse in Cañon City**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[CANON CITY DAILY RECORD](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* City officials are investigating a [partial building collapse](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) at 612 Main St. in Cañon City. Emergency and utility crews responded to the structure after portions of a first- and second-floor east exterior wall collapsed.

* Fortunately, there were [no injuries reported](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), but one family was displaced and is staying with relatives. All utilities to the building have been shut off, and the cause of the collapse is under investigation.

* The Building Department is working with the owner to assess options, and until the cause is determined, access to the building is [restricted for safety reasons](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

| **SO MUCH TO TELL!**
**THAT LAST RNC MEETING.**

I attended the last RNC meeting March 7-8, which was historic as Ronna McDaniel gave her final speech and Trump's people assumed operations. What a great moment to witness! The change in management was immediately obvious. Gone were Ronna's signature thousands of dollars in floral arrangements. This meeting was streamlined and all about business. She has since been hired and fired by NBC, and trolled by Trump.

Aside from that election, I spent several hours with one of Trump's former ambassadors and learned more about the world of foreign diplomacy. During dinner with a Sr. Advisor in the Trump Campaign, I heard _his_ take on the infamous story of how he and Solomon helped negotiate Japan's transfer of submarine technology to Taiwan for defense production, with President Trump's blessing at the time. I think that's a subject for a future newsletter - or an entire book!

**ORP'S STATE CENTRAL COMMITTEE MEETING.
**
I’m proud of Solomon! The race for Oregon's National Committeeman was held on the 16th between 4 candidates. Per usual in the ORP and many organizations, there had to be a majority of 50%+ to win. The initial ballot came back with Don Powers first, but with nowhere near a majority. Solomon was second. Dan Mason third. Jerry Cummings fourth, so he was automatically out. The votes were split to high heaven.
Powers is the individual with a criminal record who built an effigy to attack Solomon. In a bizarre twist, he claimed “Mar-a-Lago” had called him, and much of the room understood he was insinuating some sort of backing from Trump. Some delegates believed the lie, but what a disgrace his election would have been for Oregon.
Solomon could’ve fought it out from second place and possibly won - but to protect the integrity of that RNC seat, he decided on the spot to withdraw, throw his support to Dan, and try to unite the room that way. Many of Jerry's supporters followed suit.
It was a truly classy move. You could physically feel the shock wave roll through the room.
It's sad the ORP as a party apparatus has lost its seniority in the RNC and will never have it back. Solomon remains NCM until after this important convention. Then... we have a new project in the works for Oregon because I think we can turn it red with the right strategy, and our 2nd annual Worldwide Freedom Initiative summit is coming this winter. Some big national opportunities have been coming Solomon's way as well, so that's exciting! We may even go to an RNC meeting or two next year as we're both still part of the Republican National Conservative Caucus and Republicans Overseas.
Finally, after the election Powers took to X in a two-hours-long, bourbon-soaked interview. He admits to waging a 2-year "strategic operation" with the sole purpose of removing Solomon and smearing all of us around him. Translation: nearly his entire time in the party has been dedicated to deliberately causing division. I hope ORP's delegates realize how negatively impacted the party has been by this faction, circle the wagons, and start targeting Democrats. Oh, and congratulations, Dan Mason. The best of luck to you!

Over & out,

**_Kerry_**

_PS - Don't forget banquet tickets! (See below.) Proceeds go to fund our future Patriot Kids Camp, teaching real American history - not the woke kind!_

**CALL TO ACTION**
Support Senator Halloran, OPPOSE LR335
LR335 - Censure and condemn Senator Steve Halloran for his conduct toward other members of the Legislature

**Stop the Hypocrisy and waste of the legislative session!!** Leave a comment of support for Senator Halloran. The same Senators who don’t have time for parents rights or school choice, claim school porn is good for kids, are NOW going to make time (with only 10 days left of session mind you) to censure someone who read from a school library book during floor debate. Hypocrisy at its finest! The facts and details of the situation are lost on the supporters for censure. We can point out that Halloran was not talking about or even to Michaela Cavanaugh. We can point out that others have made equally vulgar comments on the floor and directed at others in the past. The issue to drive home is that Halloran was making a very important point that the content found in public schools, if too vulgar for the floor, is too obscene for schools. The reaction from the democrats PROVES this to be true. If adults are so incredibly offended, students in K-12 should not have access to the material in the public school and library setting. The senators have immunity for free speech for this very reason!! Senators must be able to freely discuss these issues and make solid arguments without recourse of censure. Had Hallorans comments been irrelevant to the bill being discussed, this would be a completely different situation. **You are one of 30,000 receiving this email. If ALL our voices were heard, Senators would know WE THE PEOPLE, seek representation of OUR values!**
[**_5-10 minutes to make your voice heard!_**](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=9bd377660b&e=25844e23a8)

**Submit your online comment ASAP: [https://nebraskalegislature.gov/bills/view_bill.php?DocumentID=57169](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=36876a9e49&e=25844e23a8)** [](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=70289334bf&e=25844e23a8)
Be sure to verify your email after submitting the comment. There will be a message saying that the deadline to submit for the hearing is passed, but you can still write, and they’ll get seen. Thank you!
We urge our Republican membership to [CALL](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=fdf74880ec&e=25844e23a8) your Senators, [email](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=afeaf47a07&e=25844e23a8) your Senators, or attend in person to testify on this critical piece of legislation which will refocus education in Nebraska back to core values.

**BELOW are easy to modify Testimony Templates.** #1 I am glad the incident has drawn so much attention to the issue. Many people either didn't know or didn't believe content like that was really available to children in school libraries, and now they do. Ignoring senators on the mic is quite common as I witnessed just yesterday, senators looking at their phones, or engaging in side conversations when another senator has the mic. Quite literally, more people are NOT listening to the speaker than are. It's obvious he was trying to get their attention. Where were the censure motions and condemnations during the last session when hate and harassment filled the chamber?? The same laws which protected the outrageous rantings of Senator Cavanaugh and Hunt last session should protect Senator Halloran this session. WE THE PEOPLE of {Insert County} County Support Senator Halloran! Stop wasting our time and tax-payer dollars.

#2 I am writing to OPPOSE the censure of Senator Halloran.

Senators, our children are being bombarded with sexual imagary by TV, in movies, the internet, their phones, and unfortunately, in our schools.

The strategy for increased sexual imagery on our children is this: Radicals sneak the unspeakable into the lives of our children, and then act horrified when good people speak the unspeakable in order to shine a light on it.

How did we get here?

The president of the American Library Association, Emily Drabinski, is a self-proclaimed Marxist and a leading Queer Theorist. The goal of Queer Theory is to disassemble all normality, including the nuclear family, heterosexual relationships, male and female, etc.. She’s the so-called “expert” promoting books that are chosen by our Nebraska librarians.

This has gone on far too long. Senator Halloran shined a light on this because there’s no “Nebraska nice” way to do this. What he proved, and what we can all agree on, is what was read was pornography and has no place in Nebraska’s school libraries. Senators can cry theatrically all they want about civility and respect, but there’s nothing respectable about authors sneaking the unspeakable into the lives of children.

Have you gone back and listened to or watched the recording of this part of the debate? I have. Many times. Bad faith on the floor immediately twisted Halloran’s good faith testimony into a salacious attack.

Then the media lied. Never once did Halloran speak Senator Machaela Cavanaugh’s full name, which was a report I repeatedly heard on the radio. There is a saying that if a lie is repeated often enough people will believe it to be true.

However, many listening to the testimony understood that Senator Halloran was calling for attention from senators as a teacher would redirect students who are losing focus. Even Senator Blood made comments on the floor today about how few Senators pay attention to the Senator speaking.

The eagerness to censure any Senator over what is said on the debate floor should cause all of you to squirm. Taking the intent of what a Senator says and twisting it to ruin a reputation for political gain should terrify each one of you.

If you recall, Sen Halloran warned NPR and parents watching at home to take their children out of the room if they were watching the live stream before he read graphic content FOUND IN NEBRASKA SCHOOL LIBRARIES.

Instead of persecuting a commonsense colleague, Senators should be protecting the innocence of Nebraska's children from traumatizing sexual content. If reading that passage was traumatic to adults in the Capitol, imagine how much more damaging it is to children and adolescents in schools. Those triggered Senators opposing Senator Halloran just made his point for him.

I ask that you do the right thing, and support Senator Halloran.

#3 The attempt at censuring Senator Halloran is strongly opposed by grassroots coalitions and partners of the Republican Party of Nebraska. With over 600,000 Republicans in Nebraska the vast majority support Senator Halloran and his efforts to highlight the stark hypocrisy of those who claim offense after the reading of material they also claim is acceptable for children. The narrative has conveniently shifted from focus on the material described in LB441 to blaming the messenger and personal attacks. If the comment had not been relevant to the bill on the floor, it could have been arguably inappropriate. This censure comes 8 days before the end of the session against a senator that is term limited and is a total waste of precious time and taxpayer dollars. OPPOSE LR335.

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Championing fair legal representation for Texans in need / Defendiendo una representación legal justa para los tejanos necesitados
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/PNG%202023%20TOP%20Newsletter%20Header.png]
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
TOP and Bexar County advance fair legal representation through a new system
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/MAC%20Bexar%20County%20TOP%20group%20shot.jpg]
TOP’s Bexar County Right2Justice team returned to Bexar County Commissioners Court on Tuesday to advocate for the continued implementation of the Managed Assigned Counsel (MAC) system [https://www.bexar.org/3587/Managed-Assigned-Counsel] . This innovative program is designed to transform legal representation for low-income defendants facing misdemeanors and felonies.
The MAC system goes beyond just legal defense. It provides critical support services, including access to mental health resources and on-site immigration attorneys. This holistic approach aims to reduce unnecessary jail time and ensure better outcomes for all involved.
Our commitment to the MAC system reflects TOP's unwavering belief in equal justice for ALL.
We stand firm in the fight to create a #TexasForAll where every person – regardless of race, background, or circumstance – receives fair and equitable treatment under the law. View the MAC’s 2024 Mid-Year Report here. [https://drive.google.com/file/d/1lbBuw4fe3G5BDKK3dG9Zg0GFmBceuiGb/view]
For more information on Bexar County’s MAC system and TOP’s Right2Justice organizing, email Laquita at lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
Taking to the streets against Gov. Abbott's racist SB4
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/SB4%20Dallas%20march.jpg]
TOP members joined forces with immigration advocates and community allies Sunday in downtown Dallas for a march against SB4 [https://www.politico.com/news/2024/03/27/texas-sb4-immigration-law-00149276] , our state's currently blocked (but still dangerous) law targeting immigrant families.
At its core, SB4 is white supremacy in action that emboldens racial profiling, attacks personal freedoms, and directly threatens the well-being of communities of color. Gov. Abbott and his far-right allies passed SB4 with the intention of sowing division and fear in Texas communities, not with the purpose of enhancing public safety.
WATCH footage from the march here. [https://www.cbsnews.com/texas/news/hundreds-gather-in-dallas-to-protest-sb4/]
TOP and our statewide progressive partners remain dead set on utilizing every organizing and legal tool at our disposal to combat and fully stop this heinous law.
Plug into our movement against SB4. Call or text TOP Immigration Lead Organizer Damaris Gonzalez at 832-774-7704 to find out how you can join the fight .
Calling out Ken Paxton's sweetheart deal
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/CorruptKen.jpg]
Brianna Brown, TOP Co-Executive Director, released the following statement in response to Texas A.G. Ken Paxton getting a slap on the wrist from prosecutors to avoid going to trial for securities fraud after nine years [https://www.cbsnews.com/texas/news/former-special-prosecutor-in-paxton-securities-fraud-case-says-potential-deal-to-avoid-trial-have-charges-dropped-is-common/] :
“This sham deal shows us clear as day how there exists two ‘justice’ systems in this country; one for the wealthy and well-connected, and one for every one else. It also doesn’t change the fact that Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton is our state’s most corrupt elected official in modern times.
“Just like his insurrectionist idol, Donald J. Trump, Paxton is a power-hungry white nationalist grifter who will say and do anything to avoid accountability. After all, he not only attended, but spoke at Trump's infamous Stop The Steal rally on January 6.
“ For years, Paxton has weaponized our state’s attorney general’s office to infringe on people’s constitutional rights – from access to the ballot box, to abortion, to seeking asylum, and more. You’d be hard-pressed to find a corrupt politician in Texas who is more deserving of being removed from office for their years of attacking our communities, restricting our freedoms, and destabilizing our democracy.
“ Part of BlackTOP's historic effort to reach out to 1.4 million Black Texans in the 2022 midterm included attempting to serve Paxton a “People’s Subpoena” at a political fundraiser hosted by one of his right-wing mega-donors in Colleyville.
“A darling of the far-right, Paxton has elevated himself politically at the expense of the well-being of Black and Latino Texans , illustrating time and time again how he is dangerous for our families, dangerous for our state, and dangerous for our country. No matter age, race, economic status, or political leanings, ALL Texans deserve honest elected officials who lead with integrity, not status-seeking, immoral politicians who only look out for themselves.”
TOP Tip: Turn on this iPhone feature to further protect your identity
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/iPhone%20tip%202024.jpeg]
It's happened to all of us at some point: we've left our smartphone behind in a public place. Commence the freak-out. If you're an iPhone user, give yourself added peace of mind by quickly using a new feature that protects against those who may try to steal your identity from your device. [https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/blog/ios-17-3-stolen-device-protection/]
Español
TOP y el Condado de Bexar avanzan en una representación legal justa a través de un nuevo sistema
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/MAC%20Bexar%20County%20TOP%20group%20shot.jpg]
El equipo Right2Justice del Condado de Bexar de TOP regresó al Tribunal de Comisionados del Condado de Bexar el martes para abogar por la implementación continua del sistema de Managed Assigned Counsel (MAC) [https://www.bexar.org/3587/Managed-Assigned-Counsel] . Este programa innovador está diseñado para transformar la representación legal de acusados de bajos ingresos que enfrentan delitos menores y graves.
El sistema MAC va más allá de la mera defensa jurídica. Proporciona servicios de apoyo críticos, incluido el acceso a recursos de salud mental y abogados de inmigración en el lugar. Este enfoque holístico tiene como objetivo reducir el tiempo de cárcel innecesario y garantizar mejores resultados para todos los involucrados.
Nuestro compromiso con el sistema MAC refleja la creencia inquebrantable de TOP en la igualdad de justicia para TODOS.
Nos mantenemos firmes en la lucha para crear un #TexasParaTodos donde cada persona, independientemente de su raza, origen o circunstancia, reciba un trato justo y equitativo ante la ley. Vea el Informe de mitad de año 2024 del MAC aquí. [https://drive.google.com/file/d/1lbBuw4fe3G5BDKK3dG9Zg0GFmBceuiGb/view]
Para obtener más información sobre el sistema MAC del condado de Bexar y la organización Right2Justice de TOP, envíe un correo electrónico a Laquita a lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
Protestando contra la racista SB4 del gobernador Abbott
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/SB4%20Dallas%20march.jpg]
Los miembros de TOP unieron fuerzas con defensores de la inmigración y aliados comunitarios el domingo en el centro de Dallas para una marcha contra la SB4 [https://www.univision.com/noticias/inmigracion/corte-mantiene-bloqueo-sobre-sb4-ley-inmigracion-de-texas] , la ley actualmente bloqueada (pero aún peligrosa) de nuestro estado dirigida a las familias inmigrantes.
En esencia, la SB4 es la supremacía blanca en acción que fomenta la discriminación racial, ataca las libertades personales y amenaza directamente el bienestar de las comunidades de color. El gobernador Abbott y sus aliados de extrema derecha aprobaron la SB4 con la intención de sembrar división y miedo en las comunidades de Texas, no con el propósito de mejorar la seguridad pública.
MIRA imágenes de la marcha aquí. [https://www.univision.com/local/dallas-kuvn/marcha-en-dallas-solidaridad-con-los-inmigrantes-en-tiempos-de-incertidumbre-por-la-ley-sb4-en-texas-video]
TOP y nuestros socios progresistas en todo el estado siguen decididos a utilizar todas las herramientas jurídicas y organizativas a nuestra disposición para combatir y detener por completo esta ley atroz.
Conéctese a nuestro movimiento contra SB4. Llame o envíe un mensaje de texto a la organizadora principal de inmigración de TOP, Damaris González, al 832-774-7704 para descubrir cómo puede unirse a la lucha.
Denunciando el castigo leve a Ken Paxton
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/CorruptKen.jpg]
Brianna Brown, codirectora ejecutiva de TOP, emitió la siguiente declaración en respuesta a que el fiscal general de Texas, Ken Paxton, recibió un castigo leve de los fiscales para evitar ir a juicio por fraude de valores después de nueve años: [https://www.telemundodallas.com/noticias/eeuu/fiscal-general-de-texas-paga-300000-como-parte-de-acuerdo-por-caso-de-fraude/2415215/]
“Este acuerdo falso nos muestra claramente cómo existen dos sistemas de 'justicia' en este país; uno para los ricos y bien conectados, y otro para todos los demás. Tampoco cambia el hecho de que el Fiscal General de Texas, Ken Paxton, es el funcionario electo más corrupto de nuestro estado en los tiempos modernos .
“Al igual que su ídolo insurreccional, Donald J. Trump, Paxton es un estafador nacionalista blanco hambriento de poder que dirá y hará cualquier cosa para evitar la rendición de cuentas. Después de todo, no solo asistió, sino que habló en el infame mitin Stop The Steal de Trump el 6 de enero.
“ Durante años, Paxton ha utilizado a la oficina del fiscal general de nuestro estado como arma para infringir los derechos constitucionales de las personas , desde el acceso a las urnas hasta el aborto, la búsqueda de asilo y más. Sería difícil encontrar un político corrupto en Texas que merezca más ser destituido de su cargo por sus años de atacar a nuestras comunidades, restringir nuestras libertades y desestabilizar nuestra democracia.
“ Parte del esfuerzo histórico de BlackTOP para llegar a 1.4 millones de Tejanos Negros en las elecciones intermedias de 2022 incluyó el intento de entregarle a Paxton una “citación del pueblo” en una recaudación de fondos política organizada por uno de sus megadonantes en Colleyville.
“ Paxton, un favorito de la extrema derecha, se ha elevado políticamente a expensas del bienestar de los Tejanos Negros y Latinos , ilustrando una y otra vez cuán peligroso es para nuestras familias, peligroso para nuestro estado y peligroso para nuestra población. país. No importa la edad, la raza, la situación económica o las inclinaciones políticas, TODOS los texanos merecen funcionarios electos honestos que lideren con integridad, no políticos inmorales que buscan estatus y que solo se preocupan por sí mismos."
Consejos de TOP: Active esta función de iPhone para proteger aún más su identidad
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/iPhone%20tip%202024.jpeg]
A todos nos ha pasado alguna vez: nos hemos dejado el smartphone en un lugar público. Comienza el pánico. Si es usuario de iPhone, disfrute de mayor tranquilidad utilizando rápidamente una nueva característica que lo protege contra aquellos que puedan intentar robar su identidad desde su dispositivo. [https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/blog/ios-17-3-stolen-device-protection/]

Denunciando el castigo leve a Ken Paxton [] Brianna Brown, codirectora ejecutiva de TOP, emitió la siguiente declaración en respuesta a que el fiscal general de Texas, Ken Paxton, recibió un castigo leve de los fiscales para evitar ir a juicio por fraude de valores después de nueve años: [] “Este acuerdo falso nos muestra claramente cómo existen dos sistemas de 'justicia' en este país; uno para los ricos y bien conectados, y otro para todos los demás. Tampoco cambia el hecho de que el Fiscal General de Texas, Ken Paxton, es el funcionario electo más corrupto de nuestro estado en los tiempos modernos . “Al igual que su ídolo insurreccional, Donald J. Trump, Paxton es un estafador nacionalista blanco hambriento de poder que dirá y hará cualquier cosa para evitar la rendición de cuentas. Después de todo, no solo asistió, sino que habló en el infame mitin Stop The Steal de Trump el 6 de enero. “ Durante años, Paxton ha utilizado a la oficina del fiscal general de nuestro estado como arma para infringir los derechos constitucionales de las personas , desde el acceso a las urnas hasta el aborto, la búsqueda de asilo y más. Sería difícil encontrar un político corrupto en Texas que merezca más ser destituido de su cargo por sus años de atacar a nuestras comunidades, restringir nuestras libertades y desestabilizar nuestra democracia. “ Parte del esfuerzo histórico de BlackTOP para llegar a 1.4 millones de Tejanos Negros en las elecciones intermedias de 2022 incluyó el intento de entregarle a Paxton una “citación del pueblo” en una recaudación de fondos política organizada por uno de sus megadonantes en Colleyville. “ Paxton, un favorito de la extrema derecha, se ha elevado políticamente a expensas del bienestar de los Tejanos Negros y Latinos , ilustrando una y otra vez cuán peligroso es para nuestras familias, peligroso para nuestro estado y peligroso para nuestra población. país. No importa la edad, la raza, la situación económica o las inclinaciones políticas, TODOS los texanos merecen funcionarios electos honestos que lideren con integridad, no políticos inmorales que buscan estatus y que solo se preocupan por sí mismos." Consejos de TOP: Active esta función de iPhone para proteger aún más su identidad [] A todos nos ha pasado alguna vez: nos hemos dejado el smartphone en un lugar público. Comienza el pánico. Si es usuario de iPhone, disfrute de mayor tranquilidad utilizando rápidamente una nueva característica que lo protege contra aquellos que puedan intentar robar su identidad desde su dispositivo. subject: The key to Lincoln's rhetorical success
body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zpk9mk6tm01llq5etap0p6fl60jm9k8h3q7cm9mg_rp22sh2s8i6ep34cdh60o32chh2bs)
---
| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** **** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z1mqg9p4vhu5nl5pc0naji4dmn0632fkss4f58ug_rp22sh2s8i6ep34cdh60o32chh2bs)
---

body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

---
| | Dear fellow American, Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law. Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.” By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun. That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.” ** Through** “Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** ** ** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.** Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because... Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below: [_**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/dvd-mathematics-and-logic-course**_](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31337%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=f27ZA%2fyaqcnJRLbsIqOTFQ&sysid=1) Thank you for partnering with Hillsdale in its mission on behalf of liberty. name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: The key to Lincoln's rhetorical success
body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/AS-OT6GbBZ_GiLsv7q81Kg~~/AARclAA~)
---
| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** **** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
---
| [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/AS-OT6GbBZ_GiLsv7q81Kg~~/AARclAA~)
---
| | That’s why we need the support of friends like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.
Quantities of this special DVD box set are limited, so reserve your copy today. I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below:
[_**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/dvd-mathematics-and-logic-course**_](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/AS-OT6GbBZ_GiLsv7q81Kg~~/AARclAA~)
Thank you for partnering with Hillsdale in its mission on behalf of liberty.
Warm regards,
Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8638ad2c-a598-4a2a-b908-0b230685cafb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

| | | | | Peter, When I retired from the military, I immediately knew what I wanted to do next. During my 40 years of service I had the opportunity to travel the world and experience so much. In the end, the greatest gift was being able to retire back home to Georgia and become a farmer again. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T57c3b2cb-fe96-427e-80b3-80ec09dde443/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) My father passed away when I was young but he was a farmer. After he passed, the community stepped up to work our family farm. They took my siblings and I under their wing until we were old enough to handle it ourselves. Those experiences ingrained in me the values of hard work, dedication, community, and love of the land. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2125d93a-6ac2-45a6-b709-e6283a12046b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Farming here in North Georgia means dealing with a pretty wide range of demands. Recently, I got a herd of cattle and I’m diving into the work of caring for them from managing their grazing areas to ensuring their well-being. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T924560c0-026c-4964-8ec2-ceb7e12eef0c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Growing up on a farm cultivates a strong work ethic, and I’m eager to bring those values to Washington. It is my belief that our nation needs representatives who understand the essence of hard work and commitment. Unfortunately, **a strong work ethic is not something we’re getting from Marjorie Taylor Green** , who currently holds this Congressional seat. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T22190310-f13c-4a2b-8ac6-53fe0ac80ccd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) If you agree that we could use more hard work from Congress, I could use your help. MTG, whatever her work ethic, has a lot of powerful and wealthy friends. What I have is a nationwide team of regular people. I know we can conquer this incumbent, but the proof is in the pudding. Together, we can champion those values of hard work, dedication, and community. Your contribution will help us amplify our message and meet voters to make a meaningful difference.
---

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight."
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **" Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." **
Through** "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,"** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** ** **
**You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

Ron DeSantis ended Wednesday with the two sides agreeing to end the litigation, [leaving Florida in control ](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LEOnDAQBNCvMd0ie21srqBIQ3dpUyKDF9jIwAlvDvH3EanTjTTS02h-vYd35Mz78jNu1Ml8DHES_tJgAVtAN7gqdTMRkq2oM8EYb7ENWK1d68mbxpgwaXq5BhOlOCYXonfBtY4q7lCj0xZb_Wo8-lo704SXDlp7O9rWKKcpsRxn_fvgXVaa83186aynY6tyt4p8irI_FPYK--u66mkfp6dU2D-0wl7bJweFfeKy0w1xTzDn4-QUoZBIJsjxKn9YCjw2JCpxFy5QPjRxzJC4yMmTwMzLKpCOXaDEG5Z4w8g516tsuTq79Lk4Zy4-KKeXLXL-t1P--9rfAAAA__8Jgm5W)of the tourist district overseeing Disney World. The lawsuits began after Disney opposed a Florida law banning sex education for young children in grade school. DeSantis then dissolved the Disney board, which for 50 years had overseen Disney's land development. Multiple lawsuits followed. As part of Wednesday's settlement, Disney agreed to give [the new DeSantis-appointed board control](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuhDAQRL_GdCB7bWwoKNK4u7QpkQ8vdxsZ-4Q3h_j7iNTpXjGjGb2v23wLlCg_PsOGE69lDgvTG2fdwtCCmU0TpxURUDc4KaeU1TA4aJ6TAbtYVFobqU20MJjFLnrUcTVyuDvb0AQSjNQwyLG3YDtpVO9G6aS0-q4HJYzESFz27rtQ5ieu6Sxv3LulbE2ansyvKvSHAC_AH8fR_dTAJYbzCgjwlct-CvAZjyrAv0oipuXCa1iAl_piJ8BHqhnPtiJzwg0zt3vJbcQaMlNt11R2ikGAd1qpsYdeyqvW7FN8HZQSVeuEkY8tUPq7x__K-g0AAP__HLlnIw) over the district, though with an agreement that they'll consult with Disney on major changes. Disney also agreed to defer its appeal of a lawsuit against DeSantis.
## Longtime Senator Joe Lieberman Dies
Joe Lieberman, the longtime Connecticut senator who was [Al Gore's running mate](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFurDAQRb_GdEbDDNimcPEaun1tSmRg2J2VsRFYi_L3EanT3eJK5-h8PcZHkCjp-T9s7MuaxzAX-fBIGp3Gdmyrxa_MyFSxb2zTGEJnsXp5B93SWyDGmQ2CW3s7BUZHZgqE3VKJR8AWCB30nUFTQ9t0tgcLYGgi16gWeJGSj_qdJZUXr_E7f_io57xV0b9K2U9F_xQOCofruuo9Ryky5_ugcEh8nQqHm6JwALq3VTi8M-soPPGxhaQRAPRHZtb7wacsnIqEqFPeJDHrPEnRQNQ7qA6_7JfEKKexqoXnFiT-ypQ_0_wEAAD__yUyYa4) for the contested presidential election in 2000, died Wednesday at the age of 82. Lieberman was the first Jewish-American nominated on a major party's ticket. The 2000 race, one of the closest in U.S. history, was ultimately decided by the Supreme Court. Through his long career, Lieberman was known a hawk on foreign affairs. His support of the 2003 Iraq invasion alienated him from many Democrats, and he ended his career as an independent. Ron DeSantis ended Wednesday with the two sides agreeing to end the litigation, the tourist district overseeing Disney World. The lawsuits began after Disney opposed a Florida law banning sex education for young children in grade school. DeSantis then dissolved the Disney board, which for 50 years had overseen Disney's land development. Multiple lawsuits followed. As part of Wednesday's settlement, Disney agreed to give over the district, though with an agreement that they'll consult with Disney on major changes. Disney also agreed to defer its appeal of a lawsuit against DeSantis. Longtime Senator Joe Lieberman Dies Joe Lieberman, the longtime Connecticut senator who was for the contested presidential election in 2000, died Wednesday at the age of 82. Lieberman was the first Jewish-American nominated on a major party's ticket. The 2000 race, one of the closest in U.S. history, was ultimately decided by the Supreme Court. Through his long career, Lieberman was known a hawk on foreign affairs. His support of the 2003 Iraq invasion alienated him from many Democrats, and he ended his career as an independent. . Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight."
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **" Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." **
Through** "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,"** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

name: Reclaiming American Freedom
subject: Lincoln's secret weapon
body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills

| This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=34fe63674aa54c73a43a71fe1ed1d54e&_e=6BvayXpn9nwdmD0xOlyEcqOUzXoo8O3FREdKs_9Wm7b8I5YR8arsVfPNAkBaDFS8-MuUVE4CwNW3MXf5ExAiIxW6QLfQppBnvYLaWDRDfnlAo6eKLBn7kcHEyf0JlTcgzQmgkwzGq1etsc2604Vq_hd66E18PyzP6-NK7VZnG4ogtd5axRM_MfHSfoktyywx6mLSsfcMi8nJZsuD0Qst_Lgq1-yWVbSMj1ca1D7gijXjJc4ltSEMunf3viLsfc6bvHzFuLrM6uUZ-CAt9y7l_rS177KKMGSAIu7oVR35P6F4EwuHCXOYOhrORZjvjfwT9oSHN-DAs5ramb2L_kzmROPJDIOvtD7lj5_urunuhzJNiXpEbkv0CjzYhYoUucYAvyg19X9pabD5nC30RDm2CgSq1VDctupjqXhNauLK5uA%3D)
---
| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight."
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **" Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." **
Through** "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,"** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** ** ** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...

name: Marjorie Dannenfelser
subject: Do this one thing to stand for life today
body:
In our fast-paced world, it's easy to lose sight of fundamental principles

|
---
| | From the Desk of Marjorie Dannenfelser Hello, In our fast-paced world, it's easy to lose sight of fundamental principles, especially when it comes to complex issues. Rather than trying to understand or get involved, so often I find it's easier for people to turn a blind eye. Recently, I feel like the culture in our country has forgotten - or ignored - the most basic lessons. I've felt a growing concern about how our society perceives and values life, particularly when it comes to the development of human life. Science and research tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. We know exactly when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, can wiggle their toes, and even hear their mother's voice. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are treated as though they are not alive or even human in our society. **After speaking to the experts and talking to mothers for over 30 years as a pro-life activist, I can assure you that they are very much alive.** Our Creator has given us life as a precious gift. No person is disposable, and every life has value because we are made in His image. I believe that everyone deserves life, despite what our society, schools, or government say. I believe that together we can make a difference in our culture that has drifted off course. I believe we can bring dignity and a voice to the voiceless. I also strongly believe I'm not alone in my convictions. I believe that you believe this too. SBA Pro-Life America works everyday to bring the truth about abortion to light and shine a ray of hope into our culture. We want to give the next generation of Americans a bright future. But this future will require commitment from people like you. The first step we must all take is clearly stating what we believe and what we're willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. Will you join me and be a voice for the voiceless? Will you stand up for those that cannot do it for themselves? I've created a pro-life pledge and I'd love your support. You can join over 1 million pro-life supporters - people like you - that want to see the unborn protected, valued, and cherished. [https://action.sbaprolife.org/stand-for-life-with-me](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7caeb3cee23e4b678091e57121d6304c&_e=XY9w2bLBpoPq7jpOPkk0JBW_o5JMVT_SrAj2si7jsvCJRzLY9gdNicTC6KcKrab6hvy1WsfElZtPLwfEBa-Nvv1YOcbH5lpHKCEA2w2PscA-ViE25rEg9VbnqRR9D7UqMX5rvIlvSn3EfvzK6EzQKu4Y_hlc0JS6zAFdY2w6W2YMAQK-2mj7J4rrhi2Ne4SapJXB0TxYDjCjFLAirGBKwFP1OtL30e1rkMBzOSo_ZZNGvZW1fsr7LcMCoGdfHQV2FpQuU6NP0JqylXKK4aHzOicgMj9swCAKClcFGQX5DwqeCUdTeAG1RO_t-ubKxbdW-SXf_cITvwfH2d1pukMbr3rPxgaI5HMiMIbaPE7_AeV9VqjXY8GKtdzmWcAitLWKcpa9cy2IrPLcnznvh3Ym2mgNa5Qs7L1W6KmpmYJ2iSg%3D) For Life,

name: Craig Segall, Evergreen
subject: Draft PDFs are blocking a new clean tech boom.
body:
What you need to know + how we fix it
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2430289/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Friend,

**Did you know there's a flaw in how we implement the most important law regulating pollution—the Clean Air Act (CAA)?** And that that flaw is actually _preventing_ us from cleaning up our air and improving communities' health?

**I'll let you in on the little-known culprits:** Blurry, outdated draft-version PDFs from the 90s and bizarre loopholes at the center of the CAA's air permitting system. That system is supposed to drive clean tech into every big polluting source in the country—but those old docs mean that zero emission technology often just sits on the shelf.

They are slowing, and even blocking, scale-deployment of cost-effective, clean energy technology—causing real-life impacts on the air quality of mostly Black, Brown, and low-income communities.

We break down this public health and climate problem, how we fix it, and why you might not have heard about it until now. |
---
[READ NOW: AIR PERMITTING 101](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2430290/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| By addressing the inequitable harms of fossil fuel pollution at the source and putting the CAA to work as it was intended, we can create jobs, accelerate industrial decarbonization, and bring clean air to communities. Let's get to work.

Onward, |

Democrat policies have brought America to its knees. There's fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. The cost of living is exploding and for the first time causing more people to leave California. Joe Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don't care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and dependent. And that's why I'm running for Senate. We Republicans pulled our country out of the 1970's Democratic malaise by electing Ronald Reagan. Dear Friend,
March 31st will be the biggest test of our campaign to unseat Scott Perry. It’s an important fundraising deadline and the last one before the April 23rd primary election. I wanted to take a moment and lay out to you why I’m the best candidate to beat Scott Perry. That message is below. If you already support my campaign, I am asking for your help one more time to help us reach the most important goal in this campaign so far. Click here to contribute [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
The stakes in this election couldn’t be higher. Democrats are only a few seats away from control of the U.S. House of Representatives and this seat could be THE deciding race. With everything on the line, I’m asking the voters in PA-10 to remember the work we’ve already done. I’m proud of the race my team and I ran in 2022. We outperformed in a district that was redrawn to be more Republican by the courts. We achieved this with minimal funding and no national democratic support.
As you know, this district is now targeted, which means the nominee will receive support and resources from the national party. If I am the nominee, I’ll be able to build on all of the hard work we did in 2022 and finish the job. I’m the candidate the voters in this district know and trust.
To be successful, I need your help and I’m asking you to support my campaign with a contribution today. Please dig deep and contribute what you can to help us reach our March 31st fundraising goal here. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
The nominee we choose in PA-10 matters . Voters have a choice and I am the strongest nominee to take on Scott Perry in November. Voters in this district know me and I have a record of standing up for the values that will be front and center in this election. Along with being a longtime Democrat, I’m a proud pro-choice woman who has spent my career fighting for women’s rights. My work on these issues was recognized by the National Organization for Women when they endorsed my candidacy.
Comprehensive immigration reform is long overdue, and our economy needs it now more than ever. As an immigration attorney and Venezuelan-American, I have seen the results of our broken system up close. As a City Councilwoman, I’ve seen our family farms close and our businesses struggle with the lack of available labor. As a longtime Harrisburg resident, I know how medically underserved we are and what a functioning visa program would mean for bringing specialty doctors, home care workers, and childcare workers into our community.
We have all have witnessed Scott Perry and his allies in Congress block the bipartisan immigration reform bill that could have addressed many of these issues while implementing stringent border security measures. If elected to Congress, I would prioritize fixing our broken immigration system - not playing politics with such an important issue. I am honored that my efforts on these issues were acknowledged through endorsements from CASA in Action, Second Generation, and the Latino Victory Fund. With the support of these organizations, we will be well-positioned to engage and mobilize voters in our district who may not always participate in elections but are concerned about these issues.
Even with the help from these groups and the attention of national Democrats, our campaign will need the resources to get our message out to the voters of PA-10. That is why we’ve set an aggressive March 31st fundraising goal and I’m asking you for your support.
Click here to join our campaign and make a contribution of $100, $50, $25, or whatever you can afford before the March 31st deadline. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
With gratitude,
Shamaine

| | | Dear Peter,

The bridge collapse in Baltimore is a tragedy on many levels. My thoughts and prayers go out to the families that have lost someone so unexpectedly.

With the port in Baltimore being a major hub for trade - both international and domestic, the impacts of this bridge collapse are far-reaching. The supply chain was just starting to show signs of recovery after the pandemic. The likelihood now is that we will again face equipment delays and high prices.

Our community struggles daily with high prices, kept high by the failed democrat policies. Now as the supply chain begins to grapple with more problems created with this collapse, the question remains - will we continue to see prices soar?

My opinion is YES.

Couple that with the fact that Sean Casten has been working against the people of this District by supporting legislation that is designed to keep prices high, and we face more difficult times ahead. His stance against energy independence keeps transportation costs high.

It's time for change! Once I am in Congress, I will work in the interest of the people of this District and protect all Americans against the failed Democrat policies.

Spread the word. Tell your friends and family to vote Niki Conforti for Congress!!

Stay Safe! Stay Strong!

Can you help support the Conforti for Congress campaign's efforts to beat Casten? Your contribution will go a long way in helping us win! You can click the link below to make a donation today.

Without your grassroots support, we could miss the chance to reach crucial swing voters, and in a battleground race like this one, that could be the difference between winning and losing. The vast majority of contributions to this campaign come from emails like this one, so I’m counting on you today. Please use the links in this email to start a monthly donation through ActBlue. Thank you in advance. With gratitude, Bob Casey

# Campaign Update
---
This week's Monday Memo comes from Nathan Freed, the Campaign Chief of Staff....
Dear Peter,,
Here is a quick update from the campaign trail. With just 60 days before the start of early voting for the Primary, there are lots of things happening. Here's a rundown on some of them:
* Mark travels all over our district, participating in several events almost daily. * Volunteers host meet-and-greets in their homes, inviting their family, friends, and neighbors to meet Mark. * [With this link](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001mkKKiPkUUF0pa510b1K9A1c6-oQnlGns4CSBk0flz6eX13vtQM6xNwea7MboINnqboz60FCg6XwaMCSVJZGBFxqv_QH_PAIXL53tgXan4hkCdXPu0YVz_rpqpxcopxp0GB4papJjJMiP8lcPRIMBi3zJumyKwezlVaeFkhzYmbqDqBVYFupW0phIMCmd0k8X4t-4zxoU6bk=&c=rO4HfV_1gA_4SC2geLVhun76xtwRRMtS9bL3p4aH_AoMM1hCEEDLRg==&ch=3l5HqoJ133fyuuyKg7AMK5mgPQboKuFzvz-gT0ybf8znch3XE8BtRg==), Nevada voters are scheduling personal phone calls with Mark. He has several of these phone conversations each week. * Mark is very visible in the various communities in our district, finding out what issues are most important to them. * We are engaging with the 46,000 registered Republicans who did not vote last time, encouraging them to vote early, in person, or by mail. The message is VOTE! * Our [campaign website](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001mkKKiPkUUF0pa510b1K9A1c6-oQnlGns4CSBk0flz6eX13vtQM6xN1yIpLuj6zp6BWkuzHUOtgwV6RPKoJCf2EB6L9xu6TuQ8-alMr7Kqd5ZZC-U7TU7yraXIEmYjdB3WAsNCwzPLCMaIEOPG31SxUxM0Zt28dHfR6E_cWARg8A=&c=rO4HfV_1gA_4SC2geLVhun76xtwRRMtS9bL3p4aH_AoMM1hCEEDLRg==&ch=3l5HqoJ133fyuuyKg7AMK5mgPQboKuFzvz-gT0ybf8znch3XE8BtRg==) has a "Chat" feature people are using to chat directly with Mark (not an A.I. robot). * We're holding events at coffee shops, restaurants, local parks, Senior Centers, and Community Recreation Centers so that Mark can talk with people wherever they gather. * Several Republican Clubs have invited Mark to participate in town halls, debates, and as a keynote speaker. * Local Veteran and law-enforcement organizations are hosting Mark at their events. * We are coordinating our efforts with several Republican candidates running for State and Local offices within our Congressional District, which helps more conservatives get elected. * Local TV, print media, and social influencers have interviewed Mark.
We have hundreds of volunteers, thousands of social media followers, and over 100,000 people who voted for Mark in the last election. Many of these people are involved in knocking on doors, putting out signs, calling voters, sending text messages, and doing other things to help spread the word.
In the last election, Mark beat Titus in Boulder City. He beat her in Henderson. Mark beat Titus by 20 points with in-person voters. Titus won the ballot-harvested and mail-in votes. Like Abraham Lincoln and Ronald Reagan, who also lost their first elections, we are using these lessons to win this time. No one is better positioned to win the general election than Colonel Mark Robertson!
Our momentum is building. You can still get involved if you like. Please respond to this email, and someone from our all-volunteer staff will contact you!
Sincerely,
Nathan Freed

| I trust this message finds you in good health and high spirits. I am writing to share the exciting news that we are entering the second phase of our campaign for the United States Senate from the great state of Tennessee. Last month, we submitted our petitions to officially be the first (#BeThe1st) Environmentalist and Woman of Color to represent the great state of Tennessee in the U.S. Senate. [Over the years, my commitment to serving our community and championing the issues that deeply resonate with us has only strengthened. Now, I am thrilled to elevate that dedication by pursuing a seat in the United States Senate. My aim is to instigate positive change and serve as a steadfast advocate for our shared values and aspirations.](https://l5vsmw.fg98.fdske.com/ec/gAAAAABmBXB3j0BcGAKtewA6ejF7tohInKD8b_YH-zXc8iCJ7RD0cu5-9pCxQ1J5Ged6e7r7zgGsKO148Y0Epkfk_8YP_UQ9pMUxE_m0ihKoC3GxD3x7nbrrqi8dZw2PyRjTmGPZEo_qKLDHe1XiaP4p5mxL41MF-zWFc2dkCW0F75ceQe0j87rE5ms21UI8XAcvLXbDl-O9SKbMtuZEksIEBTg6CoHNqydSr6VxxqYh8Ju1ED7S3FslVGXOQOQoDe3-imEqw5_ysA1dxKckylTx2rMpA-lvWIEnFWRslzsEO4KEbJqPJhKMMj76G9qgb8fPveE4gjidS_8QmXYlArlgkxaalPEKYIbQ5zScqGMaABfT2ljOGx1qgAEKjsnDGihUNrUMhOlE) Having been actively involved in community service, I have consistently witnessed the challenges faced by everyday Americans. [I firmly believe that through collaborative efforts, we can forge a brighter future for all Americans.
