| March 26, 2024 Laken Riley – say her name. The arrest of an illegal alien from Venezuela for the brutal murder of this promising young woman has rightly become a national call to action on the border. When the Democrats in the White House flat-out refuse to create a safe environment for a 22-year-old nursing student’s morning jog, you know that we’ve failed our young women. We can hardly remember a time when purposeful inaction, like that of the Biden administration and his Democrat allies, has welcomed chaos and disarray throughout the nation. FBI Director Christopher Wray recently testified before Congress that “we have had dangerous individuals entering the United States... We are seeing a wide array of very dangerous threats that emanate from the border. The FBI alone seized enough fentanyl in the last two years to kill 270 million people.” Over the past several months, countless stories have been reported on drug trafficking, rapes, and murders by illegal aliens coming across our open borders. More ominously, we know that people on the terror watch list are crossing these open borders into the United States. From 2021 to 2023, there was almost a 260 percent increase overall in terrorist screening encounters and an almost 800 percent increase on the Northern Border. Open border policies have devastated our neighbors to the south. Massachusetts has eight sanctuary cities, including Boston, leading to migrants overwhelming their emergency shelter system. This will cost Bay State taxpayers close to $1 billion by the end of fiscal year 2024. The Biden administration’s open border policies recently allowed a Haitian man to enter the country illegally, and then allegedly rape a 15-year-old disabled girl at a Massachusetts-run shelter. Democrat Gov. Maura Healey’s only response was to say, “I think we have the right systems in place,” and “It is unfortunate, from time to time, things will happen.” Her comments are unacceptable and dangerously naïve. New Hampshire taxpayers can’t afford the consequences of sanctuary policies. Do we want Manchester Airport to be converted into a makeshift shelter like Boston-Logan Airport was? We do not want New Hampshire to be a magnet for illegal aliens like Massachusetts. We’re already feeling the effects of open borders, along with every state in the nation. Opioid use has skyrocketed, and deadly fentanyl is seeping into our communities. If you visit any larger city in the Granite State, you will see the resulting homelessness that these drugs are bringing into our backyards. Now, every state is a border state. And despite all of this, the Democrats still refuse to act. But New Hampshire Republicans are taking action. Attorney General John Formella recently called for Congress to pass the “Laken Riley Act,” requiring the detainment of any illegal alien for the offenses of larceny, burglary, theft, or shoplifting. Sadly, our Democratic U.S. Sens., Jeanne Shaheen and Maggie Hassan, voted against the bill. That’s shameful. Sanctuary policies are a magnet for illegal aliens looking to evade the law. Republican state senators voted to prohibit “sanctuary cities” in New Hampshire. We voted to stop illegal aliens from using driver’s licenses they get in states like Massachusetts. We are fighting to stop the flood of fentanyl and opioids onto our streets, so we funded efforts to secure our Northern Border and send our National Guard to help secure the Southern Border. Unfortunately, but not surprisingly, New Hampshire Democrats stood against these common-sense measures. One political party is serious about our border crisis, and one is not. In fact, some Democrats are more concerned about the term used to describe a person entering our country illegally than stopping the flow of drugs and dangerous criminals. They object to saying “illegal alien” but do nothing to reduce the number of illegal aliens coming to our state. We think ignoring our immigration crisis is what’s offensive. Laken Riley was violently beaten and murdered by an illegal alien who came into our country with bad intentions. Offensive language did not kill Laken Riley. Open borders and sanctuary city policies did. The time to act is now. **ABOUT THE AUTHORS** _Sen. Sharon Carson (R-Londonderry) is chair of the Senate Judiciary Committee. Sen. Bill Gannon (R-Sandown) is vice chairman._

The arrest of an illegal alien from Venezuela for the brutal murder of this promising young woman has rightly become a national call to action on the border. When the Democrats in the White House flat-out refuse to create a safe environment for a 22-year-old nursing student’s morning jog, you know that we’ve failed our young women. We can hardly remember a time when purposeful inaction, like that of the Biden administration and his Democrat allies, has welcomed chaos and disarray throughout the nation. FBI Director Christopher Wray recently testified before Congress that “we have had dangerous individuals entering the United States... We are seeing a wide array of very dangerous threats that emanate from the border. The FBI alone seized enough fentanyl in the last two years to kill 270 million people.” Over the past several months, countless stories have been reported on drug trafficking, rapes, and murders by illegal aliens coming across our open borders. More ominously, we know that people on the terror watch list are crossing these open borders into the United States. From 2021 to 2023, there was almost a 260 percent increase overall in terrorist screening encounters and an almost 800 percent increase on the Northern Border. Open border policies have devastated our neighbors to the south. Massachusetts has eight sanctuary cities, including Boston, leading to migrants overwhelming their emergency shelter system. This will cost Bay State taxpayers close to $1 billion by the end of fiscal year 2024. The Biden administration’s open border policies recently allowed a Haitian man to enter the country illegally, and then allegedly rape a 15-year-old disabled girl at a Massachusetts-run shelter. Democrat Gov. Maura Healey’s only response was to say, “I think we have the right systems in place,” and “It is unfortunate, from time to time, things will happen.” Her comments are unacceptable and dangerously naïve. New Hampshire taxpayers can’t afford the consequences of sanctuary policies. Do we want Manchester Airport to be converted into a makeshift shelter like Boston-Logan Airport was? We do not want New Hampshire to be a magnet for illegal aliens like Massachusetts. We’re already feeling the effects of open borders, along with every state in the nation. Opioid use has skyrocketed, and deadly fentanyl is seeping into our communities. If you visit any larger city in the Granite State, you will see the resulting homelessness that these drugs are bringing into our backyards. Now, every state is a border state. And despite all of this, the Democrats still refuse to act. But New Hampshire Republicans are taking action. Attorney General John Formella recently called for Congress to pass the “Laken Riley Act,” requiring the detainment of any illegal alien for the offenses of larceny, burglary, theft, or shoplifting. Sadly, our Democratic U.S. Sens., Jeanne Shaheen and Maggie Hassan, voted against the bill. That’s shameful. Sanctuary policies are a magnet for illegal aliens looking to evade the law. Republican state senators voted to prohibit “sanctuary cities” in New Hampshire. We voted to stop illegal aliens from using driver’s licenses they get in states like Massachusetts. We are fighting to stop the flood of fentanyl and opioids onto our streets, so we funded efforts to secure our Northern Border and send our National Guard to help secure the Southern Border. Unfortunately, but not surprisingly, New Hampshire Democrats stood against these common-sense measures. One political party is serious about our border crisis, and one is not. Laken Riley was violently beaten and murdered by an illegal alien who came into our country with bad intentions. Offensive language did not kill Laken Riley. Friend,
I wanted to reach out and ensure you saw this important message from Pam, myself, and dozens of other Virginians committed to seeing Jay Jones elected our next Attorney General.
I've said it before, I will say it again today, Jay Jones is the right Democrat to serve as Virginia's next Attorney General. He is smart, he is a listener, he cares about the future of the Commonwealth, and he will be an Attorney General who is focused on justice for everyone in the Commonwealth. I am honored to lead this committee in supporting and encouraging Jay Jones to be our next Attorney General.
Please join me in supporting Jay Jones with a contribution of $10 or more before our first reporting deadline on Sunday! Here's a link you can use: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/virginians-for-jay-jones [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/virginians-for-jay-jones]
Thank you,
Governor Ralph S. Northam
—————————-—-——Forwarded Message————————————
For Immediate Release
January 4, 2024
Virginians for Jay Jones PAC Launches With Support from Across the Commonwealth
PAC will encourage, support Jones for the Democratic nomination for Attorney General in 2025
Norfolk, VA — Today, dozens of supporters of Jay Jones launched “Virginians for Jay Jones” to encourage Delegate Jay Jones to seek the Democratic nomination for Attorney General in 2025. Co-chairs of the PAC include former Governor Ralph Northam, former First Lady Pam Northam, Senator-elect Laschrese Aird, Senator-elect Schuyler Van Valkenberg, Delegate Alex Askew, Delegate Jeff Bourne, and Delegate Paul Krizek.
“I’ve said it before, I will say it again today, Jay Jones is the right Democrat to serve as Virginia’s next Attorney General,” former Governor Northam said. “He is smart, he is a listener, he cares about the future of the Commonwealth, and he will be an Attorney General who is focused on justice for everyone in the Commonwealth. I am honored to lead this committee in supporting and encouraging Jay Jones to be our next Attorney General.”
“When families needed leadership in their community, Jay stepped up to serve in the House of Delegates. When the General Assembly needed a new generation of leaders, Jay created Meet Our Moment to personally train and invest in minority candidates. And now, as Virginia needs someone with an unwavering commitment to justice and equality, Jay is the ideal candidate for Attorney General. Jay understands the challenges we face as a Commonwealth and has the courage and wisdom to tackle them head-on,” said Senator-elect Lashrecse Aird.
“With Jay Jones as Attorney General, Virginia will have a champion for the people, someone who understands that the law can be a force for justice. We need his leadership to address issues from public safety to consumer protection and civil rights. I urge Jay to run for Attorney General, and if he runs I’ll work every day to see him elected,” said Senator-elect Schuyler VanValkenburg.
“Jay Jones has shown time and again his dedication to serving the Commonwealth with integrity and a vision for a more inclusive future. Like the best leaders, Jay is a listener who takes what he hears and turns it into action on behalf of all Virginians. I strongly encourage Jay to run, because his candidacy would be a beacon of hope for those who believe in a fairer, more just Commonwealth,” said Delegate Alex Askew.
"Having spent three years in leadership at the Office of the Attorney General, I have seen first hand the qualities, skills and abilities that are necessary to be an effective AG. I can think of no better person for the job than Jay Jones,” said Delegate Jeff Bourne.
“Jay is honored to receive the support of so many Virginia leaders to serve as your next Attorney General,” said Lesley Shinbaum, senior adviser to Jay Jones. “He will remain focused on the important election we have in front of us in 2024: re-electing President Joe Biden and Senator Tim Kaine. He will also be working to ensure we hold the 7th and 10th congressional districts and flip the 2nd back to Democratic control. We must stay focused on the task at hand in 2024 and any formal announcement for 2025 will come after those elections have concluded.”
The full of list of Virginians for Jones includes:
Governor Ralph S. Northam
Former First Lady Pamela Northam
Current and newly elected General Assembly members
Senator-elect Lashrecse Aird (Petersburg)
Senator Lamont Bagby, Chairman, Virginia Legislative Black Caucus (Henrico)

Senator-elect Angelia Williams Graves (Norfolk)
Delegate Alex Askew (Virginia Beach)
Delegate-elect Bonita Anthony (Norfolk)

Delegate Jeff Bourne (Richmond)
Delegate Nadarius Clark (Suffolk)
Delegate-elect Joshua Cole (Stafford)
Delegate-elect Rae Cousins (Richmond)
Delegate-elect Michael Feggans (Virginia Beach)
Delegate Kelly Convirs-Fowler (Virginia Beach)
Delegate Cliff Hayes (Chesapeake)
Delegate-elect Phil Hernandez (Norfolk)
Delegate-elect Michael Jones (Richmond)
Delegate Candi Mundon King (Prince William)
Delegate Kathleen Murphy (Fairfax)
Delegate Paul Krizek (Fairfax)
Delegate Marcia Price (Newport News)
Delegate David Reid (Loudoun)
Delegate Holly Seibold (Fairfax)
Delegate Marcus Simon (Fairfax)
Delegate Shelly Simonds (Newport News)
Delegate-elect Josh Thomas (Prince William)
Former General Assembly Members
Former Delegate Ward Armstrong, Former House Democratic Minority Leader (Martinsville)
Former Delegate Dick Cranwell, Former House Democratic Majority and Minority Leader (Vinton)
Former Delegate Chris Hurst (Blacksburg)
Former Delegate Mike Mullin (Newport News)
Daun Hester, Treasurer, Former Vice Mayor, and Former Delegate (Norfolk)
About Jay Jones
Jay Jones is an attorney at Hogan Lovells, a global law firm, where he focuses his practice on state Attorneys General work as well as regulatory and policy matters, including environmental, social, and corporate governance (ESG) issues. He is an accomplished litigator with extensive trial experience in state court. He served in the House of Delegates from 2018-2021 where he fought to expand Medicaid, increase the minimum wage, and raise teacher pay. Jay also championed legislation known as the “Ashanti Alert,” a bill to establish a missing persons alert for adults in the Commonwealth, which was used as the model for a bill that eventually became federal law.
After serving in the House, Jay served as an Assistant Attorney General in the Office of the Attorney General for the District of Columbia, where he was a member of the Office of Consumer Protection. Jones lives in Norfolk with his wife Mavis and son.

_Let me explain why this is so important._

The first 24 hours after kicking off a campaign are crucial to setting our pace for the rest of the race. We’re in all-important Pennsylvania, so you know that national Republicans will be watching us – hoping for signs of weakness to inform their swing state strategies. My career in public service began in 2016, when I was recruited to flip a
competitive House seat blue. I was serving as the president of Nevada’s
largest synagogue, and looking back now, that was incredibly fitting —
because my Jewish faith and values have always been at the very core of my
work in Congress.

principle of Tikkun Olam — to leave the world a better place than how we
found it.

Hello,
When I first decided to run against Lauren Boebert in 2022, people warned me what would happen. Politics is a “blood sport,” they said. The attacks would get nasty. I tried to prepare myself – to prepare my family – for what would come. But I never could have imagined the things that Boebert and her far-right allies would make up and put on TV.
**Now, after we came just 546 votes short of in 2022 (the closest race in the entire country!), and with Boebert running off scared to another district, the attacks are going to get even nastier. I’m sure of it.**
Super PACs are going to spend millions running the most ridiculous ads they can attacking me. We have to be ready if we’re going to win.
I’m facing my first federally-mandated FEC fundraising deadline of the year at midnight on Sunday, and if the Super PACs sense even one shred of weakness in our public fundraising report, they’ll pounce with attacks to try to bury us.

| Peter - The last few weeks have been HUGE for us, and it's all thanks to you! Recent polling shows **we’re leading the Republican primary race** for Nevada’s CRUCIAL 3rd congressional district. But we need your help to stay there! March 31st is Easter Sunday. But it’s also a **CRITICAL fundraising deadline **– the end of the 1st financial quarter for congressional candidates. The money we get before the deadline will help us pay for signs, mailers, and TV ads. Even more importantly, it will show our supporters across the nation how serious we are about _WINNING THIS RACE!_ People in DC and across America are watching our race closely because they want to see me in this seat. They believe my background of fighting for limited government policy solutions at America’s leading conservative think tanks and nonprofits is **exactly what the Republican party needs in Congress.** According to our analysis,**for every $1 we raise, more than $4 in support will flood in from outside organizations** that want to ensure we flip this seat and _help Republicans keep control of the House of Representatives_. **You may think a small donation of $5 or $10 won’t mean much. But it means the world to our campaign right now.** I’d be very grateful for any amount you’re able to give to support our campaign before midnight on Sunday. Simply visit this link to donate online: [https://secure.winred.com/drew-johnson-for-congress/victory-2024](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=e6b4dc7fd2&e=fc26432468) Whether it is $5 or $5,000, **_every dollar counts._** Thank you for your support, your kindness, your prayers, and your belief in our campaign to make America freer and more prosperous.

---
|
---
|
# _**In the Media**_
The Daily Caller featured [Drew’s groundbreaking exposé](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=57a1d7f994&e=fc26432468) about the Biden administration’s plan to use tax dollars to bail Moderna out of legal trouble. Moderna was caught stealing patents to make its COVID vaccines. Now, if the vaccine-maker loses its multi-billion dollar patent infringement lawsuit, Biden wants taxpayers to pay the damages -- even though Moderna made more than $42 billion from its COVID jabs.

Drew has spent his career as one of the most effective taxpayer watchdogs in American history. This is just the latest example of him fighting to protect your hard-earned tax dollars.
---
| [Read the Article](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=3a16b12347&e=fc26432468 "Read the Article")
---
|
---
|
# _**On the Campaign Trail**_
The **Sin City Chamber of Commerce **featured Drew in a ribbon-cutting ceremony to celebrate a new wine bar at the **Ahern Luxury Boutique Hotel**. Drew joined small business owners and community leaders to discuss ways he hopes to make it easier to do business in Southern Nevada.
---
|
---
|
---
| **Battle Born Republican Women** welcomed Drew back to speak at their March meeting. Drew is always inspired by this amazing group of tireless conservative activists. He was proud to share stories from his childhood and outline his path to flip Nevada’s 3rd congressional district red to ensure Republicans keep control of the House of Representatives.
---
|
---
|
---
| **Pastor Matt** and the wonderful team at **Liberty Baptist Church** hosted the** Clark County Republican Convention**. Drew was excited to engage with hundreds of supporters who will help carry him and many other Republicans to victory in November!
---
|
---
|
---
| At the **Hope for Prisoners** graduation, Drew was honored to lead the Pledge of Allegiance as well as hand out certificates to March's graduating class. Hope for Prisoners founder **Jon Ponder** has created one of the best and most successful reentry programs in America right here in Las Vegas!
---
|
---
| Drew and Sarah enjoyed spending their Saturday at the **Summerlin Easter Egg Hunt **hosted by the **Las Vegas Metro Police Department Summerlin Area Command**. They were delighted to help Metro officers bring smiles to dozens of happy families!

_Fun fact: Drew was the Easter Bunny 🐰 at the mall when he was a senior in high school. He only made $5.15 an hour, but he was allowed to eat as much candy as he wanted! 🍬 🧺_
---
|
---
| **Southern Hills Republican Women** put on a wonderful candidate forum earlier this week. Talk radio host, **Alan Stock** , and **Nickie Diersen** , SHRW’s 1st VP of Programs, did a great job moderating. Attendees enthusiastically supported Drew’s liberty-based solutions to some of the most important issues facing Southern Nevada voters.
---
|
---
|
---
|
# _**Upcoming Events**_
---
|
### April 17 | 11 AM - 1 PM
Catch Drew in action! He'll participate in the **Republican Women of Las Vegas’ CD-3 Candidate Panel** during RWLV’s monthly meeting at Lawry's The Prime Rib. [Learn more about the event here](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=26424ceb9b&e=fc26432468).
---
|
### April 18 | 6 - 8 PM
The **Sun City Summerlin Conservatives Club** is hosting a **Conservative Candidate Meet & Greet **with local conservative candidates at the Sun City Summerlin Community Center. Don't miss it!
---
|
---
|
---
|
# _YOU Can Help Us Defeat Susie Lee!_
Want to help Drew and make sure Republicans maintain control of the House of Representatives? We need your help! This race is going to be tight, and having supporters like you step up and lend a hand is vital!

Here are the **_TOP 3_ ways _YOU_ can get involved:**

1. **Donate: **Simply chipping in a few dollars to support our efforts is incredibly helpful. Whether it's $3 or $3,000, every donation makes a _huge_ difference! Just $18 buys coffee and donuts for volunteers! **You can contribute to the campaign [HERE](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=3932d82d25&e=fc26432468)**.

2. **Host a Meet-and-Greet for Drew** : Hosting a Meet-and-Greet in your home for Drew and inviting your friends, family, and neighbors is one of the _best ways to spread our message_. Whether it’s a casual coffee meeting, a wine and cheese event, or an energetic Golden Knights watch party, we can make hosting a get-together fun and easy. Interested in hosting a Meet-and-Greet? Email [linnea@drewfornevada.com](mailto:linnea@drewfornevada.com?subject=I'd%20like%20to%20host%20a%20Meet%20%26%20Greet%20for%20Drew!).

3. **Volunteer for the Campaign:** #TeamDrew is the secret weapon that will get Drew elected to Congress. We're knocking on tens of thousands of doors, writing thousands of postcards, and making as many phone calls as possible to make this campaign a success. And we can't do it without you! Please visit** **[THIS](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=13ee62dab4&e=fc26432468) link to join #TeamDrew as a volunteer.

[**Which is why he should be wearing an ankle monitor, should be tracked 24/7, and put in prison if he tries to flee.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8a29183a-db0a-44ca-b5ec-c2a3af86aee6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Trump has a host of despots and autocrats ready to give him asylum, most notably Putin in Russia. And we need to take steps NOW to prevent him from fleeing justice and wreaking havoc. [**Add your name, and call for Trump to be forced to wear an ankle monitor.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5178e0da-7360-463c-8b7e-94015cf6e16b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

This is their attempt to stop Black and Brown folks from having their voices heard on Election Day. | | | | | [](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=a0db7fd13b&e=95417d7e87)
---
Fellow activist,

Ahead of a critical election year, Republicans are stepping up their attacks on voting rights.

Shortly after PA Democratic Speaker Joanna McClinton announced her intention to introduce same-day voter registration and early in-person voting on machines, Republicans lashed out. Senator Cris Dush (R) introduced legislation to **_eliminate satellite offices and drop boxes_** , and PA House GOP Leader Bryan Cutler announced his intention to push for a constitutional amendment to **_advance additional voter ID barriers._**

In order to vote in Pennsylvania, voters already need to show a valid ID when voting for the first time. But in a clear attempt to suppress votes, Republicans want to take it a step further.

As our CEO Kadida Kenner stated to _LancasterOnline (LNP)_ , “This is their attempt to stop Black and Brown folks, young voters and immigrant communities from having more convenient access to ballots and having their voices heard on Election Day.”

[**We’ve seen these attacks before. In 2020, Trump ran a smear campaign against PA’s election systems in an attempt to overturn the results. Now, with the 2024 presidential election coming up fast and PA being a key battleground state, we have to be prepared for anything. Help us prepare to defend voting rights in PA by rushing $25 or more today →**](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=24a74a08c7&e=95417d7e87) _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [**$25 »**](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=e2d4907986&e=95417d7e87)

body:

This is going to be a long one, team, but it’s important.
If you’re in a rush, here’s the short version: Right-wing extremists have a **900+ page plan** to completely dismantle our democracy in the first 180 days of a Trump presidency. They want to ban abortion nationwide, overhaul the entire federal bureaucracy, roll back any progress we’ve made for LGBTQ+ rights, and commit all kinds of human rights violations for their own political agendas.
The bottom line is that we cannot let them get away with this. We’re mobilizing young voters to fight back, but we need your support. The FEC fundraising deadline is coming up fast, and we need your help to hit our quarterly fundraising goal. [Can we count on you to chip in and support the fight for our democracy?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81817732/463631769/644581965?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS85OTMyMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMjdhMTRkZS0xM2VkLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vK5f4I622rJtcb_37b30O8z4yMYhN4S6RPdOEUQfqMU=&emci=a863fa52-4ae2-ee11-aaf0-002248223197&emdi=227a14de-13ed-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=6787172)

* * *

There’s no easy way to say this, so we’ll just come right out with it: Letting young voters sit home and do nothing on Election Day 2024 will have disastrous results.
We don’t say that to be dramatic; we say it because we read the GOP’s 920-page plan and they make it very clear that they’re out for blood.
**If young voters don’t show up and make their voices heard in November, we can say goodbye to democracy as we know it in the U.S.**
Here’s what’s going on — the MAGA zealots are on a mission to get Trump a second term. And to make his transition to power easier for him, right-wing groups have raised $20 million toward what they’re calling **Project 2025.**
If MAGA extremists get their way, Project 2025 will be the blueprint for a Trump dictatorship on his first day in office.
Here’s what they have planned:

Peter - My name is Nancy Mace.

I’m a high school dropout who started out working at Waffle House to pay the bills and put food on the table.

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also worked to earn my high school diploma taking classes at a technical college. **I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies — and I am a better woman because of it.**

**Through grit and the American dream, I was the first woman to graduate from The Citadel’s Corps of Cadets and now proudly serve in Congress and fight for folks like you to have the same opportunities that I was granted.**

Unlike a lot of folks in Washington, I’ve been working since I was 17. It’s clear Congress is in desperate need of people like me – someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other.

Someone who knows what it’s like to actually earn a living and make sacrifices.

We need actionable, common-sense solutions to address illegal immigration and its ramifications in our own backyard. | That's why I've outlined a detailed plan aimed at tackling this issue head-on, proposing strategies that prioritize security, uphold the rule of law, and protect the interests of New Jersey residents. == This plan is a rallying point for all of us who believe in taking decisive action to safeguard our state and country. It's about more than just securing our borders; it's about ensuring a future where legal immigration is respected and illegal activities are staunchly opposed. As members of the Common Sense Club, we stand united in advocating for policies that make sense, policies that protect our communities, and policies that ensure the prosperity of our great state. If you haven't yet joined our ranks, now is the time. Among other perks, members will receive exclusive updates as we complete important missions like visiting the border, granting you intimate insights into the realities our country is facing. Your support enables us to keep fighting the good fight, to push for real action on border security, and to make sure New Jersey remains a beacon of common sense in an often chaotic world. Together, we can tackle this crisis head-on and emerge stronger, safer, and more united than ever before. ✅ Quality, affordable healthcare, paid sick leave, and childcare for $10 a day; and
✅ Student debt forgiveness up to $50,000 and free public college.

body:
It is Time We Unseat lizzie Fletcher

Friend, I hope you are having a blessed Holy Week.

I’m Caroline Kane, I'm running for Congress in Houston, TX and I am looking to unseat radical leftist Lizzie Fletcher in TX CD-07. I'm honored to have the chance to earn your support - and we need it today, before the end of the quarter on March 31st! Would you consider jumping in today?

I am a wife, a mother, and a small business owner. I run a multi-family property management company, am an investor, and contributing writer for Forbes Real Estate council.

I have the endorsement of Commissioner of Agriculture Sid Miller, Dr. Hotze and the Houston Chronicle, showcasing my broad appeal to all on the right.

I am the woman to take the down Lizzie Fletcher in November.

Would you consider jumping in to support my race? Click here to give $100, $250 or even $500 (https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=34149a4534&e=522547b974) . Want to schedule a call or a meeting? I’m happy to come to you! Click here to submit a meeting request (https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=969a878cc8&e=522547b974) .

And, Happy Easter! May we never forget why we are fighting to take back our country.
Donate Today! (https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=866bd912fe&e=522547b974)
Request A Meeting With Caroline (https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=bac4664a9d&e=522547b974)

I hope you will take a moment to read a bit about my platform below. I look forward to meeting you in the district and working for you to bring our Texas values to the swamp.

Caroline’s Plan for 2024 Includes:

· Secure the border, deport illegal aliens and tighten all existing visas.

· Outlaw ALL government assistance for illegal immigrants.

· Outlaw ownership of US soil by anyone other than a US citizen.

· Repeal the Green New Deal and end all federal interest and subsidies for Net Zero, ESG and DEI

· Repeal the Patriot Act restoring privacy and eliminating DHS and all their NGOs that are currently assisting in smuggling, narcotics, gun trafficking and human and child sex trafficking and slavery.

· Term Limits

· Incentivize quality farming practices with quality produce and livestock. Outlaw GMOs and mandatory vaccinations.

Join me – and let’s raise some KANE in DC!
Donate Today! (https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=0a177e08e9&e=522547b974)

Caroline Kane

Small Business Owner and Candidate for US House TX Dist 7

Staunch Conservative Values

America FIRST – Much Smaller Government

| | Friend, Like something out of a sci-fi movie, artificial intelligence (AI) is [expanding rapidly](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=e50fcd2ed5044bb3a255b460a2755585&_e=nik11ZoTukKaNrNwhQib8qrzdRlCAZT4pU-uMAsZ-JZwvrutes1Krt3ax9IH5F06qtukLNNsWl0aRafWJzawrNY9NF2S3MrD-AFF48O6FdFIq7Bi1MBRmIZVERGa9hFJEyPmp2OsL7bpdVU1urgREz9y919IZ6PzM9-JvAXRm5odp37htnnHDnYGxxhlEOGUt5SQoYqEpkbKFlZjX3h3L1KVX_eYqwWZD9gysq5ebhsiuueA8AmB2LveYlda8YdcjDEROpwFhed3tMl0fheJFV3aXv-Iq8p5bYeDhXQknMUPx6GcqCtShG4HgOh0bUbtDgjx0JBR86rAIzWfwhpgQg%3D%3D) into nearly every industry. Many states have already [passed laws](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=e50fcd2ed5044bb3a255b460a2755585&_e=nik11ZoTukKaNrNwhQib8l50KgQr3iIpSbxBxNMcYUBuAqYGfpg-vN1Yu1z5WX2jAPKIkGbyJGPQ9X_8KGN-vDGrGNu5FNp6pw-_MW6tNuZGNhnUOItVHVgjkO62JkTDJN2QFUnJTqcFdQuZyvUJWAvUXvxVlQ20DMeDwHDWwH32t11-wK1GRm2ZwtZU917RZUYezn5U1WqDUyyBAv7VmKvMkoUZg4hkXHqVEsMKfZVpYHBlzt60ed4xfmxB84foSCpSGgKv_LvkBcS3SYHgvKGErZ69KuK4WzMiPubDRXYOmbwsp9tUl63cSkaNy82h) limiting the use of AI in areas like police investigations and hiring, but Congress is [late to the game](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=e50fcd2ed5044bb3a255b460a2755585&_e=nik11ZoTukKaNrNwhQib8njPr6yKfY4ZFdlNCuD5CU0H8THjPSqkEAi66zVvGGWsaXJUpakY5roLGifiKliCUnciKjI7s2O9QyQLP3fZ2dqcTx6OQJjMnC8KBgvJyZHzyIgmU1GDLDuQb_Re9T3mwvF0lyM4LEmk7Ami3ucH7KiBEUcbJ6qTzDeWiVHeLBrEsaqzVI-LJJupxSIRZpDpDFTgD5m9djlgjbJZguRRkrTep23IZg1dmDfCwDGDHmK2wTZjt_doKuyQxRookYUsTnSlcwLV7tziUljHgYAktUQ%3D) on regulation. As we scramble to play catch-up, it appears we’re turning to the Korean War era [Defense Production Act](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=e50fcd2ed5044bb3a255b460a2755585&_e=nik11ZoTukKaNrNwhQib8vEgBDYqsaYpoYfjtKCis9x1Pc1Ae0dMrIp9x43XfbFOCePTStchc7ud1LzYOewCY9HTFSVy7XJmipqdvSfJJ8nm_p61VBKP6jxVbWg7PIVt2GBPtnpbbr3MEpNvCLu9I8SWxBM2fOCv1UOFK5Oj4yogrt59NExaf4dmsUe1x26bTNisBfaD7gSPF0NbgYut7oSQWTchMVJ1Uad2K6Vt-PNzV-8vGqQuBgQ-64VKzst93Fiy59ZP3iSEpWjtdBc8mA%3D%3D) to rein this in. The voters have spoken, and they chose me to be the Republican candidate for Senate in California. There's no time to lose. With every day that goes by, you and I are getting more and more reminders why it's so important we win this election. The reality is present-day America is starting to look a lot like 1970s America. You remember what it was like: ► Not only were gas prices sky high, Carter's rationing meant we could only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license plate numbers. Remember? ► Eleven Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village in Munich by terrorists. Remember? ► Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists in Iran. Remember?? Democrat policies had brought America to its knees. And now, as Yogi Berra used to say, "It's deja vu all over again." Joe Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don't care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and dependent. **About Jim Jordan:** Leading the fight to hold Washington accountable.

**
In Washington, Jim Jordan is focused on his oversight role, helping lead investigations into federal agencies

In Congress, Jim Jordan continued to fight for fiscal responsibility,and he offered the only balanced budget of any member of the House or Senate.

As a state legislator, he took on the powerful special interests and the leaders from both political parties who wanted to put Ohio on an unsustainable path of higher taxes and spending.

body:
Fellow Patriot,

I just won the first competitive U.S. Senate primary of 2024.

Now, as the \*\*GOP nominee for Senate in battleground Ohio\*\* , we’re unifying the party and our grassroots base to come together to flip this seat and the Senate majority along with it.

But there’s still one problem... \*\*my incumbent Democrat opponent, Sherrod Brown, raised over $1.8 million online last month\*\* – _more than ANY other vulnerable Democrat incumbent on the ballot this year!_

We’re still way behind Brown and the liberal establishment in the fundraising game, \*\*and I need your help to turn this around fast!\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=3589292.1604.1.10bb37e53fe46e217fad3f78723d3a52 )

-> ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=3589292.1605.1.133ae9c4da7674662f7286daf6171768 )<-

My first Federal Election Commission quarterly deadline as the Ohio nominee is coming up fast at the end of the week, and we only have until then to put up our strongest report ever in this race.

If we fail to hit our mark by the end of the month... our chances of ever catching up will not be strong.

I won’t ask you to spend any more time reading – _ \*\*except to say that taking back a Republican Senate majority is riding on flipping this Ohio seat\*\* _ – I’ll get right to the point:

\*\*Help me hit this first deadline goal of the general election campaign and close in on Brown’s fundraising by rushing your critical support right away!\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=3589292.1606.1.e236c8399b060d2651c53a8fb1a44b6e )

\*\*Meet Bernie Moreno:\*\*

Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18.

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board.

After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation.

Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First.

Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has.

From Alabama to Michigan; it’s all on the line
I hope this message finds you fueled by the recent tide-turning victory in Alabama, where Democrat Marilyn Lands, who, like Bob Lorinser, is a second-time candidate , clinched a decisive win in a district once dominated by Trump.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
^WATCH VIDEO [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
With your help, Bob Lorinser's two-cycle strategy in Michigan will work, too.
In just three days , we face an FEC deadline that will help determine the strength of our campaign going into the spring and summer. We need you.
RUSH A CONTRIBUTION [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Friends,
Lands's landmark victory — nearly a 33% swing from her 2022 attempt at the same seat – is not just a win; it’s a testament to what’s possible when we stand united against extremism and fight for reproductive rights.
Here in Michigan’s 1st Congressional District, we are also at a pivotal moment.
Bob Lorinser is up against an incumbent who has openly advocated for a nationwide ban on abortion, and restrictions on IVF and contraception, undermining our most personal liberties.
The stakes have never been higher. The GOP’s relentless assault on women's rights continues to threaten our liberties. This is why we’re reaching out to you today, at this critical juncture, to ask for your support as we close this quarter.
Invest in our cause. Invest in Dr. Bob. Invest in safeguarding the freedoms and values we hold dear.
Your contribution today will directly empower our campaign to fight back against regressive policies and ensure that personal medical decisions remain just that – personal.
If Alabama can do it, we will do it, too. Rep. Bergman has never faced a second-time challenger and Bob is more energized than ever to send him packing.
If you're able, please make a contribution before the quarter ends [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob] . Every donation, no matter the size, brings us closer to a future where individual rights and freedoms are protected and respected.
Onward,
Kevin

Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula
Democrat, MI01

https://karenforvirginia.com/ [https://karenforvirginia.com/] Karen Jenkins for HB-89

Friends-
We’ve sent multiple bills to Governor Youngkin’s desk this year. While these bills may be in his hands, it doesn’t mean our work is over quite yet.
We’ve petitioned legislators this year to vote for these pieces of legislation and we can petition the Governor to sign them into law. Will you use your voice to tell Governor Youngkin to sign our bills on his desk?
Our top priority bills are
*
The
Prescription
Drug
Affordability
Board
[https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+HB570]
*
Paid
Family
and
Medical
Leave
[https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+SB373]
*
Increasing
the
Minimum
Wage
[https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+HB1]
The Prescription Drug Affordability Board would lower the cost of living by lowering the cost of medicine. It would establish an independent review board to review costs of particularly burdensome medications and set limits for payments. You can email Governor Youngkin to tell him you want PDAB to be signed into law here [https://secure.everyaction.com/FOI3xWMjpkWlIJe1PJz1pQ2] .
Paid Family and Medical Leave would establish an insurance program for employers that would allow them to provide paid leave to all their employees. This would ensure no one has to choose between a critical paycheck and caring for themselves or a loved one. You can email Governor Youngkin to tell him you want Paid Family and Medical Leave signed into law here [https://secure.everyaction.com/35j9vZrfCkWv5qjw-mNdEw2] .
Increasing the Minimum Wage would ensure all Virginians are paid a livable wage that keeps up with the rate of inflation. The cost of living crisis is hitting Virginians hard and wages haven’t been keeping up. This bill will solidify Virginia as a great place to work, live, and raise a family. You can email Governor Youngkin to tell him you want the minimum wage increase signed into law here [https://secure.everyaction.com/uBnrESHIhkScwcCLvb7jYg2] .
Tell Governor Youngkin to sign these bills into law! [https://linktr.ee/freedomvaadvocacy]
Thank you for your continued advocacy
Eddie Seay

body:
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1038%2E791427%2EBJEejP)

Hey folks, it's Makenzie. Ilhan's finance director.
I'm reaching out because earlier this week, I made a seriously difficult decision during our team budget meeting, and as a supporter of this campaign, I felt that you deserved to know about it.
As we look forward to the months ahead of our primary this summer, it's become clear that in order to continue growing our progressive coalition and ensure we have the resources to take on the likes of AIPAC and the right-wing super PACs, we need to _significantly_ scale up our investments in digital organizing and advertising.
It was a significant cost, and the money wasn't in our March budget. But I gave the green light anyway.
I knew it was a risk — there's no doubt about that. But right now, as we approach this weekend's official FEC fundraising deadline, the right-wing and their Republican mega-donors are watching our every step, and we need to do _whatever it takes_ to succeed.
That's why I made a bet that if I asked, this movement would come through and help us fill the gap. And I'm really hoping you will — today. Not just for me, or for Ilhan, but for everyone who cares about continuing our progressive movement's fight for justice in Congress and beyond.
**[So please. Can you make your first contribution — of $3 or any amount you can — to stand with Ilhan and our campaign today? Every donation ahead of Sunday's FEC deadline will help fill our budget gap as we make critical investments in our campaign.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-mar24.3mFzHz&refcode=em240328-1-t1&t=2&akid=1038%2E791427%2EBJEejP)**
Like I said, this was a seriously difficult decision — one that I thought you deserved to hear about from me directly. Because of the way we fund this campaign, I spend a lot of time balancing our financial priorities and figuring out where to best spend our resources, and it's not a conclusion I came to lightly.
But one of the many things that separates Ilhan from our opponents in this race is that she knows our movement always has her back when it matters most.
Thanks for chipping in today if you can.
In solidarity,
Makenzie Richardson
Finance Director

This work is hard, and wins won’t happen overnight — but they _will_ happen. Look no further than my home state of Michigan to see how playing the long game can pay off big time.
With your support, we fought for years to reform the redistricting process in Michigan, and we won — the independent redistricting commission in place created a fairer map that is already leading to a more representative state legislature.
Here’s just one example: Under gerrymandered maps, anti-labor groups actually made Michigan (one of the most historically pro-union states in the country!) a so-called "right to work" state. **But this year, under the new, fairer maps — the legislature made Michigan the first state in SIX DECADES to scrap this anti-union law. **
I’m proud my home state shows what’s possible when we put fair maps into place — how working towards fairness has real, tangible effects on people’s lives.

body:
Kari Lake thinks the January Sixers are patriots. I think that anyone who supports those terrorists and traitors shouldn’t be allowed anywhere near the U.S. Senate.

| I won’t ever forget it, Peter.

Standing on the House floor. Hearing shouts, pounding, breaking glass. Barricading the door, teaching my colleagues how to use their gas masks. Texting my staff, telling them to hide.

I carried a rifle in Iraq, and all I had to defend myself on January 6th was a pen. But I was ready to fight.

And after that day, Trump’s loyalists crawled right back to him. Witnessing them reject what they lived through, watching them ignore the testimony of the police officers that defended us that day while they were beaten, bloodied, pepper sprayed, and cursed at... it makes me sick.

Kari Lake thinks the January Sixers are patriots who were “invited in” — she even campaigns with them.

I think anyone who supports those terrorists and traitors shouldn’t be allowed anywhere near the U.S. Senate.

This race in Arizona is just me and her. It’s on us to stop her march to more power and influence. Whoever wins in Arizona is going to determine which party holds the Senate and could even decide whether Trump takes back the White House.

I need you with me, and I need you to take this race seriously.

| | **Friend****,** **Across the Puget Sound region, juvenile violent crime is skyrocketing. Tragically, juvenile criminals are making headlines for armed robbery, gun battles, and even intentionally running over innocent pedestrians with their cars. If you 're like me, you find this violence disturbing.** **Yet, instead of acting to protect our communities, radical politicians are pushing to close the juvenile jail entirely in an initiative called Zero Youth Detention. **

**[I am leading the charge against this at the King County Council --will you stand with me?](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=9074fb533c&e=77eef70c61)** **I believe that dangerous criminals need to be behind bars for the safety of our communities, and that simply closing the jail doesn 't reform criminals. Yet, yesterday, the Law and Justice Committee heard that not only do far-left politicians want to close the jail, but they want to instead hold violent offenders in unlocked, unsecured rooms. **

**That 's right--King County wants to put murderers, rapists, and other violent criminals in unlocked homes spread throughout communities across the County, with nothing to keep them from escaping and inflicting more harm onto innocent people. [I won't stand for it, and I hope you won't either.](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=2d2c2bb5bf&e=77eef70c61)** **I am the lone King County Councilmember who is mounting an attack against these backwards policies and fighting to bring common sense to our justice system.[But I can't do it without your help. Will you donate $25, $50, $100, or $250 to my campaign to help me continue my fight?](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=c836158e39&e=77eef70c61)** **I do have some good news! The radical politicians are on track to fail in their mission to close the juvenile jail by 2025. But we can 't let up--they are now trying to close it by 2028. It's time to pay attention and get involved. ** **As a former federal prosecutor, I know that criminals need to be held accountable for their crimes or they will only commit more crimes. And it 's our children, our families, and our neighbors who stand to be victimized. We must all work together to protect our communities and demand accountability in our justice system. [Can you support me with a gift of $25, $50, $100, or $250?](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=24c62c82fb&e=77eef70c61)** **I am determined to make sure that violent criminals aren 't allowed to go free and am fighting to keep King County a good place to live, work, and raise a family. However, I need your support to do it. [Give to my re-election campaign to help me defeat the radical agenda to release violent offenders onto our streets.](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=7496cee037&e=77eef70c61)** **Thank you for your support, **
**Reagan Dunn** **www.reagandunn.com**

body:
Last Friday, a young West Michigan woman’s life was brutally cut short by an illegal immigrant who was only in this community because of multiple failures in our broken immigration system.
| | |
---
| [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001X64wEeZ4iariAf0M0rlrQYBEltNA5ej6zUbb_SI9dzIgVWskpXh3SVxtBSuCiwlBIotBkdtqi2VIabVwjaFM53STsjn8VJ0Jt5mJzBnlKiROHmWChBmAUSHNu_0DyM9WkvLW2RE7WQuFJfaz-D39-b_gXBO7acgq&c=7Ng2cw03WYhvu3LNYnq-LZaUPDRdJ5H3n4YUhOLtvHAY3r7khTE8zQ==&ch=jEuXISn_NOZ7ru-YyU-kI6BFAP8pax8Tnqc8pJ0oEQXFhZtiGyP8tA==)

|
Friend
Last Friday, a young West Michigan woman's life was brutally cut short by an illegal immigrant who was only in this community because of multiple failures in our broken immigration system.
---
| I join all my fellow citizens in honoring the victim, Ruby Garcia, and supporting and respecting her family in what must be a wrenching and nightmarish time.
I think it's important not to use tragedies like these to score political points, but rather to highlight serious policy failures so we can make immediate changes to prevent anything like this happening again.
Because make no mistake: what led to this killing was a series of breakdowns in our immigration system. The suspect was here illegally, committed a string of crimes dating back to 2017, had multiple run-ins with law enforcement, lived here in our community for years after committing those crimes, and then even after he was deported, he entered the country illegally again.

---
| [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001X64wEeZ4iariAf0M0rlrQYBEltNA5ej6zUbb_SI9dzIgVWskpXh3SVxtBSuCiwlBd6N3pZjobccw49oOflHyRoa8t88ySyPARpz-kzudIMzTodCOKBACHpdRVmRBTrcz5lovXvX8MLW8FDgyE-sSAY-usHKY8GKG&c=7Ng2cw03WYhvu3LNYnq-LZaUPDRdJ5H3n4YUhOLtvHAY3r7khTE8zQ==&ch=jEuXISn_NOZ7ru-YyU-kI6BFAP8pax8Tnqc8pJ0oEQXFhZtiGyP8tA==)
---
|
After saying nothing for days about the tragic murder of Ruby Garcia in our community, [Hillary Scholten](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001X64wEeZ4iariAf0M0rlrQYBEltNA5ej6zUbb_SI9dzIgVWskpXh3SVxtBSuCiwlBd6N3pZjobccw49oOflHyRoa8t88ySyPARpz-kzudIMzTodCOKBACHpdRVmRBTrcz5lovXvX8MLW8FDgyE-sSAY-usHKY8GKG&c=7Ng2cw03WYhvu3LNYnq-LZaUPDRdJ5H3n4YUhOLtvHAY3r7khTE8zQ==&ch=jEuXISn_NOZ7ru-YyU-kI6BFAP8pax8Tnqc8pJ0oEQXFhZtiGyP8tA==) finally broke her silence. But her only response was to blame Republicans for calling for action in response to the tragedy.
In a local television interview, she couldn't even bring herself to acknowledge that Ruby Garcia's murderer was an illegal immigrant with a lengthy arrest record, calling him instead simply 'a person who did not have authorization to be here.'
This is a disappointing and inadequate response from our representative in Congress. Serious-minded people want to identify the systemic breakdowns in our national immigration policies that have allowed violent criminals to repeatedly enter and remain in this country. That's not playing politics; that's solving problems so they don't happen again.

---
| | [HELP SECURE THE BORDER](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001X64wEeZ4iariAf0M0rlrQYBEltNA5ej6zUbb_SI9dzIgVWskpXh3SUZLu6ZlZY1E3HOY-8gGhcgMUwYKZvjAqzUkCRc2pQvu0FjXfHRqpDUs9etG0Wh2CIETtS7TZCY8CPU5wjuPt_SRyi0sb4R3xJuhkfAkzUu88dTh1EwURdkym4MDvXhADilo8gds2M4yu7_c30jVUbPqM0hWB3OAaKJzrG65vNChKXcd2DE2XbCMQ7QOCL7d68NJ_NGIi0hwduNe8_RRyljwwTmdBIR_sg==&c=7Ng2cw03WYhvu3LNYnq-LZaUPDRdJ5H3n4YUhOLtvHAY3r7khTE8zQ==&ch=jEuXISn_NOZ7ru-YyU-kI6BFAP8pax8Tnqc8pJ0oEQXFhZtiGyP8tA==)
---
|
This is more of the same from Hillary. Hillary Scholten has called for a '[freedom of movement](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001X64wEeZ4iariAf0M0rlrQYBEltNA5ej6zUbb_SI9dzIgVWskpXh3SV5xDubWhH8jm1_zDTg1uYPOty0QPkUBpaPCATBoMTSEsP2pgdBsJfpKQ3KvVAN_duQdkPcbXO7EN1hmYi-gtS9touXSwLyojAGq5DlN7BsK4SMwccfculNVsADjZNpIfPsa65KL2bgTVpkE2FSA1YKkhNIeUOPkREga9Tjxf-InmfMXvgrNcPg=&c=7Ng2cw03WYhvu3LNYnq-LZaUPDRdJ5H3n4YUhOLtvHAY3r7khTE8zQ==&ch=jEuXISn_NOZ7ru-YyU-kI6BFAP8pax8Tnqc8pJ0oEQXFhZtiGyP8tA==)' policy on our border, voted no on the Secure the Border Act, no on the Police Act, and has yet to demand that the Biden administration enforce existing immigration laws.
More than 8 in 10 Americans understand that the 9 million illegal crossings under the Biden administration are a serious problem. But self-described bipartisan immigration expert Hillary Scholten is once again blaming everyone else and taking no responsibility for her own decisions and inaction.
Now the damage is on our doorstep and [Hillary's record is on full display](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001X64wEeZ4iariAf0M0rlrQYBEltNA5ej6zUbb_SI9dzIgVWskpXh3SQDwA5rN4-dXON0v9oTsigrzcdZ4T41AYuTFmKhoSGzUdnJsTPP1mKe23G7Nz6Mn6HOLZdqhDhiutKfE4wFgs6AKcWk4WoEYha9qXNS6tKDXWDotxrQ7Hy6Gp0I7nnmUzQ==&c=7Ng2cw03WYhvu3LNYnq-LZaUPDRdJ5H3n4YUhOLtvHAY3r7khTE8zQ==&ch=jEuXISn_NOZ7ru-YyU-kI6BFAP8pax8Tnqc8pJ0oEQXFhZtiGyP8tA==).

Humbly, Paul

body:
Thank you for stepping up and being a part of this process to elect our parties leaders, I hope you will open this message and learn more about my goals as your next Republican National Committeewoman
| | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001dOWF6yc1r8lbqGzEsDN7NlU3NQ5CWSWO76DWZW-Dle3TZBWvTNrDn-Csc5u-8H43S-jHOUGEPwtcHHQnBqxvtWhYm0gCkeA8XdcziziAg5mbTMwpWe3F97Ph-jwFJ7pfUtjKyEIg6wpH9yj_85EdgdgMzv8gbVcQ&c=SCZ5z5pvFkMzLLERekyeR_QEVO5O2gcC3LUGIis3P8FE4mZ9g1xAOw==&ch=_XcFersOZRIwQKEhubeRNYnWzIEjmgWUz83V1e6LzGVFAY66qfnjng==)

---
| Friend,
In just 8 Days we will convene as a body of grassroots conservatives in Pueblo, CO, and decide the future of our party.
As we approach this critical election, I wanted to give you more information about why I am seeking your support to be the next Republican National Committeewoman.
---
| My Why,
---
| Our party has been going in the wrong direction for years. We have elected the same leaders to term after term and we have continued to see the same results.
Our current Committeewoman voted for Ronna McDaniel to be chair of our party 3 times, and we saw loss after loss during each of her terms.
Our party was very vocally opposed to re-electing the Chairwoman, yet only one member of our Colorado RNC Delegation did not vote for McDaniel's third term. That was our current Committeeman, who I am proud to be running with as part of the America First Slate, Randy B. Corporon.
The other members of our delegation stood in lock step with this failed leader, who spent $70,000 on flowers alone.
This is my why, to represent the people of Colorado the way they deserve to be represented.
Not only that, but we must focus on three critical pieces of strategy in order to win elections.
---
Step 1:
---
---
|
---
We must make the RNC Great Again!
---
By electing a new Chair and Co-Chair of the RNC we have made a good start, now we must retire the career members of the RNC who have enabled the reckless spending, and poor strategy choices that have actively taken away any resemblance of a backbone the RNC had.
Nearly a third of the RNC is America First Grassroots leaders, and we must increase those numbers. We must take the majority of the seats on the RNC to ensure that President Trump has the most favorable partnership possible at the RNC.
As the RNC merges with the Trump Campaign over the next few months, it is critical that we have the most dedicated Trump Supporters and allies of the President on the RNC.
Chairman Williams and Committeeman Corporon are great leaders for our state and I am hopeful you will place your trust in me to join them on the National Committee so that Colorado can help ensure President Trump wins the White House in 2024 and that we Make America Great Again!
---
| Step 2:
---
|
---
| |
---
| We Must Secure Our Elections!
---
| Election Integrity is many peoples number one issue, and they have every right to feel that way. After the results of the 2020 election, there were questions on whether the election was fraudulent. I am looking forward to joining the ongoing efforts at the RNC to secure our elections and will work to promote policy at the RNC that will focus on removing automated voting systems and going back to paper ballots, as well as legal ballot harvesting and vote banking operations.
We must work to ensure the RNC advocates that we require an ID to vote in all 50 states and territories and make election day a national holiday. We must restore faith in our electoral system, and I am hopeful to be part of those efforts.
---
| Step 3:
---
|
---
| |
---
| We Must Engage the Next Generation and Increase Grassroots Participation!
---
| We must increase awareness of the Republican brand to GenZ and Millennials using social media. Our messaging has been lacking for far too long. Alongside these efforts, we must partner with outside youth organizations to gain participation through events and activities across the country.
At the same time, it is important to reward the hard work and dedication of the next generation in order to keep them engaged. The RNC Youth Advisory Council is a good start but is not enough.
Let's be honest, our party has neglected the grassroots for far too long. We must educate Republicans in the caucus and assembly process to boost involvement in the party. As RNC Members we must be a conduit between party officials and the grassroots, we are the emissaries of the national party and it is time we act like it.
As a leader it is important to remember that we must empower every individual to take a stand in local politics.
---
| |
---
| Now that you know a little more about my goals as your committeewoman, I encourage you to take a look at the list of over 30 endorsements I have received from State, and National leaders in this race.
You can also read my entire platform to see where I stand on many more issues that are plaguing our party and the American People every day, as well as my bio, so you can learn more about my background and history as a party activist, mom, and former business owner.
---

clean_body: Thank you for stepping up and being a part of this process to elect our parties leaders, I hope you will open this message and learn more about my goals as your next Republican National Committeewoman | | | | == | Friend, In just 8 Days we will convene as a body of grassroots conservatives in Pueblo, CO, and decide the future of our party. As we approach this critical election, I wanted to give you more information about why I am seeking your support to be the next Republican National Committeewoman. | My Why, | Our party has been going in the wrong direction for years. We have elected the same leaders to term after term and we have continued to see the same results. Our current Committeewoman voted for Ronna McDaniel to be chair of our party 3 times, and we saw loss after loss during each of her terms. Our party was very vocally opposed to re-electing the Chairwoman, yet only one member of our Colorado RNC Delegation did not vote for McDaniel's third term. That was our current Committeeman, who I am proud to be running with as part of the America First Slate, Randy B. Corporon. The other members of our delegation stood in lock step with this failed leader, who spent $70,000 on flowers alone. This is my why, to represent the people of Colorado the way they deserve to be represented. Not only that, but we must focus on three critical pieces of strategy in order to win elections. Step 1: | We must make the RNC Great Again! By electing a new Chair and Co-Chair of the RNC we have made a good start, now we must retire the career members of the RNC who have enabled the reckless spending, and poor strategy choices that have actively taken away any resemblance of a backbone the RNC had. Nearly a third of the RNC is America First Grassroots leaders, and we must increase those numbers. We must take the majority of the seats on the RNC to ensure that President Trump has the most favorable partnership possible at the RNC. As the RNC merges with the Trump Campaign over the next few months, it is critical that we have the most dedicated Trump Supporters and allies of the President on the RNC. Chairman Williams and Committeeman Corporon are great leaders for our state and I am hopeful you will place your trust in me to join them on the National Committee so that Colorado can help ensure President Trump wins the White House in 2024 and that we Make America Great Again! | Step 2: | | | | We Must Secure Our Elections! | Election Integrity is many peoples number one issue, and they have every right to feel that way. After the results of the 2020 election, there were questions on whether the election was fraudulent. I am looking forward to joining the ongoing efforts at the RNC to secure our elections and will work to promote policy at the RNC that will focus on removing automated voting systems and going back to paper ballots, as well as legal ballot harvesting and vote banking operations. We must work to ensure the RNC advocates that we require an ID to vote in all 50 states and territories and make election day a national holiday. We must restore faith in our electoral system, and I am hopeful to be part of those efforts. | Step 3: | | | | We Must Engage the Next Generation and Increase Grassroots Participation! | We must increase awareness of the Republican brand to GenZ and Millennials using social media. Our messaging has been lacking for far too long. Alongside these efforts, we must partner with outside youth organizations to gain participation through events and activities across the country. At the same time, it is important to reward the hard work and dedication of the next generation in order to keep them engaged. The RNC Youth Advisory Council is a good start but is not enough. Let's be honest, our party has neglected the grassroots for far too long. We must educate Republicans in the caucus and assembly process to boost involvement in the party. As RNC Members we must be a conduit between party officials and the grassroots, we are the emissaries of the national party and it is time we act like it. As a leader it is important to remember that we must empower every individual to take a stand in local politics. | | | Now that you know a little more about my goals as your committeewoman, I encourage you to take a look at the list of over 30 endorsements I have received from State, and National leaders in this race. You can also read my entire platform to see where I stand on many more issues that are plaguing our party and the American People every day, as well as my bio, so you can learn more about my background and history as a party activist, mom, and former business owner. | | == | | == | | == | If you have seen enough, and wish to join us in this mission to Re-Take the RNC and lead the party in A Return to Patriotism, then I humbly ask that you pledge your support to me at the State Assembly by clicking the button or image below. Stand up for your Country, Stand up for your Party, and Stand up for the America First Conservative Values that we hold so dear! | == | | == | I again would like to thank you for your support and consideration in this race as we approach April 6th. This campaign has been a truly incredible journey for me and I hope you will join us as we cross the finish line! name: David Horowitz
subject: The plot to destroy Christian America
body:
No matter what you believe or who you worship, this is your fight.

| |
---
| | If you were a Christian that wanted to attend worship service in 2020, government officials treated you like a terrorist. If you were a criminal that assaulted innocent people, burned buildings to the ground and ransacked every business in your path, Leftists handed you the keys to the city. I'll never forget what they did - _because if they had their way, they 'd do it again._ They pretended it was about safety, but we both know that was a lie. It was about control. It was about their agenda. **And it was about their decades-in-the-making war on Christian America.** No matter what you believe or who you worship, this is your fight. You see, the radical Left is doing everything in their power to rip Christianity from our culture, because that's where our freedoms, our rights, our liberties -- the values that have defined our nation -- came from. **[**I explain this at length in _Dark Agenda: The War to Destroy Christian America_.**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a33b35ac0b114e26adee933d65420c86&_e=DkyiE54jtL17AjcGFEZvvCUie4aWpnkAroSIH1YkbGw_E--uIDZ3kLDsC5pEXZ6TFLwP8k7U-CpUWwrjAVQfWjZrvxYWZXJYY5wXyjytfLhkd9Au5W8YD6tLISYZZkxkOq6iO090u-bCya-WZgMW27Wvq1obGjPCJpWujPpkgzLXuNzdS3y2EWklRxH7lz292pEJjtKK6vJGB5qaDtAWb84yrc9_j0MNMKjl4_vNxgSnZGv3kZFgetn9cv7YV72hg5AgXR5Djm-DBhkJW8fVhFl9FGGWDO-athgWsRNJcBe0EyeNXrjfFBb6zNBVDZ-BQIzMUgCIge5OXCZmlGFtWLevRUG0T3OtIaL0Tpo4CvEDMp1bY3hb_4CRtAQJxjDuxpRFbbBdLQyfdlL9z2GB7w%3D%3D)** My name is David Horowitz, and this might surprise you, but I'm not a Christian and I never have been. This isn't about my personal beliefs, it's about right versus wrong, good versus evil, and those who want to protect America versus those who want to destroy her. _And no one knows the Left better than I do - or how their hatred for America and their hatred for Christianity go hand in hand._ I spent decades entrenched in the radical Left before I saw them for who they really were. When I was a young man, I marched side by side with the Black Panthers and edited the leading Marxist magazine. I finally saw their true nature when they murdered my friend, so I cast my vote for Ronald Reagan in 1984 and I never looked back. **_All that to say I know the reason Leftist politicians hunted down churchgoers like enemies of the state while violent criminals roamed free in 2020._** It wasn't negligence, coincidence, or incompetence. They want to tear Christianity and religion from our country because they want to replace God with government. They want you answering to the State and the State only. And they know if they can strip America's religious foundation, they can finally shred our Constitution and destroy everything that made us who we are. **But this war is far from over, and I need you on my side.** **[That's why I hope I can count on your generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to the David Horowitz Freedom Center today.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a33b35ac0b114e26adee933d65420c86&_e=DkyiE54jtL17AjcGFEZvvCUie4aWpnkAroSIH1YkbGw_E--uIDZ3kLDsC5pEXZ6TFLwP8k7U-CpUWwrjAVQfWjZrvxYWZXJYY5wXyjytfLhkd9Au5W8YD6tLISYZZkxkOq6iO090u-bCya-WZgMW27Wvq1obGjPCJpWujPpkgzLXuNzdS3y2EWklRxH7lz292pEJjtKK6vJGB5qaDtAWb84yrc9_j0MNMKjl4_vNxgSnZGv3kZFgetn9cv7YV72hZZAUUXC4VUTEu_2QMRXf95QEDnXZJNX9oA6tvDOwBPX6Cz95ngq8aw0q5dvyQV4ID5hb7mN2jz3RT3UbqIE0oQlAEPra8CR826Uuy3NlVV0XH0iJRJINM1riKqWCboxFOnFMN5GBTSaawktdsLqt1Q%3D%3D)** I founded the Freedom Center because I was determined to expose everything I'd learned about the radical Left in the hopes that I could stop them in their tracks. Since then we've published thousands of articles, pamphlets, books and profiles - and we've changed hearts, minds and outcomes. The Left attacks us time and time again because they know just how effective we are. We've been targeted by MasterCard, Discover Card, the Ways and Means Committee, and most recently the IRS. But we won't back down - no matter who comes after us. Because there is no nonprofit with a history like ours -- or more importantly, a knowledge like ours. There is no nonprofit with our expertise or understanding of the Left and its motives, or the track record we have to back it up. **[That's why I hope I can count on your generous, tax-deductible gift of $35 or more today](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a33b35ac0b114e26adee933d65420c86&_e=DkyiE54jtL17AjcGFEZvvCUie4aWpnkAroSIH1YkbGw_E--uIDZ3kLDsC5pEXZ6TFLwP8k7U-CpUWwrjAVQfWjZrvxYWZXJYY5wXyjytfLhkd9Au5W8YD6tLISYZZkxkOq6iO090u-bCya-WZgMW27Wvq1obGjPCJpWujPpkgzLXuNzdS3y2EWklRxH7lz292pEJjtKK6vJGB5qaDtAWb84yrc9_j0MNMKjl4_vNxgSnZGv3kZFgetn9cv7YV72hFHs4gWMRwH0Q33RNCAaCxf2L05DCRRIHKt3oM7VYIgo0X0bfbP2_tbjw0ZkOlzA-Shi_x0dW-UYDmFIYfFgHe8LExXg-a69gjFpf1UyYRQKRaTv73lUpBtvhVH8ny7ZGiqNDpITNWJyK27QWuVJ49A%3D%3D) - and as a thank you for your support, I'll send you a complimentary copy of _Dark Agenda: The War to Destroy Christian America._** Karl Marx said it himself: communism begins where atheism begins. Simply put, without Christianity, we have no country, and we have no future. But too many of our fellow citizens don't understand what's at stake, or exactly what we're up against. And I need your help sounding the alarm. I hope I can count on you.

subject: The FL Supreme Court is playing games with our lives.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Debbie for Florida
body:
| | |
---
Friend —
I only have a moment, but I wanted to drop you a quick note on the frustrating news we just got out of Tallahassee.
Nearly a million bipartisan Floridians signed on to put abortion rights on the ballot in Florida this November. In February, right-wing activists sued to keep it off the ballot, and the DeSantis-appointed Florida Supreme Court heard oral arguments. The deadline for them to decide is April 1, but they drop decisions on Thursdays. **Everyone expected to have a decision today, but at the last second the Florida Supreme Court made the unprecedented choice to hold the ruling until Monday, April 1.**
It’s no secret what is happening here. The ballot initiative language is clear. It’s constitutional. And an overwhelming majority of Floridians support abortion rights. **Extremists on the court are playing political games by running out the clock on a decision that WILL impact the lives of women in Florida.**
Abortion deserves to be on the ballot, and it still may be. But either way, right-wing extremists in Tallahassee KNOW that we are going to vote like hell to protect our rights and defeat every single extremist lawmaker, from Tallahassee to DC, who has tried to strip them away.
**Listen, today makes one thing completely clear: Rick Scott and his extreme allies know they’re on the wrong side of history, and the only way they will win is if they play political games and throw money at the problem. [We can’t let them. I need you in this fight with me.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81836123/463683997/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1018-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTgwMWNjNmMtMjdlZC1lZTExLWFhZjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=9QoCInOoDLe-EXMhjknrcp6qa5od-h1CVEx9rJetrMw=)**

Onwards,

Debbie

subject: Did you see this, Peter? You might get a call from me soon…

body:
Just wanted to make sure you didn’t miss it.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1120%2E62735%2ETSInkd)
Hey Peter, it’s Hill —
I wanted to quickly forward my email from Tuesday since **I’ll be calling a select few campaign donors over the next few days, and I’d love for you to be one of them.**
This is more than just a way for me to say “thank you,” Peter. This is an opportunity for me to hear directly from you — to hear your thoughts, your concerns, and your priorities as we push forward with this campaign.
**[That’s why I’d be so grateful for your support today, especially since my campaign’s end-of-quarter deadline is coming up this Sunday. Please, chip in $5 today, and you just might get a call from me in the next few days to thank you for your support!](https://act.hillharper.com/go/945?t=4&akid=1120%2E62735%2ETSInkd)**
**[DONATE $5 »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/945?t=5&akid=1120%2E62735%2ETSInkd)**
\- HH

**Begin forwarded message:**
\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Hill Harper [(info@e.hillharper.com)](https://act.hillharper.com/go/936?t=6&akid=1120%2E62735%2ETSInkd)
Date: Tuesday March 26, 2024
Subject: Hey Peter — you might get a call from me soon 📞
> Hey Peter, it’s Hill —
> I’ll cut right to the chase: I’m facing a critical end-of-month deadline this Sunday, and my team tells me we need to raise about $25,000 in online donations to hit our goal. **[It would mean the world to me if you could rush any amount right now. In fact, I’ll be calling a few donors who chip in, so you might even get a call from me in the next few days thanking you for your contribution!](https://act.hillharper.com/go/936?t=7&akid=1120%2E62735%2ETSInkd)**
> [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/936?t=8&akid=1120%2E62735%2ETSInkd)
> **[DONATE »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/936?t=9&akid=1120%2E62735%2ETSInkd)**
> Look, I’ll be honest: I’d rather be out on the campaign trail than sitting here in my office, writing this email asking for your financial support. **But the reality is that I cannot afford not to ask.**
> I’m not taking a cent of corporate PAC money, and without a groundswell of grassroots support, we’ll have a _much_ harder time taking on our establishment opponent. We’re counting on everyday folks like you to help keep our momentum going. And since we need to hit every single campaign goal from now to Election Day, the stakes here are sky-high.
> **That’s why my team is hand-selecting a few supporters for me to call once we’ve hit our goal for this month — and I’d love to give _you_ a call, Peter.**
> **[So please, will you chip in $5 or more to help us hit our end-of-quarter goal before Sunday’s deadline? We’re up against serious establishment money in this race, so every grassroots dollar is critical to our victory.](https://act.hillharper.com/go/945?t=10&akid=1120%2E62735%2ETSInkd)**
