subject: EXPLAINED: Why the U.S. military CAN be used to secure the border
body:
| | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us1.campaign-archive.com/?e=17913c7d6d&u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=ea0b9b44c9)
---
| | |
---
| | | Friends,

What is happening along the United States’ southern border with Mexico is a crisis we saw coming when Joe Biden made his open border policies crystal clear to the rest of the world.

Now we’re being invaded by military-aged illegal aliens from the Middle East, China, Latin America, and elsewhere, as tens of thousands pour over our southern border each month.

As we explain in our new [report](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=cff1dc3417&e=17913c7d6d) written by our Senior Fellow Ken Cuccinelli, a national emergency of this magnitude must grant a future President all the necessary authority needed to utilize the U.S. military to secure America’s borders from invasion by any person, group, or force.

**CRA Policy Brief:[The U.S. Military May Be Used to Secure The Border](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=aa8fb2f160&e=17913c7d6d)**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=b690239500&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| **If you think using the U.S. military to repel an invasion is self-evident, you’re not alone. **But critics of using military power to enforce the border are pointing to the Posse Comitatus Act (PCA) of 1878, which they say limits border enforcement to domestic law enforcement agencies like the border patrol.

In short, the PCA is a post-Civil War era law which sought to distinguish law enforcement responsibilities between the military and domestic agencies, stating:

_Whoever,**except in cases and under circumstances expressly authorized by the Constitution or Act of Congress** , willfully uses any part of the Army, the Navy, the Marine Corps, the Air Force, or the Space Force as a posse comitatus or otherwise to execute the laws shall be fined under this title or imprisoned not more than two years, or both._
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=b88895fb9c&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| As Ken and Adam Turner explain in our paper, the intent of the PCA was never to expressly bar the U.S. military from repulsing an invasion. Furthermore, the clause “except in cases and under circumstances expressly authorized by the Constitution or Act of Congress” provides ample justification for the president to use executive action to deploy the military to our southern border.

We at the Center for Renewing America, led by experts like Ken Cuccinelli, are proud to say **we’ve led the charge on defining this crisis as an invasion** and arguing for the policies needed to end this national emergency.

**[A gift to the Center would go a long way in helping us keep up the fight](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=5fb4593ff1&e=17913c7d6d).**

Thank you for your support.
---
|
Wade Miller
Center for Renewing America

In short, the PCA is a post-Civil War era law which sought to distinguish law enforcement responsibilities between the military and domestic agencies, stating: Whoever,except in cases and under circumstances expressly authorized by the Constitution or Act of Congress , willfully uses any part of the Army, the Navy, the Marine Corps, the Air Force, or the Space Force as a posse comitatus or otherwise to execute the laws shall be fined under this title or imprisoned not more than two years, or both. | | As Ken and Adam Turner explain in our paper, the intent of the PCA was never to expressly bar the U.S. military from repulsing an invasion. Furthermore, the clause “except in cases and under circumstances expressly authorized by the Constitution or Act of Congress” provides ample justification for the president to use executive action to deploy the military to our southern border. We at the Center for Renewing America, led by experts like Ken Cuccinelli, are proud to say we’ve led the charge on defining this crisis as an invasion and arguing for the policies needed to end this national emergency. . Thank you for your support. | Wade Miller Center for Renewing America | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Copyright © 2024 Center for Renewing America, All rights reserved. | Peter -
As one of my committed supporters, I wanted to send a quick note before the weekend and the quarterly fundraising deadline to express my gratitude for your loyalty.
I know that this year especially, you're being swamped with fundraising emails, text messages, phone calls, and other gimmicks from politicians asking you to donate to their campaigns.
It's overwhelming, and difficult to tell who is being honest, or who is just using cheap tricks. It's difficult to know who is communicating a positive, persuasive vision, and who is using dark and dire language to scare you into donating. Ultimately, it's difficult to know who you should send your hard-earned money to.
My hope is that my messages to you have been useful and substantive, and that I've explained how I use every dollar you send me to further our conservative movement.
I want to take this moment to share with you all that we've been able to accomplish TOGETHER, all thanks to your generous support.
We're able to communicate with millions of people across the country, with persuasive messaging on key issues that are driving the most heated debates in our country. I know our messaging campaigns on energy, climate change, border security, taking on the cartels, and so much more have brought more Americans to our side. That wouldn't be possible without your donation.
We're able to hold policy and political summits, attracting thousands of active - often younger - Americans from across the country to Houston for fun, informative discussions that are meant to persuade young people to join the conservative movement and be receptive to conservative ideas on key policies. I truly believe these events are ensuring the continued success of our movement for generations to come.
And, importantly, I'm able to stay in Congress and fight for the issues that matter to you. I take my legislative work seriously in Washington, passing bills to boost American energy production, reduce government spending and waste, secure our border and destroy the Mexican drug cartels. I serve on the most powerful committees in Congress - the Energy and Commerce Committee and the Intelligence Committee - and am the chairman of the Congressional Cartel Task Force. I could not continue this important work without your support.

clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | | Peter - As one of my committed supporters, I wanted to send a quick note before the weekend and the quarterly fundraising deadline to express my gratitude for your loyalty. I know that this year especially, you're being swamped with fundraising emails, text messages, phone calls, and other gimmicks from politicians asking you to donate to their campaigns. It's overwhelming, and difficult to tell who is being honest, or who is just using cheap tricks. It's difficult to know who is communicating a positive, persuasive vision, and who is using dark and dire language to scare you into donating. Ultimately, it's difficult to know who you should send your hard-earned money to. My hope is that my messages to you have been useful and substantive, and that I've explained how I use every dollar you send me to further our conservative movement. I want to take this moment to share with you all that we've been able to accomplish TOGETHER, all thanks to your generous support. We're able to communicate with millions of people across the country, with persuasive messaging on key issues that are driving the most heated debates in our country. I know our messaging campaigns on energy, climate change, border security, taking on the cartels, and so much more have brought more Americans to our side. That wouldn't be possible without your donation. We're able to hold policy and political summits, attracting thousands of active - often younger - Americans from across the country to Houston for fun, informative discussions that are meant to persuade young people to join the conservative movement and be receptive to conservative ideas on key policies. I truly believe these events are ensuring the continued success of our movement for generations to come. And, importantly, I'm able to stay in Congress and fight for the issues that matter to you. I take my legislative work seriously in Washington, passing bills to boost American energy production, reduce government spending and waste, secure our border and destroy the Mexican drug cartels. I serve on the most powerful committees in Congress - the Energy and Commerce Committee and the Intelligence Committee - and am the chairman of the Congressional Cartel Task Force. [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

As right-wing Republicans continue to attack reproductive rights and the
U.S. Supreme Court considers restricting access to the abortion pill
Mifepristone, Justice Democrats Rep. Cori Bush and the rest of the Squad
are fighting back.

Cori is calling out the GOP for limiting our freedom to decide if and when
to start a family. This week, she became the first Democratic member of
Congress to demand a repeal of the Comstock Act, an outdated 1873 ‘zombie
law’ that Republicans are trying to use to ban abortion pills and
procedures nationwide.

She also called out her Democratic primary opponent who claims to be
pro-choice while accepting campaign contributions from the AIPAC network,
which is mostly funded by the same right-wing megadonors who support
anti-abortion Republicans Josh Hawley and Donald Trump:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240328-cb.Z_3LOI&refcode=em20240328-34033&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=34033%2E1203867%2EO2OF7f ]Tweet from Cori Bush: Meet my opponent. He went from running against
Missouri’s biggest anti-abortion crusader, Josh Hawley, to now sharing the
same anti-abortion GOP donors as Josh Hawley & Donald Trump. You can’t be
FOR protecting abortion rights while taking money from anti-abortion
extremists.

Cori knows firsthand the crucial importance of being able to make
decisions about one’s own body, health, and family: in 2021, she
courageously shared her personal story of getting an abortion after she
was sexually assaulted as a teenager.

She is the only true progressive Democrat in this race for Missouri’s 1st
congressional district with a track record of fighting for reproductive
freedom and bodily autonomy.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240328-cb.Z_3LOI&refcode=em20240328-34033&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=34033%2E1203867%2EO2OF7f ]We can’t let a pro-abortion champion be replaced in Congress by someone
who takes money from the same people trying to rip away abortion rights.
Help Cori defeat her primary challenger this summer by splitting
$5 or more to her campaign and Justice Democrats now!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240328-cb.Z_3LOI&refcode=em20240328-34033&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1021&akid=34033%2E1203867%2EO2OF7f ]Contribute $5

Anything you can contribute to help re-elect Cori this year is deeply
appreciated.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81844259/463704206/227139380?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMDUxMThiOC0zM2VkLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bLPlb7lxrF0MNQdnnfC42HR9W3wb0i32eKRAbRXBvuc=&emci=2e73a705-2bed-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=f05118b8-33ed-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=43566853)

| | Hey Peter,

Let me start off by saying that I know a lot of us have felt discouraged by sensationalist polls and articles out there that make it seem like we’re in a bad position. In particular, there’s been a LOT made about how Trump’s gaining with Black voters. **Here’s the thing, though: the facts DON’T back that up.**

**How are pollsters and pundits telling us Trump could win 25% of the Black vote when only 5% of Black voters in Georgia requested a Republican primary ballot? I’m not impressed by any of that BS.**

Instead of fretting about any of these disastrously wrong polls and clear misinformation, let’s focus on the plan to WIN in November.

**First:** We’re putting together one of the finest teams that Georgia has ever seen. We’ve already put together the framework of veteran campaigners who have experience here in Georgia and in critical swing states across the country.

We’re going to energize our communities all across Georgia. We need local volunteers to do the hard work of talking with their neighbors and turning out Democrats all across the state.

**Finally:** The team that we put together is going to go door to door and talk with their neighbors, send texts, make phone calls, and get voters out to the polls in the final weeks of this election. **_That’s how we win.**_

**Don’t pay attention to any of the noise. Pay attention to what we know in our hearts and what we have seen on the ground.** [**_Georgia, we’re ready to make history YET AGAIN. So please, have our back. Pitch in right now, ahead of our critical End of Quarter FEC deadline and help us put in the hard work of keeping Georgia blue.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81844260/463704207/710125701?refcode=20240328.1_KO_3AW&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMDUxMThiOC0zM2VkLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bLPlb7lxrF0MNQdnnfC42HR9W3wb0i32eKRAbRXBvuc=)**_

Forget the noise. Forget what the orange man says. Forget what Marjorie Taylor Greene tells you. Forget what the polls and the media says. **_We know what we know – and what we know is that Georgia is ready for President Biden’s second term._**

With you behind us, we WILL win.

Kevin

Kevin Olasanoye
Executive Director
Democratic Party of Georgia

name: Adam Schiff
subject: Donald Trump attacked me on Truth Social… Again
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Defeat Republicans PAC (www
body:
|
---
Peter — The attacks from Donald Trump are non-stop.

**Trump took to Truth Social to attack me as “the most outrageously crooked politician out there.”**

Undoubtedly, I am living rent-free in Trump’s head, but it is also true that he fears my election to the Senate. He’s seen me lead his impeachment inquiry and prosecute his Senate trial. | | | We have a big campaign update to share out of New Jersey, Peter: Former New Jersey WFP State Director Sue Altman, a longtime anti-corruption organizer, former teacher, and professional basketball player, is running for Congress in New Jersey’s seventh district — **and today, her campaign was added to the DCCC’s Red to Blue program, which means this is**** _officially_****one of the most competitive House races in the country.** Why is this a big deal, Peter? Let us explain: Within days of one another, Sue’s primary opponents dropped out and endorsed her, forcing New Jersey's Democratic Establishment to coalesce behind her. And along with recent news that she’s secured backing from national Democrats, it’s a sign that the political elite that has historically sought to undermine progressive candidates like Sue — **now see our growing momentum to defeat Republican incumbents and take back the House in November.** All of these positive signs mean that and one more thing: _we need to keep our foot on the gas._ We cannot afford to slow down and lose this momentum. **Now that Sue is the presumptive Democratic nominee, with the**** _full_****backing of the Democratic Party, the GOP is going to do everything they can to tear her down in November — but our grassroots movement is ready.** [**Can you split a donation between WFP and Sue’s campaign now to help us defeat Republican incumbent Tom Kean Jr. and send a real working families champion to Congress?**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9rQ6_8dRcYyR7-EJ9P8mxfikJaOKFQcivPh_HQQrkl8I3EWGTzagBk9o586ER2zbQ0XS78-EX7mg4cFkx8W5aABrUZslcsc6siItnAODU_-x3o7gTG_L2_LY7W8b7sXppF9SQVJzT2nbp8I7nxPNb-L1D-qsY6sGbS7jbLn5ja0mgEWFzBbI568hNUGhcg8iUa3Uvj0ShI_wD_TBk9CTHu5w5RPY4IQyRWBCk-6AZMWECFZlkrw7UecEiSffchM0mi6d_Y0lFSXlAyMiufzsvEkfLtvqS7ksq2JOSL6kNOMkNPBk1s7kMCDHAq2EyP5mhM0f-Al40EZ93elBaNaqeLw/451/48vwEq5NS6yoFNusDpP4pA/h0/h001.BDjUD9LLIarcz-BV0Bh0S7UWILVi40SgVMKIwRmkfWQ) **[Contribute $10 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9rQ6_8dRcYyR7-EJ9P8mxfikJaOKFQcivPh_HQQrkl8I3EWGTzagBk9o586ER2zbQEqQxmODvA273tJx9NK_-qJkFik6wzZ70o4lLAoJghoCc0cFlTcmr-PS72gVdV87umxSq9U4rAyJUP2Fz9kAC1kbr8hD8D1fpjGHlwnlOZMSzffL5g-VXqFcPZUvwMi4TMuce3nFQuwqKxuSjKi2J1qmlsRfsT4jCsT73GldIUtvtqo8EGOzxe0mePh8GT_Yi39J-qw0VdNlaXa9bwhJoeqy-Z6km10hIIk7ku-lY3lXD0pWK55aDFbewCN9hh8BYnowxDRMNLcxqSip1f5lz2g/451/48vwEq5NS6yoFNusDpP4pA/h1/h001.035KAt9Bd3oPUdJTrJAyvOk31b0x04-BoQIwQWWBA70)** There’s a lot on the line in this race, Peter. clean_body: | | | We have a big campaign update to share out of New Jersey, Peter: Former New Jersey WFP State Director Sue Altman, a longtime anti-corruption organizer, former teacher, and professional basketball player, is running for Congress in New Jersey’s seventh district — and today, her campaign was added to the DCCC’s Red to Blue program, which means this is officiallyone of the most competitive House races in the country. Why is this a big deal, Peter? Let us explain: Within days of one another, Sue’s primary opponents dropped out and endorsed her, forcing New Jersey's Democratic Establishment to coalesce behind her. And along with recent news that she’s secured backing from national Democrats, it’s a sign that the political elite that has historically sought to undermine progressive candidates like Sue — now see our growing momentum to defeat Republican incumbents and take back the House in November. All of these positive signs mean that and one more thing: we need to keep our foot on the gas. We cannot afford to slow down and lose this momentum. Now that Sue is the presumptive Democratic nominee, with the fullbacking of the Democratic Party, the GOP is going to do everything they can to tear her down in November — but our grassroots movement is ready. There’s a lot on the line in this race, Peter. It’s one of our biggest opportunities on the entire map to flip a seat from red to blue and replace a Republican with a representative who isn't afraid to stand up for working families and take on powerful special interests. But that also means we’re going to have to work twice as hard to win. Tom Kean Jr.'s MAGA donors are going to stop at nothing to keep him in the House. He’s had their back each step of the way: refusing to condemn the January 6 insurrection, voting against codifying abortion rights on the state and federal level, earning a 100% rating from the NRA in 2020, and using his position to support some of the most radical members of the GOP. With Sue in the House, we’ll be that much closer to taking back the House from far-right extremists like him, rooting out political corruption, and delivering for the working people of this country. This race is a toss-up, but together, we can win back this critical seat, regain control of the House of Representatives, and send this anti-corruption organizer, former teacher, pro basketball player, and WFP leader to Congress. body:
| | | | | |
---
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=c95f30440d&e=0a12281e0e)
# First Campaign Video is LIVE! 🎥
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=ad0f5c8283&e=0a12281e0e)
I am excited to announce that our FIRST campaign video is officially LIVE! 🚀
🎥 It's been a labor of love, and I couldn't be prouder of the incredible team who poured their hearts and souls into making this video happen.
This video is more than just footage; it's a glimpse into my vision, values, and commitment to bringing Western Maryland’s conservative voice to D.C. and flipping Maryland’s 6th Congressional District for Republicans in the General Election this November.
Click the link below to watch and share with everyone you know! ⬇️
| [CLICK HERE TO VIEW VIDEO](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=1f80946a1e&e=0a12281e0e)
---
# Special Message from
# Speaker Newt Gingrich 🇺🇸
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=9bba127a9a&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m absolutely thrilled and deeply honored to share this very special message from Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich. His support means the world to me, and I’m grateful for his confidence in my vision and leadership. Together, we’ll continue to work tirelessly to bring Western Maryland’s conservative voice to Congress and flip this seat in November.
Thank you, Speaker Gingrich, for your endorsement and belief that we can make this happen for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District! 🇺🇸
| [CLICK HERE TO VIEW VIDEO](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=8724938a8e&e=0a12281e0e)
---
# Media Coverage 📰
Our campaign has ignited a wildfire of momentum, capturing the attention of media outlets far and wide. With each passing day, our message resonates louder, drawing in supporters and spreading our message and campaign to wider audiences.
The media frenzy surrounding this race is palpable, with various newspapers and websites covering our campaign. To delve deeper into the buzz surrounding our campaign and to stay updated on the latest developments, click below to visit our website and explore the plethora of news articles capturing our progress in our campaign for Congress here in Maryland’s 6th Congressional District! 🇺🇸
| [CLICK HERE FOR RECENT NEWS](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=6483bd2b90&e=0a12281e0e)
---
# Fundraising 🙏🏽
With absentee ballots set to be mailed out by the state of Maryland starting on or after March 30th, we are facing a tight deadline to ensure our message reaches every voter in our district. To make this happen, we must raise a minimum of $25,000 by April 15th in order to get our materials out in time.
Your contribution today will play a crucial role in funding our outreach efforts, including mailers, text messages, phone calls, and postcards. Here is what our campaign needs help with in the next 30 days to get over the finish line:
1. **Postcard Mailing:** $3,000
2. **Yard Sign Purchase:** $1,000
3. **Mailer for Absentee Voters:** $6,000
4. **Door Hangers:** $1,000
5. **Texting:** $2,000
6. **Digital Advertising:** $10,000

We understand that these are challenging times, but the future of our district and country is at stake. We need your help now more than ever. Please consider donating today to help us get through the primary election on May 14th here in Maryland.
Every dollar you contribute will bring us one step closer to ensuring a Republican victory in November for Maryland 6th, one of the most crucial races in the country that can decide our House Majority!
Please click on the link below to make your secure contribution:
[**rocaforcongress.com/donate**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=ec955a1f54&e=0a12281e0e)
The future of our Republican majority in the House of Representatives hangs in the balance. We cannot afford to lose sight of the importance of securing seats like Maryland's 6th Congressional District if we want to keep a Republican majority in the House of Representatives and continue advancing our conservative agenda. 🇺🇸
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=419724cdd0&e=0a12281e0e)
Sincerely,
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=1ea37ec823&e=0a12281e0e)
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for Congress MD-06U.S. Air Force Veteran
|
---
# More about Mariela Roca
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=03b0557362&e=0a12281e0e)
My name is Mariela Roca. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for Congress here in Maryland’s 6th Congressional District.
[**Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign’s momentum and WIN BACK Maryland’s 6th Congressional District!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=44cabb87aa&e=0a12281e0e)
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=2f8a30c821&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress because I was raised by a single mom in Puerto Rico who always showed me how hard work and determination is what makes us all live the American dream. I learned english when I was 5 years old, and from that young age always felt so proud to be an American.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=5941cdcfde&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress as a military veteran. I began my journey of service to our nation in 2005 when I joined the U.S. Air Force at the age of 20. During my military service I had the honor of serving my county abroad in the Global War on Terror, serving within the Task Force Medical and the Bagram Theater Internment Facility (BTIF) in Bagram, Afghanistan, during Operation Enduring Freedom in 2007. I know what sacrifice looks like - and this is why I love my country so much.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=e25057b02b&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for my kids, your kids, and your grandkids. Everything that I do in my life is to make the best possible future for my daughter and my son and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has offered me my entire life.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=fabf15e95b&e=0a12281e0e)
[**I’M RUNNING FOR CONGRESS BECAUSE WE HAVE A COUNTRY TO SAVE!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=9e8e818f5b&e=0a12281e0e)
Even during our most challenging moments, we are fortunate to call America our home. But it's clear that under the Biden administration, we face significant challenges, our prospects are dwindling, we are weak on the world stage, our economy is failing, and American families are being left behind every single day.
[**I’m running for Congress because America can do better with leaders that will always fight for America first. No matter what.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=eecbcab165&e=0a12281e0e)
**As a military veteran** , I intimately understand the profound significance of service and the willingness to make the ultimate sacrifice for my country. My time in the military taught me the unwavering commitment to duty, honor, and the defense of freedom. It's a bond that transcends words; a deep-seated connection with the men and women I served alongside, many of whom paid the ultimate price. I've witnessed the selflessness, courage, and dedication that define the character of those who choose to protect their nation.
**As a medical logistician** , my mission was to ensure that our dedicated warfighters had the essential tools and supplies required to save lives on the frontlines. I understood the critical nature of my role in providing our troops with the medical resources and equipment they needed to deliver immediate care in challenging and high-stress situations. I am now prepared to take the knowledge, commitment, and understanding I gained in that role with me to Congress, where I will tirelessly advocate for policies that will support our country, military and American families first. Above anything.
**As a** **mother** , I understand firsthand the deep commitment and love that comes with the responsibility of providing for one's family. In the countless roles we take on as parents - caregiver, protector, educator, and provider - we become intimately acquainted with the challenges and triumphs of family life. We witness the struggles that many families face, whether it's making ends meet, securing access to quality education, or ensuring our children have the healthcare they need. It's in these moments that we are inspired to take action, to advocate for better opportunities, and to fight for a brighter future for our families.
I know how to make our community, district, and America strong and proud because i’ve done it before.
[**And i’ll do it again as your next Congresswoman.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=8c21f29da5&e=0a12281e0e)
As your next Congresswoman for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District I will always fight for policies that will revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s out of control spending, champion school choice & parental rights, and save America’s future.
But, in order to do this, I need your support today so I can spread this message to everyone across our district and country.
[**Will you chip in today to help me win this fight for our nation’s future?**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=aedf651d54&e=0a12281e0e)
Together we WILL flip Maryland’s 6th Congressional District for Republicans and make America strong and proud again.
Sincerely,
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=44ee0540d3&e=0a12281e0e)
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for CongressMaryland’s 6th District
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=0ecc3a1761&e=0a12281e0e)
|

Everything that I do in my life is to make the best possible future for my daughter and my son and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has offered me my entire life. Even during our most challenging moments, we are fortunate to call America our home. But it's clear that under the Biden administration, we face significant challenges, our prospects are dwindling, we are weak on the world stage, our economy is failing, and American families are being left behind every single day. As a military veteran , I intimately understand the profound significance of service and the willingness to make the ultimate sacrifice for my country. My time in the military taught me the unwavering commitment to duty, honor, and the defense of freedom. It's a bond that transcends words; a deep-seated connection with the men and women I served alongside, many of whom paid the ultimate price. I've witnessed the selflessness, courage, and dedication that define the character of those who choose to protect their nation. As a medical logistician , my mission was to ensure that our dedicated warfighters had the essential tools and supplies required to save lives on the frontlines. I understood the critical nature of my role in providing our troops with the medical resources and equipment they needed to deliver immediate care in challenging and high-stress situations. I am now prepared to take the knowledge, commitment, and understanding I gained in that role with me to Congress, where I will tirelessly advocate for policies that will support our country, military and American families first. Above anything. As a mother , I understand firsthand the deep commitment and love that comes with the responsibility of providing for one's family. In the countless roles we take on as parents - caregiver, protector, educator, and provider - we become intimately acquainted with the challenges and triumphs of family life. We witness the struggles that many families face, whether it's making ends meet, securing access to quality education, or ensuring our children have the healthcare they need. It's in these moments that we are inspired to take action, to advocate for better opportunities, and to fight for a brighter future for our families. I know how to make our community, district, and America strong and proud because i’ve done it before. As your next Congresswoman for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District I will always fight for policies that will revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s out of control spending, champion school choice & parental rights, and save America’s future. But, in order to do this, I need your support today so I can spread this message to everyone across our district and country. Together we WILL flip Maryland’s 6th Congressional District for Republicans and make America strong and proud again. Sincerely, Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for CongressMaryland’s 6th District | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | | | Copyright (C) 2024 Roca for Congress. All rights reserved.

subject: DACA renewal fees are increasing — we need your help to cover the costs
body:
USCIS is increasing the cost of renewing DACA status starting in just a few days. We need support more than ever to cover the fees for DACA recipients. | | | **Peter, USCIS recently announced that the cost of renewing DACA would be increasing from $495 to $555 for online and $605 for paper renewals starting on April 1st.** Our DACA Renewal Fund, the resource we use to cover the fees of DACA recipients applying for DACA renewal, was already running low before these increases. We have a long waitlist of immigrant youth requesting financial assistance — _but we don’t have the funds to cover them all._ Now, with fees increasing in just a few days, we’ll need more support than ever to clear our waitlist and open our doors to more DACA recipients. We know that many in our community are low-income and work to support their families — these fee increases may be a real barrier to immigrant youth who desperately need protections if we aren’t able to step in and help. **Will you rush in a donation of any amount to help replenish our DACA Renewal Fund? 100% of your tax-deductible donation will go directly into the hands of DACA recipients who need to pay $555 to renew their status.** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [express donate: $10](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvkqBZ6VW_VFbtBGGVx_RZ5bJyGdSOgZPq7HO9BCX1me8ItR-dY3d0MnwE49scz4yzM-BlNY7x6yfD6fSutS7qPK1E3VPrdsLsF6Q4KpPt6Y3GOCPXrftn55_esvqV90AhC_BFyo3xyVOWkJLkSf5Fopoy0eVbX1nEyK-UhEaClf22GqFSqsGU8wfAL25l3xOwVeHpDgA2PZWkFfvKhMKrhxg3ABdsmUfTZ7Lnq6vZ5lYYI6w2S8mOZn63gSzj7p3hX2u2AHNYjBc8EeW7SiqSHbV90Zhc8yiQwz1zUseTrBwvVgYe2Y5DdVMFqQF_9_hbYmVUL6w0naDn9OOlHNSsTKYaQbtNpTfqBi7_J3ZVPYBcHGiy4yMTqJAbsUhnZsIhAgqnnRQA7b7zJWDNgKJMkXi966FCeSNrT-MSZiBhN2bFXNzu_gB2oBgIchgj1pjT1lAgFo-cK7XBltDx7evmjJGLK-7i6-bFxahtAlM4nBjNsS_U3fbn-ziDfBdrgVBY/451/6gbI4ClFSkCatCRueVnUsQ/h0/h001.l85YNobwJg60NkVocSObpSRPZKbjWttEesWPGFAxbsA)

We need support more than ever to cover the fees for DACA recipients. | | | Peter, USCIS recently announced that the cost of renewing DACA would be increasing from $495 to $555 for online and $605 for paper renewals starting on April 1st. Our DACA Renewal Fund, the resource we use to cover the fees of DACA recipients applying for DACA renewal, was already running low before these increases. We have a long waitlist of immigrant youth requesting financial assistance — but we don’t have the funds to cover them all. Now, with fees increasing in just a few days, we’ll need more support than ever to clear our waitlist and open our doors to more DACA recipients. We know that many in our community are low-income and work to support their families — these fee increases may be a real barrier to immigrant youth who desperately need protections if we aren’t able to step in and help. Will you rush in a donation of any amount to help replenish our DACA Renewal Fund? 100% of your tax-deductible donation will go directly into the hands of DACA recipients who need to pay $555 to renew their status. name: Jessica Morse
subject: The Last Woman Standing on the California Battlefield
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jessica Morse for Congress
body:
That means I'll have to do what I’ve done my entire career: out-hustle and outwork the boys.

[|
---](http://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/E81s6hiG7znZwvzCH8H4fg~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRn6E5DP0QhaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubW9yc2Vmb3Jjb25ncmVzcy5jb20vVwNzcGNCCmYEVckFZmJqebNSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAt)
| | Peter, **I am the only woman challenger in California to move forward after the March 5th primary.** In a year where reproductive freedom is unquestionably on the ballot and provides the sharpest contrast between Republicans and Democrats, the fact that I’m the only woman in California left to draw the contrast is both sobering and cements my commitment to ensuring that women have a voice in Congress.
Throughout my career, I’ve been the only woman in the room – from Baghdad to Pacific Command to the California wildfire crisis, I’ve taken jobs where most of my peers and bosses have been men. I’ve had to work twice as hard, and usually needed to deliver twice the results to be given a seat at the table. **Despite those challenges, I’ve always worked hard to do the job at hand, and have managed to build coalitions, win allies and support, allowing me to still be an effective public servant despite the obstacles.** It’s well-known that, historically, one of the largest hurdles preventing more women from serving in elected offices is not recruiting women to run for office. But this cycle, the issue wasn’t recruitment. Remarkably, there were women running in seven out of the eight “races in play.” One dropped out before the primary, and six lost their primaries, **leaving me as the last woman standing in California.**
California seats that have been held by California women will now be held by men. The California Senate seats held by women since the “Year of the Woman” in 1992, will be men, and the Congressional seats currently held by Katie Porter, Anna Eshoo, and Grace Napolitano, now have only male contenders. **It is clear that we still need to fight hard for women’s representation in Congress. If we had achieved parity over the last fifty years, we wouldn’t be in the position of having to re-litigate such a basic and fundamental right – women’s reproductive rights would have been firmly secure.**
As the last woman on the California battlefield, of course, I will do what I’ve had to do my entire career: out-hustle and outwork the boys. Our campaign has raised over $1 million for the cycle, we have over 500 active volunteers, and despite an extremely Republican turnout in the California primaries, I had the second-highest vote share of any Democratic challenger in California (and I didn’t spend any money on ads in the primary). **I even got 12,000 more votes than Donald Trump in the primary here in CA-03, which feels like a victory for all women.** You all know that national political watchers use one main metric to determine the efficacy of a campaign: fundraising. And so far, I’ve hit _every_ marker they’ve given me. **But I have a big fundraising deadline for the end of the first quarter of 2024 this Sunday, and if I’m going to be the last woman standing in California after polls close on November 5, I need your help to reach our next major benchmark.**
[**Being the last woman standing in California means this campaign is now bigger than me or you — it’s about protecting our fundamental freedoms and ensuring we’ve got strong, equitable, and effective representation in Washington. Chip in before Sunday to send me to Congress this November so we can get to work »** ](http://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/bauH-YT9NywTCtmjli79-w~~/AAUS1gA~~) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | [DONATE $10 »](http://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/gtHrcj54hVQEQVs3L_jUgg~~/AAUS1gA~~)

# FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
March 28, 2024
#
CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com

**GREATER SAN DIEGO ASSOCIATION OF REALTORS (SDAR) ENDORSES KEVIN FAULCONER FOR SAN DIEGO COUNTY SUPERVISOR**
SAN DIEGO, CA -- Former San Diego Mayor Kevin Faulconer, candidate for San Diego County Supervisor in the third district, announced the endorsement of the Greater San Diego Association of Realtors (SDAR).

The Greater San Diego Association of REALTORS® (SDAR) is the largest REALTOR association in California. Their mission is to protect private property rights and to contribute to the individual success of members in their quest to help their clients achieve the American Dream of Homeownership.

_**“The Greater SanDiego Association of REALTORS® (SDAR) is honored to have the opportunity to endorse Kevin Faulconer for the 2024 San Diego County District Three Supervisor race,” said SDAR President Spencer Lugash. “Our Association prioritizes the importance of the protection of private property rights and the assurance that our members can continue to help their clients achieve the American Dream of Home Ownership and the creation of generational wealth. As Mayor, Kevin Faulconer epitomized these values, and we believe that he will be able to bring much needed change once again to the San Diego County government that will allow for an ease on restrictive regulations that will bring increased home production.”**_
_**"I am honored to receive the endorsement of the Greater San Diego Association of REALTORS®," said Former San Diego Mayor Kevin Faulconer. "As Mayor, I worked to make it easier to built the housing supply we needed in the areas that made the most sense in order to give all San Diegans an opportunity to live the American dream – starting by having the ability to afford to own their own home. I’ll keep that same mindset as Supervisor, working to make it easier to build the housing supply we need to help future generations stay in San Diego.”**_

As Mayor of San Diego, Faulconer prioritized housing in areas that make the most sense and want smart growth. In tandem with the City Council, he worked to increase citywide housing capacity by 100,000 units by completing 16 community plan updates – more than any administration in City history. As Supervisor, he’ll bring the same approach he did when he was Mayor of San Diego, working with communities that want more housing.

For more information, please visit www.kevinfaulconer.com.

Peter, Today we need to tell you about one of the biggest risks to our elections: The Electronic Registration Information Center (ERIC). Driven by an intense partisan bias that undermines the integrity of our elections, ERIC is a threat to our entire electoral process.

**The organization claims to “improve the accuracy of voter registration rolls,” but in reality, it does the complete opposite. **

---
[**HELP FIGHT AGAINST ERIC**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=48f94419f89a4b5c9356c3fcbb96c6e6&_e=pc4TtpmRRYaaQLPsiVxz3M6GUxrvhvUUlM5C8E7vIS1_n9wI6FB8HLFhkE7achicsAAqnwp4zY4x8QjrSB7xRiXey0qFZ51Ms7zbAukOcUpWV5LaZ82aWgBqLz1qITdAxqoWXYAwnvbLsx0PQn4A0zPSyTAIzZrwLBDP_ZCk7ZbUm0zA7jj1F1p6VDJ41CrIum8nBfa23IV6FY82OFVBbuuY-0jf5dteRwTgLqFqb4mGPuqFyshSLGkctjuRrWHqiAwFJKPalPwoLQHKo7OIsv6-dvFKsxZIDqaK_EcCm_VIX-AYIdrgxeXPDuWew3T2WQ-z10-DtnEPumkjmzJgA2KqHcGR9J5Qzc05tqP9EGCB8cvEfzRHgcGjA27hLxjg6V9aOuwf2oLMVMU8fdJg7EjCVTibD-itti02qnmwIYA%3D)
---
Voter rolls were **NEVER** designed to be maintained by some shadowy partisan effort hidden behind closed doors. They are and always have been designed for us, The People, to monitor - as explicitly outlined in the Motor Voter Act. **Here's why ERIC's agenda is so concerning:**
1. **Lack of Transparency:** ERIC operates behind closed doors, shielded from public scrutiny. This opacity raises serious doubts about the organization's intentions and impact on our electoral process.
2. **Privacy Concerns:** ERIC's data-sharing practices compromise the privacy of voters by indiscriminately collecting and disseminating sensitive information across state lines.
3. **Partisan Bias:** ERIC's methods for "cleaning" voter rolls are riddled with partisan bias, resulting in the purging of legitimate voters from registration lists. This systematic disenfranchisement undermines the fundamental principles of democracy.

**ERIC is already active in several states, with others at risk of joining its ranks. Peter, we cannot allow ERIC to continue its unopposed assault on election integrity.** The good news is that Voter Reference Foundation has been closely following ERIC - and we have _successfully_ fought against it....

This decision is a step in the right direction, _but it's just one battle in a much larger war._

Our efforts to keep our election system out of ERIC's grip have been tireless, and while we've made strides, there's still so much work to be done. ERIC continues to pose a grave threat to election integrity, and the fight against it is far from over.

clean_body: ERIC claims to “improve the accuracy of voter registration rolls”, but in reality, it does the complete opposite. | | | Peter, Today we need to tell you about one of the biggest risks to our elections: The Electronic Registration Information Center (ERIC). Driven by an intense partisan bias that undermines the integrity of our elections, ERIC is a threat to our entire electoral process. The organization claims to “improve the accuracy of voter registration rolls,” but in reality, it does the complete opposite. Voter rolls were NEVER designed to be maintained by some shadowy partisan effort hidden behind closed doors. They are and always have been designed for us, The People, to monitor - as explicitly outlined in the Motor Voter Act. Here's why ERIC's agenda is so concerning: 1. Lack of Transparency: ERIC operates behind closed doors, shielded from public scrutiny. This opacity raises serious doubts about the organization's intentions and impact on our electoral process. 2. Privacy Concerns: ERIC's data-sharing practices compromise the privacy of voters by indiscriminately collecting and disseminating sensitive information across state lines. 3. Partisan Bias: ERIC's methods for "cleaning" voter rolls are riddled with partisan bias, resulting in the purging of legitimate voters from registration lists. This systematic disenfranchisement undermines the fundamental principles of democracy. ERIC is already active in several states, with others at risk of joining its ranks. Peter, we cannot allow ERIC to continue its unopposed assault on election integrity. The good news is that Voter Reference Foundation has been closely following ERIC - and we have successfully fought against it.... | | In Virginia, we recently scored a significant victory as Governor Glenn Youngkin vetoed a Democrat-pushed bill (SB 606) aimed at forcing the commonwealth back into ERIC. This decision is a step in the right direction, but it's just one battle in a much larger war. Our efforts to keep our election system out of ERIC's grip have been tireless, and while we've made strides, there's still so much work to be done. ERIC continues to pose a grave threat to election integrity, and the fight against it is far from over. But, with your support, we can continue our advocacy efforts, push back against ERIC's influence, and defend the integrity of our elections nationwide. Will you join us in this critical fight? body:
On April 8th we are having a big guest come to PA's 8th Congressional District | | | | |
---
Hi Friends,
**As a reminder, tonight’s fundraiser at the Westmoreland Club has been re-scheduled to Monday, April 8th in lieu of Majority Leader Steve Scalise headlining the event.**
Leader Scalise is the representative of Louisiana’s 1st Congressional District who upholds the Constitution and advocates for the principles of fiscal discipline, lower taxes, strong border security, freedom, and conservative values. In 2017, while practicing for the Congressional baseball game, he was critically wounded but fought back and inspired the nation with his resilience and optimism. He has taken that fighting spirit to his battle with multiple myeloma and just recently completed a successful stem cell treatment.
We are honored to have him visit the 8th Congressional District and speak on the importance of this region to keeping our republican majority in the US House.
As a result, we will be **moving** our Luzerne County Fundraiser that was previously scheduled for March 28th to this date.
Below contains all the information on the _VIP Reception with Leader Steve Scalise_ as well as the General Reception. **Please**[**RSVP**](mailto:events@robforpa.com?subject=I%20would%20like%20to%20attend%20Rob's%20fundraiser%20on%20April%208th%20with%20Leader%20Scalise!%20&body=Count%20me%20in%20for%20a%20donation%20of%20%24%20%20!)**by April 3rd** to reserve your attendance to this exciting event. We look forward to seeing you there.

| Dear Peter,
I am Sheryl Emord, wife of Jonathan Emord. Jonathan is a [candidate for the U.S. Senate](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001b3-eg5qdEUkdEyBEa7EZ1a-zX-C9KpXxxMTUe6JoEdEq9KAzW_XYl4rtWzY41sce8Ry7feCATEBz6e5jR1CP1mwH2e9qw7OgrAuobEhOJHQXfFuENJoGNAAkxlmg8LV_ddGlUVRUcFIQfogI-6wiQEHC4csWE_MgKbSe4GATtHUZxFlTP3V9hX4odBwSAjHc_UVWflMDuQnJAb0983Bcfg==&c=leEHiOoqm0mN8-w-RB1zWLw7qjOeWkHYk35uNDCfjxhqdQ4TNv9QlA==&ch=FyH_YyrJlOg1VqLV7woepoRw1O7Kds4f2hjGz_Ukj8nn5qoYku6emQ==) against Tim Kaine. He is a constitutional litigator who has battled the federal government and defeated it in the so-called impossible-to-win cases over the last 38 years. He defeated the FDA more times on constitutional grounds, 8 times, than any other attorney in American history. For that, they have referred to him as the "FDA Dragon Slayer." [Coast-to-Coast AM's](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001b3-eg5qdEUkdEyBEa7EZ1a-zX-C9KpXxxMTUe6JoEdEq9KAzW_XYl1bJESrUC7DwUh3Fds6Gq17lYr5hl6gMr1M3eR-Fe_hmEjRhNJoi7qFUvG06xW9dRos9a4Y45bl5tghInB2JvANd3jh6g8xzhaLnIbQ-2hTkMA8E2qHmCmZK8Ub_r21KhpP7uLwl0E4rKfUL2Te8n45ok0FKffjOEtN_r1mGU0t-lC-ELE5ugCSujX9DDyKVLbRh6AvvnAZ7&c=leEHiOoqm0mN8-w-RB1zWLw7qjOeWkHYk35uNDCfjxhqdQ4TNv9QlA==&ch=FyH_YyrJlOg1VqLV7woepoRw1O7Kds4f2hjGz_Ukj8nn5qoYku6emQ==)[ ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001b3-eg5qdEUkdEyBEa7EZ1a-zX-C9KpXxxMTUe6JoEdEq9KAzW_XYl1bJESrUC7DwUh3Fds6Gq17lYr5hl6gMr1M3eR-Fe_hmEjRhNJoi7qFUvG06xW9dRos9a4Y45bl5tghInB2JvANd3jh6g8xzhaLnIbQ-2hTkMA8E2qHmCmZK8Ub_r21KhpP7uLwl0E4rKfUL2Te8n45ok0FKffjOEtN_r1mGU0t-lC-ELE5ugCSujX9DDyKVLbRh6AvvnAZ7&c=leEHiOoqm0mN8-w-RB1zWLw7qjOeWkHYk35uNDCfjxhqdQ4TNv9QlA==&ch=FyH_YyrJlOg1VqLV7woepoRw1O7Kds4f2hjGz_Ukj8nn5qoYku6emQ==)[George Noory](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001b3-eg5qdEUkdEyBEa7EZ1a-zX-C9KpXxxMTUe6JoEdEq9KAzW_XYl1bJESrUC7DwUh3Fds6Gq17lYr5hl6gMr1M3eR-Fe_hmEjRhNJoi7qFUvG06xW9dRos9a4Y45bl5tghInB2JvANd3jh6g8xzhaLnIbQ-2hTkMA8E2qHmCmZK8Ub_r21KhpP7uLwl0E4rKfUL2Te8n45ok0FKffjOEtN_r1mGU0t-lC-ELE5ugCSujX9DDyKVLbRh6AvvnAZ7&c=leEHiOoqm0mN8-w-RB1zWLw7qjOeWkHYk35uNDCfjxhqdQ4TNv9QlA==&ch=FyH_YyrJlOg1VqLV7woepoRw1O7Kds4f2hjGz_Ukj8nn5qoYku6emQ==) calls Jonathan a "knight in shining armor" who "protects our rights." I view him that way too. He has an incredibly unique combination of brilliance, eloquence, debating skill, courage and patriotism that propels him to victory over and over again.
I want you to know Jonathan. He is a highly-skilled and accomplished litigator who has defeated the bureaucracy repeatedly, doing so against the best attorneys the Justice Department has to offer and against all odds. Super Tuesday is over | | | | |
---
Dear Peter,
Now that the March Super Tuesday primary election is over, I am embarking on a general election campaign for re-election to the U.S. House of Representatives representing San Mateo and San Francisco Counties.
I am proud to stand with President Biden and House Democrats in fighting for our democracy, our climate, and creating an economy that works for everyone, while my opponent is a Republican who would stand with Donald Trump and extreme MAGA forces which have taken over the Republican Party.
[**Will you support me today by making a contribution to my re-election?**](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=37097c3735&e=292fde286a)
I have made fighting for our Democracy and protecting voting rights a top priority during my first term in Congress. I am proud to be a leader on the Task Force on Strengthening Democracy. We are working to protect elections from voter suppression, partisan sabotage, gerrymandering, and dark money. This work builds upon my previous work along with others in the State Assembly to establish universal vote-by-mail in California, and combat dark money in our state elections with passage of the California DISCLOSE Act which I authored.
**Now more than ever, our Democracy needs ardent defenders.** I have a fundraising deadline on March 31st and need your help. [**Please donate today to support my re-election.**](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=8a5417d113&e=292fde286a)
Sincerely,
Kevin MullinCongressman, Congressional District 15

| | | Friend,

I can't explain how grateful I am that you chose to read this email. Only about 30-40% of folks open these messages, and look I get it - there are a lot of political emails being sent these days.

Unfortunately, I rely on emails, texts, mail, and phone calls to stay in touch with conservatives like you.

**With that being said, could you do me the simple favor of just reading this all the way through to the end?** If you get to the end and still don't think you have the power to make a difference, then I just want to thank you for your time.

While roughly 35% of supporters open these messages, only an average of 1% of supporters will step up to donate, which makes it difficult since I rely on Americans like you receiving this message to hit my fundraising goals.

I refuse to rely on billionaires and Wall Street executives for money. I want our conservative values fueled by the people who believe in them most - you and me.

**And you know what?** If everyone who opened this email gave just $1 - __one single dollar__ - we'd be able to hit all of our goals.

subject: Why I’m running for Senate
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CURTIS BASHAW FOR US SENATE, INC
body:
I’m proudly running for the United States Senate because I believe more government equals less freedom. | [](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=29bb750ce29245f9a2b8dfb48182fdb8&_e=GbkD3qmUka53oLgRgnr8aFHZtdd4mUxN8cphES1vFWuD5YWUM2cmuX-aPvBAU-E7rMUz37Z7yBeeOjpLDN0gQuQhpsw4sM3iAU46Oo1Dp9qOGPfWfqkcErgpUdXVoCLcr_rRX5A2YyfQaajHpXcayM7FIUqmrLhZhsT-IPM2O6e7MZhvYYdQh8zTuNSiW-4M-HfUcIMPRiashIlLpcFZzLkZ_cxl_ET23k-D8EJfeEsdAAKZZOMQrCQ3Ek2SqthS0y0HX7ii6SjEtNsG11qrM_PKyuO64yvpYqhkOYx0m-HJd8fLRjlQIgbj-VizrcOGOAUCfI0oROkUzv0qsdh0iuPErdDNK5rVe9uBZOg_iB4uCeVPPKWPU0pTrkMgYfFacdUVBHeti5NWuTN4ZcC9casCL2ai_z33QxlGs9zjUzE%3D)
---
Fellow American, my name is Curtis Bashaw.

I’m a lifelong New Jersey resident. In high school, I started working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. And I’ve been working nonstop since then.

I started a business and I’m a proud job creator, employing more than 1,000 hard-working people. It’s never been easy, but it’s always been worth it.

As an entrepreneur, I have the responsibility of making a payroll every two weeks and know that people’s car payments, rent, and mortgages depend on me effectively doing my job. And I’ve been successfully doing that for 35 years.

But the pandemic changed our business and our American way of life, Fellow American. Working in the tourism and hospitality industry, I saw firsthand how quickly the government can take away our freedoms - our livelihoods.

The entire industry was shut down. We lost most of our income and there was no end in sight. Hundreds of small businesses and families stood on the brink of financial disaster. When the business community and government leaders in the county wrote a plan and demanded the Governor to let us reopen, _**we were ignored.**_

**As a business owner and a product of the American dream, I’m a lifelong Republican.** [**But now I’ve decided to stand up and do something about it. I’m proudly running for the United States Senate because I believe more government equals less freedom.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=29bb750ce29245f9a2b8dfb48182fdb8&_e=GbkD3qmUka53oLgRgnr8aFHZtdd4mUxN8cphES1vFWuD5YWUM2cmuX-aPvBAU-E7rMUz37Z7yBeeOjpLDN0gQuQhpsw4sM3iAU46Oo1Dp9qOGPfWfqkcErgpUdXVoCLcr_rRX5A2YyfQaajHpXcayM7FIUqmrLhZhsT-IPM2O6e7MZhvYYdQh8zTuNSiW-4M-HfUcIMPRiashIlLpcFZzLkZ_cxl_ET23k-D8EJfeEsdAAKZZOMQrCQ3Ek2SqthSa5jBIeV99q_hBs0NzdKv66EKqWO-FJIDP7jwik1m_dWyBv1jC7T84yaX83o5H3Mk5OYourTTWRoY9kz2HheWkExODPwsRpLvzm7_9jw9fArY_WZ_5OpiufFO5ffFxIikoBhQpCf6KzQCi3oTELAmRXXGMK40zG_nu5_xhx-d-IA%3D)

[**I believe we can’t keep sending the same corrupt politicians to Washington and expecting different results. I believe New Jersey and Americans deserve better than the political machine that has ruled for far too long.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=29bb750ce29245f9a2b8dfb48182fdb8&_e=GbkD3qmUka53oLgRgnr8aFHZtdd4mUxN8cphES1vFWuD5YWUM2cmuX-aPvBAU-E7rMUz37Z7yBeeOjpLDN0gQuQhpsw4sM3iAU46Oo1Dp9qOGPfWfqkcErgpUdXVoCLcr_rRX5A2YyfQaajHpXcayM7FIUqmrLhZhsT-IPM2O6e7MZhvYYdQh8zTuNSiW-4M-HfUcIMPRiashIlLpcFZzLkZ_cxl_ET23k-D8EJfeEsdAAKZZOMQrCQ3Ek2SqthSXpB2Mf0kG-4yRlVixk_MLRv87P4C1agthlqBfWwokHc_Oyq9osknYvKHdMd1toAOcBRQgsiRj2tMBvLx6LdLchsS-tztzbwXUdjfB01mdKYFxyh6dKdqQkL_Guud_l6w8HWRhAQIYmDCY5hE_1ZPN91h2QayMkDEeqEgpoLpTD0%3D)

[** ****SEND CURTIS BASHAW TO WASHINGTON » **](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=29bb750ce29245f9a2b8dfb48182fdb8&_e=GbkD3qmUka53oLgRgnr8aFHZtdd4mUxN8cphES1vFWuD5YWUM2cmuX-aPvBAU-E7rMUz37Z7yBeeOjpLDN0gQuQhpsw4sM3iAU46Oo1Dp9qOGPfWfqkcErgpUdXVoCLcr_rRX5A2YyfQaajHpXcayM7FIUqmrLhZhsT-IPM2O6e7MZhvYYdQh8zTuNSiW-4M-HfUcIMPRiashIlLpcFZzLkZ_cxl_ET23k-D8EJfeEsdAAKZZOMQrCQ3Ek2SqthSSbLNGKqBzFHlite2_moCf6f1nC_dasmAyvADlimodDiAFLxXLX8wlf1GJwhOg0bxZkaWYwUwZ0xCyMoR9_Xt_GVWfl41NQ9KHBQetsYOe0sTNhHmUTIOfqEDjmuH8iZI66h-BONGqzbUL4dBYd7HZwuIKUVMhuTnJdxe-ROv1sU%3D)

Fellow American, like you, I’m fed up with Washington's dysfunction. [**I’m a political outsider on a mission to fix it.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=29bb750ce29245f9a2b8dfb48182fdb8&_e=GbkD3qmUka53oLgRgnr8aFHZtdd4mUxN8cphES1vFWuD5YWUM2cmuX-aPvBAU-E7rMUz37Z7yBeeOjpLDN0gQuQhpsw4sM3iAU46Oo1Dp9qOGPfWfqkcErgpUdXVoCLcr_rRX5A2YyfQaajHpXcayM7FIUqmrLhZhsT-IPM2O6e7MZhvYYdQh8zTuNSiW-4M-HfUcIMPRiashIlLpcFZzLkZ_cxl_ET23k-D8EJfeEsdAAKZZOMQrCQ3Ek2SqthSDrqa9-V6c4dI9-7FUPQGjDK3CGzRKNbOMgDWlYOW8kbcsbethZIPshU4cf8T2yw9nvn5Mml_ESwNeVPtnqCNgE1lsmmKddPid3FTUIOU10AYi-0Pl9DZO9aXZmwufEqL7v1O3Aw3ATb1308kcawcLkd3pz_OHdjvjMF6BZL7YOc%3D)

America is the land of opportunity, and that starts with a strong economy. The best social program is a job.

Yet too many families are struggling to pay their mortgages, buy groceries, and put gas in their cars. In New Jersey, we pay the highest taxes in the nation yet receive only 75 cents back on the dollar from the federal government.

clean_body: I’m proudly running for the United States Senate because I believe more government equals less freedom. | Fellow American, my name is Curtis Bashaw. I’m a lifelong New Jersey resident. In high school, I started working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. And I’ve been working nonstop since then. I started a business and I’m a proud job creator, employing more than 1,000 hard-working people. It’s never been easy, but it’s always been worth it. As an entrepreneur, I have the responsibility of making a payroll every two weeks and know that people’s car payments, rent, and mortgages depend on me effectively doing my job. And I’ve been successfully doing that for 35 years. But the pandemic changed our business and our American way of life, Fellow American. Working in the tourism and hospitality industry, I saw firsthand how quickly the government can take away our freedoms - our livelihoods. The entire industry was shut down. We lost most of our income and there was no end in sight. Hundreds of small businesses and families stood on the brink of financial disaster. When the business community and government leaders in the county wrote a plan and demanded the Governor to let us reopen, we were ignored. As a business owner and a product of the American dream, I’m a lifelong Republican. Fellow American, like you, I’m fed up with Washington's dysfunction. America is the land of opportunity, and that starts with a strong economy. The best social program is a job. Yet too many families are struggling to pay their mortgages, buy groceries, and put gas in their cars. In New Jersey, we pay the highest taxes in the nation yet receive only 75 cents back on the dollar from the federal government. **Our primary ballot is officially finalized! Now comes the hard part...** Peter, going up against Republican-funded dark money PACs isn't _easy_. Running a grassroots, people-funded campaign isn’t easy. Asking for money isn’t easy. But you know what is easy? **Being home in St. Louis.** Getting out in my community. Meeting with residents and delivering for my district. Growing up as a young Black girl in St. Louis, the daughter of a former union meatcutter, having been an unhoused, single mother of two, and a survivor of domestic abuse and sexual assault, I know the struggles of those in my community. Their struggles have been my struggles, and it’s what fortifies me in this work. **Since taking office in 2021, I’ve seen the power our movement holds.** When we come together, we’re a force of nature. We can take on the establishment, we can bring billions of dollars home to our district, and we can push our **pro-peace, pro-humanity** movement into the national _and_ international spotlight. But to keep up this work, I need your help ensuring that my campaign has the resources to defeat far-right billionaires in the primary and all the way to November. In fact, one of my opponents is quietly taking donations from the same GOP donors who gave to Josh Hawley and Donald Trump’s campaigns. [**Will you help build up the momentum for my reelection campaign by donating before my end-of-quarter deadline on Sunday?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqu2opHxbrdLylj8Xz4KZ1hRY9Bj1CaqijIXCDlo6e7EAf0lf_r1TBiw4ukt5nLDpYnJgTLJbcQR9IBfyJa6Q58IoNDJXqo9DGFrNtwXmifoNClP11oLFWOP4KCXkvLjjSkrf5Bq2MtqPnlsYNE45Tt0K22ezLBpHhcvU-6JNVzVSktOP1nFuQUeN04qeXy2VAdJAx3VufZ2_3iykOhqnY8mKTXv5bS_xG0h6K-cirp-qjnOjhtDKxeopu1kpB9QURQLOZLAJ_JJEHblS8MwNt5k-d66u1ixDzZIgmovzD2YVoDr5s3ga8KUAzsXTpIRi7_0N6-BOnnGZ_ymvV4u1KhG3yfqFCUbDisGBMPXUzbQag/451/vX0QCZJUSn6xnNMABu4Xyg/h1/h001.xYbezom6AZaNyXhB7g3pkKvYIyckeXe0mN67vQGWH9E)

**You know exactly where I stand on the issues that matter most, Peter:** dismantling white supremacy, pushing for a lasting ceasefire in Gaza, safely releasing all hostages and people arbitrarily detained, making sure everyone has a roof over their heads and food on the table, bringing home much-needed investments, supporting public education, and advancing legislation for racial, health, and environmental justice. Hey there. Lily Tomlin here. Jane and I aren’t just co-stars on TV. We've been partners in crime for decades _(literally: I was arrested with Jane at her Fire Drill Fridays protest in 2019)._ And guess what? I’d do it again 100 times over, because the climate crisis is the fight of our lifetimes, and I won’t sit on the sidelines while greedy corporations and fossil fuel giants drive our planet to the brink of disaster. **[And I hope you won’t either. Don’t worry... you don’t need to join us in jail to make an impact. Instead, chip in to the Jane Fonda Climate PAC before their end-of-quarter deadline to join Jane and me in the fight to elect climate champions!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81862496/463746156/1889669143?refcode=ea.eb9202b1-4ded-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ms=ea.eb9202b1-4ded-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImViOTIwMmIxLTRkZWQtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=cRKKo_2RmVidqx45SbuUrSlkvGDYjhfLNSQ31cO88bs=)** I got to hear from some of Jane PAC’s endorsed candidates this cycle during last month's Grace and Frankie Live Reunion, and I knew I had to help them in any way I could. I’m coming to you not as an actor or a comedian, but as someone who believes in the importance of supporting leaders who will put our planet's health over everything else. It's about championing those who dare to challenge the fossil fuel industry and who dream of a sustainable future just as much as we do. **[With each donation, you empower the Jane Fonda Climate PAC to champion the election of true climate leaders, pivotal in its effort to combat the climate crisis. | | _Dear Reader,_ _It's no secret that the mainstream press is failing the American people dismally. And yet, I'm optimistic about the future. Americans are waking up, and the movement to save American journalism is gathering speed._ _It is the honor of my life to help lead the charge by returning the famed New York Sun to the center of the national conversation. Below is a note I just shared with my fellow citizens on the recent anniversary of our return to publication. I hope you'll take a moment to read it and consider joining our fast growing movement._ _We need you. We need every patriot to stand with us._ *** As we mark this year the second anniversary of The New York Sun's return to national daily publishing, reports on our industry are dire. Layoffs are everywhere. Last month, Los Angeles Times fired 20 percent of its newsroom. The Wall Street Journal reduced the staff of its Washington bureau. NBC News, ABC News, Time magazine, Sports Illustrated, National Geographic, Insider, NPR, Vox, Conde Nast, and CBC all announced layoffs. Buzzfeed News, Pitchfork, and the Messenger shuttered their doors completely. A Northwestern University study released in November finds that nationally, newspapers are closing down at a rate of 2.5 a week, mostly weekly publications issued locally. Questions swirl about the future of the industry. One headline in the Atlantic asks, "Is American Journalism Headed Toward an Extinction-Level Event?" Predictions are dire. Uncertainty is rampant. | | It would be a mistake, though, to ignore the fact that human nature is a constant. The uniform desire - nay, need - to be informed has obtained since the birth of civilization. “The newspaper is an article of primary necessity," the Sun's pioneering 19th century editor, Charles Dana, once said. "You must have your breakfast, but you must have your newspaper too." Indeed, news consumption on the whole remains high. It seems, then, that what appears as a contraction is in fact a form of correction. The market is offering a vigorous reminder of its most enduring truth, that a newspaper's primary customer is its reader. It's a principle that in many quarters has faded over time, more so amid the industry upheaval that has in recent decades accompanied the digital revolution. This and other factors have led to a realignment of priorities at many of our country's most storied publishers. They have come to serve other masters. First among them are advertisers. The temptation is understandable. They've long paid the newsman's bills. The Sun, we must confess, played a role in introducing this model. As the first penny daily, it sold for a fraction of the price of competitor papers. It pioneered front-page advertising to offset the lower subscription price. Later, Charles Dana was described as being "barely tolerant" of advertisers and dreamed of a newspaper that was wholly supported by readers.Other papers have come to prioritize the politics, leading to a deliberate effort to downplay important stories of public interest. There have been newspapers acquired as status symbols by billionaires and deployed as ideological playthings. Others have been designed or repurposed as government organs. The Telegraph in Britain, a fine newspaper, is now at risk of being swallowed up by the United Arab Emirates. There are even calls for government funding of newspapers and journalism en masse, a terrible idea, and fully incompatible with the democratic vision of a free press. At the Sun, we hold the view that the opportunity remains greater than ever for any newspaper that is compiled with a view to serve the reader above all. In the words of Charles Dana, a newspaper "must correspond to the wants of the people. It must furnish that sort of information which the people demand, or else it can never be successful." Our aim is for every interaction with the Sun to inform, educate, inspire, and uplift our readers. To do battle on their behalf to protect the "social freedom" that our republic is in danger of entirely losing. So that "every intellectual plant grows vigorously and bears its fruit without hindrance from any quarter." We’ve been encouraged by the public reception so far. I'm pleased to report that our readership has grown by more than 300 percent over the past year. Paying memberships, sustaining the Sun's journalism, have grown by 500 percent. We've added new, exciting talent to our newsroom. Daily we hear from young people who are hopeful about making a career of journalism. We're not guided by the subjective and parochial analysis of what might be decreed "fit to print." We're a paper that for nearly 200 years has borne the promise to "shine for all." That means relentlessly seeking the benefit and welfare of our readers and all of the public which we serve. Nothing less will do for the Sun. So may I take this occasion to express, on behalf of my colleagues as well as myself, my sincerest thanks to each of you who have joined us over the past year. And to declare that our arms are held open to all Americans who have yet to make the Sun their home.

Peter, my name is Curtis Bashaw.

I’m a lifelong New Jersey resident. In high school, I started working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. And I’ve been working nonstop since then.

I started a business and I’m a proud job creator, employing more than 1,000 hard-working people. It’s never been easy, but it’s always been worth it.

As an entrepreneur, I have the responsibility of making a payroll every two weeks and know that people’s car payments, rent, and mortgages depend on me effectively doing my job. And I’ve been successfully doing that for 35 years.

But the pandemic changed our business and our American way of life, Peter. Working in the tourism and hospitality industry, I saw firsthand how quickly the government can take away our freedoms - our livelihoods.

The entire industry was shut down. We lost most of our income and there was no end in sight. Hundreds of small businesses and families stood on the brink of financial disaster. When the business community and government leaders in the county wrote a plan and demanded the Governor to let us reopen, _**we were ignored.**_

**As a business owner and a product of the American dream, I’m a lifelong Republican.** [**But now I’ve decided to stand up and do something about it. I’m proudly running for the United States Senate because I believe more government equals less freedom.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=99922e8b939749fcb50dc890a6098eec&_e=glbsfOdiV0c5wsL48O48w4hEgdsDAtOLma-Tq_lslnwtouzqwNePBWfBCfNGkHnUs6ETflDz4nIt3nPSAOo4qW3fIuOd8Bq_c5pgKPecBMc2R4OWq_AjlD_3ccEiVNftM2B2oMEf61Wk4GH9dNOFXNn6vU3hc6b0VTaTrHKDcn93OgkcJMBd7cvUPOmvsZqFKL63vKXliHSzVtVPwC9vv9aWRfzmmsyNE-DYZed5Ipc41rbk5wIk0xdvk0AFBzQaZAXPOnWfyAY6TDqaN68GV2ZY5ANEpLKJbheq2Yrw12n_dEJuyNbF4P9huz_Rj0B73vScID3DkIYTAOIn9yI-Ijr2yxMJ_hFuQUeaqmcTWvsLtvFmUt4R_lhOWk5uCiinZ5Ek14vXc43nGPt_WRXPMv_Oc3CDLG5vsiLxqFW4UNk%3D)

America is the land of opportunity, and that starts with a strong economy. The best social program is a job.

Yet too many families are struggling to pay their mortgages, buy groceries, and put gas in their cars. In New Jersey, we pay the highest taxes in the nation yet receive only 75 cents back on the dollar from the federal government.

Our families cannot afford to elect another selfish, so-called _"leader"_ who cares more about their own political ambitions than coming up with sensible solutions that actually help law-abiding American citizens. **_We deserve better than this._**

I am running for the United States Senate because I believe we need to restore freedom, security, and opportunity for all Americans. I am running to restore the American dream. | **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He’s running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May’s season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore’s most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis’ company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island’s East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

clean_body: I believe we can’t keep sending the same corrupt politicians to Washington and expecting different results. I believe New Jersey and Americans deserve better than the political machine that has ruled for far too long. | Peter, my name is Curtis Bashaw. I’m a lifelong New Jersey resident. In high school, I started working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. And I’ve been working nonstop since then. I started a business and I’m a proud job creator, employing more than 1,000 hard-working people. It’s never been easy, but it’s always been worth it. As an entrepreneur, I have the responsibility of making a payroll every two weeks and know that people’s car payments, rent, and mortgages depend on me effectively doing my job. And I’ve been successfully doing that for 35 years. But the pandemic changed our business and our American way of life, Peter. Working in the tourism and hospitality industry, I saw firsthand how quickly the government can take away our freedoms - our livelihoods. The entire industry was shut down. We lost most of our income and there was no end in sight. Hundreds of small businesses and families stood on the brink of financial disaster. When the business community and government leaders in the county wrote a plan and demanded the Governor to let us reopen, we were ignored. As a business owner and a product of the American dream, I’m a lifelong Republican. Peter, like you, I’m fed up with Washington's dysfunction. America is the land of opportunity, and that starts with a strong economy. The best social program is a job. Yet too many families are struggling to pay their mortgages, buy groceries, and put gas in their cars. In New Jersey, we pay the highest taxes in the nation yet receive only 75 cents back on the dollar from the federal government. Our families cannot afford to elect another selfish, so-called "leader" who cares more about their own political ambitions than coming up with sensible solutions that actually help law-abiding American citizens. We deserve better than this. I am running for the United States Senate because I believe we need to restore freedom, security, and opportunity for all Americans. I am running to restore the American dream. For America, Curtis Bashaw Entrepreneur. Husband. Preservationist. PS - We are looking to build a movement full of individuals who believe in common sense solutions to real problems that Americans are facing. Your contribution as a founding member of our campaign will make all the difference. | GET TO KNOW CURTIS Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He’s running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans. A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York. Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May’s season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore’s most beautiful communities. Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis’ company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island’s East End. I wanted to take a moment to reach out, personally, to introduce myself and welcome you to our grassroots campaign. **As a legislator, a mother of four, and a small business owner, I have never shied away from an opportunity to uplift our community and make it possible for all Oregonians to get ahead.** I am proud to have earned a reputation as a tireless champion for real progress. Here in Oregon, where my husband and I chose to raise our children, too many families are struggling.
The skyrocketing costs of education, healthcare, and housing are making it impossible for anyone to get ahead. And the worst part is that it seems like no one in DC is listening or fighting for solutions.
Incumbent Lori Chavez-DeRemer and her Republican colleagues are too consumed with the partisan political games in DC to push for change.
