clean_body: | Peter, My name is Janelle Bynum and I’m running for Congress in Oregon’s 5th Congressional District – one of the most competitive, Republican-held seats in the country. I wanted to take a moment to reach out, personally, to introduce myself and welcome you to our grassroots campaign. As a legislator, a mother of four, and a small business owner, I have never shied away from an opportunity to uplift our community and make it possible for all Oregonians to get ahead. I am proud to have earned a reputation as a tireless champion for real progress. I’ve fought to defend reproductive freedom, safeguard our civil rights, expand affordable housing, lower the cost of healthcare and prescription drugs, and create pathways to success for the next generation so everyone has a fair shot. = | = Here in Oregon, where my husband and I chose to raise our children, too many families are struggling. The skyrocketing costs of education, healthcare, and housing are making it impossible for anyone to get ahead. And the worst part is that it seems like no one in DC is listening or fighting for solutions. Incumbent Lori Chavez-DeRemer and her Republican colleagues are too consumed with the partisan political games in DC to push for change. Oregon deserves a Congresswoman who understands our needs and who is prepared to deliver results – no matter who tries to stand in the way. Friend,

When you hired me two years ago, I made a promise.

I promised that I would go to work for all Virginians and deliver on a shared vision that takes our great Commonwealth forward to become the best place to live, work, and raise a family.

Together, we have climbed closer and closer to that goal... to that shining city on a hill where we know Virginia should be:

We delivered $5 billion in tax relief, because your hard-earned money belongs to you and not the government.

We made record investments in our students and our teachers, so Virginia's next generation can realize their full potential with a best-in-class education.

We put parents back at the head seat of the table in their children's lives, because that's where parents belong.

We started to transform our behavioral health system to get Virginians struggling with mental health challenges the right help, right now.

We backed our law enforcement heroes with pay raises and the resources they need to keep us safe. | [ **STAND WITH GOVERNOR YOUNGKIN** ](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=cb3a02cd9fd348f4a55cfce8b84328c9&_e=P6YtW_Ya_ELp_EVKpkes58UIbMlM5FHuQpdhUzx4NuldB56DCScVY3m1wTYaYAp_zE_wzO7VU_8FjCZPCwGvzBU1pSLvLHQM2XoNh1T8Ld1GNa8d82DF0Vt8xssC7ChY1OiC2922asZ5YbXdmxK_vM5HpdvSyU1HKhxow2cMOZhZuQvyTBJ0DydlfW0eiARPYTNIgu_8NfksYUdplU62vJsAPtc5K-0Rin02ua5mw18vwqzNNMsVqeQeeqHO_b15lKUk8tsoD6-MLkeDbHRPUasngH6Qbx6-rnbtJXaZSLLNhPKPMQ6qR_rB4PQWaxYq7RYU6xTnoaH_VL3MikxmucZFmNmNKBLtcpf7DuP8s8soX0NChMUpX6HpfwUBLwxVR-MRjgQFjoaVJ4ufgS1JyA%3D%3D)

We did all of this, together, not based on a partisan agenda but because we know that commonsense solutions deliver the best results for Virginia.

But all that progress threatens to be undone by far-left Democrats who barely control our General Assembly. They are trying to lead Virginia down a path toward higher taxes, fewer jobs, unsafe communities, and a stagnant economy.

As your Governor, I am not going to let that happen. I am not going to let them steal from your paychecks and raise your taxes. I am not going to let them put violent criminals back on our streets. I am not going to let them drive economic opportunity and jobs away from the Commonwealth.

I was elected to find commonsense solutions to propel Virginia forward. I promise to use my veto pen to protect Virginians from taxation and bad policies, and I appreciate your support as I deliver on the promise I made when you hired me.

| DEVELOPING... This is moving quickly. Just last week, MAGA extremists in the House of Representatives passed several truly outrageous anti-environmental bills. _**It 's urgent that the environmental movement responds.**_ Their legislation would:
* Gut all federal funding for the greenhouse gas reduction fund, a critical lifeline for underserved communities to benefit from the clean energy transition. (PASSED 209-204: H.R. 1023)
* Prohibit any attempt to suspend fracking operations, despite problems it causes with water contamination. (PASSED 229-188: H.R. 1121)
* Set dirt-cheap royalty rates for oil and gas companies to drill on public lands and line their pockets. (PASSED 216-200: H.R. 6009)

**LCV is organizing quickly to stop MAGA Republicans ' dirty energy agenda in the Senate. _But at the end of the day, the impact we have will depend on members like you._**

[The best thing you can do to protect the environment is renew your LCV membership to power our work. And for a limited time, you'll make 3x the impact -- even $5 makes a big difference right now.](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/_4bqMrY_)

| | **
** **LCV SPRING MATCH CAMPAIGN**

**Supporter Record:** Peter Willis

**Match Status: 3X MATCH ACTIVE
Deadline:** Sunday, March 31**
Fundraising Goal:** $50,000
**Progress to Goal:** 62%

**STATUS:** [Renew now -- it only takes $5 >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/_4bqMrY_) |
---|---|---

Peter -- I really hope you'll take this opportunity to triple your impact -- because as urgent as stopping these legislative attacks are, they're not the only environmental fight we're up against. There are so many reasons to pitch in $5 -- because there are so many ways your support will make a difference. Here are just a few:
1. **RIGHT NOW, we have a real shot at protecting MILLIONS of acres of public lands.** The Biden administration needs to build on its conservation legacy and protect our cherished public lands including by establishing Chuckwalla National Monument in California. The only way that will happen is if the environmental movement keeps the pressure up. [It's crucial that the White House hear from the environmental movement now -- and for that, we need your support.](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/_4bqMrY_)
2. **Biden put a pause on new methane gas export facilities.** That includes CP2 -- a project with climate impact equal to the annual emissions of _53 coal-fired power plants_. It's potentially one of the biggest actions a President has ever taken to protect the climate -- and the response from the dirty energy industry has been fierce. [We HAVE to hold the line. But we need your help: Renew your membership today >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/_4bqMrY_)
3. **Anti-environment legislators are trying to gut important protections for the Arctic.** Republicans' extreme legislation would put the Arctic at risk of more oil and gas drilling and threaten species like caribou. [The environmental movement CANNOT sit this fight out. We need you now, Peter.](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/_4bqMrY_)
4. **A group of donors is triple-matching every contribution this month.** Bottom line, your contribution goes further to win environmental progress if you give now. [Triple your impact now >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/_4bqMrY_)

[Peter, please don't sit this fight out. Renew your LCV membership for just $5 today while it will be triple matched >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/_4bqMrY_)

Onward,

LCV Rapid Response Team

| | Friend, As a mother of two incredible young women, seeing the state that our country is currently in alarms me. Do you feel the same? We have unvetted migrants and illegal drugs pouring into our communities across the border, rampant crime, and division and hostility every which way you look. _This is not the America we grew up in, and it’s certainly not the America we pictured our girls growing up in either._ **What my husband is standing up for in Congress isn’t just rhetoric, it’s real results for our families. It’s what keeps both of us up at night.** I don’t do this often, but I need you to know one thing—Tom is on the front lines fighting for _**[_**YOU**_](https://link.tomkean.com/u/click?_t=9b7a451def6d4254858fc869cf07cd48&_m=49db52b894a8413ea54a73b3a61a6f24&_e=LZAKGgyAkhRGRJGtH-NWGHsK32--I1KvODt-JzIobB1Cu4_aiMoOOBvb4XMtCTFnRBd2PQ3SijHPXWgyrgnysGzyJsbVbBGzFk9AwxNGpmiwX0Uy89N7kTIlcNkQz8WW7YLOi1_7q3OU_AzQ722q6Z3nDld4Ewzk4558m_SpYOGdXMXMP0k7Q2SmpFnU40cKIj4NhhGWvSCEInYQxf-Qj2qKFgPTEonkUIp-BBqTjujODQllyhYC2TzaR1XJ2QlHNxiAZQfIsY1O7Y19QIa1ZI0uL7Ab3klmXPGjK6Kw_j-ciNuRHRD8uKuKlpMlYA5dDJUbcvsWfXVSE5IakyF3ZXceQF5TMunoXiP9Hm9PJ5NY04P8SkIQCQiPtkSMmOZnqpCy5-Mzyx-wsibf83MVVQ%3D%3D)**_**.**
* _He’s fighting to secure our border and end the flow of illegal and lethal drugs that are plaguing our communities.

_
* _He’s fighting for our brave law enforcement that put their lives on the line to keep us safe.

_
* _He’s fighting to end Washington’s spending addiction that is leaving younger generations with an economy in freefall.

_
* _He’s fighting to make our economy work again and make America a place where you can afford to raise a family and prosper.

_
* _He’s fighting to leave this world and our community here in NJ-07 better than he found it._

**And he’s doing it ALL with great decency. I admire that so much about my husband.** It’s because of Tom that I have hope for the future of this country. And despite so much of the progress that Tom has been able to make, there are still bad actors who are trying to tear him down and smear his name. That’s why I’m reaching out to you today. [**_Tom urgently needs your help_**.](https://link.tomkean.com/u/click?_t=9b7a451def6d4254858fc869cf07cd48&_m=49db52b894a8413ea54a73b3a61a6f24&_e=LZAKGgyAkhRGRJGtH-NWGHsK32--I1KvODt-JzIobB1Cu4_aiMoOOBvb4XMtCTFnRBd2PQ3SijHPXWgyrgnysGzyJsbVbBGzFk9AwxNGpmiwX0Uy89N7kTIlcNkQz8WW7YLOi1_7q3OU_AzQ722q6Z3nDld4Ewzk4558m_SpYOGdXMXMP0k7Q2SmpFnU40cKIj4NhhGWvSCEInYQxf-Qj2qKFgPTEonkUIp-BBqTjui_Ay_QX8SV27Pbkp_j8-ui9Iai_VeFiyu4oZPpf1N56FPLBd_2BkW2YB3QKIkJlYfYwuIwXk6ahVAkvjUAiHERZpeZvB8ARnPbjm7v8d6LaqHVhA6zArLrAufzGz94Kchch-_9oqBPzIrY7yXskOVmUsasjt_nnE1N0yn_YM4r9Q%3D%3D) He has a major fundraising deadline this weekend, and hitting this goal is crucial to ensuring his re-election campaign stays healthy as it heads into the election. **[**Friend, could you possibly spare $5, $10, or even $20 to help Tom continue fighting for New Jersey?**](https://link.tomkean.com/u/click?_t=9b7a451def6d4254858fc869cf07cd48&_m=49db52b894a8413ea54a73b3a61a6f24&_e=LZAKGgyAkhRGRJGtH-NWGHsK32--I1KvODt-JzIobB1Cu4_aiMoOOBvb4XMtCTFnRBd2PQ3SijHPXWgyrgnysGzyJsbVbBGzFk9AwxNGpmiwX0Uy89N7kTIlcNkQz8WW7YLOi1_7q3OU_AzQ722q6Z3nDld4Ewzk4558m_SpYOGdXMXMP0k7Q2SmpFnU40cKIj4NhhGWvSCEInYQxf-Qj2qKFgPTEonkUIp-BBqTjugWo4jBdYLm1Wvlcn1v1eohDgY_Kh6pyCOmwMaqD2fUAfxubUGrSYZ7YAnbycQVOi-DnH0F67xRfbVcy3280EQQaNCIIdqVwMTBYNLYYYqnWaDkh-a2_6Ss-vfM8rDUtEmBAs-vbdirp2HSMLdrx5cIgxXhG-pwfRBZgGSCvlxn4Q%3D%3D)** I appreciate your time and support more than you know. clean_body: I don’t do this often. | | | | | Friend, As a mother of two incredible young women, seeing the state that our country is currently in alarms me. Do you feel the same? We have unvetted migrants and illegal drugs pouring into our communities across the border, rampant crime, and division and hostility every which way you look. This is not the America we grew up in, and it’s certainly not the America we pictured our girls growing up in either. What my husband is standing up for in Congress isn’t just rhetoric, it’s real results for our families. It’s what keeps both of us up at night. I don’t do this often, but I need you to know one thing—Tom is on the front lines fighting for . He’s fighting to secure our border and end the flow of illegal and lethal drugs that are plaguing our communities. He’s fighting for our brave law enforcement that put their lives on the line to keep us safe. He’s fighting to end Washington’s spending addiction that is leaving younger generations with an economy in freefall. He’s fighting to make our economy work again and make America a place where you can afford to raise a family and prosper. He’s fighting to leave this world and our community here in NJ-07 better than he found it. And he’s doing it ALL with great decency. I admire that so much about my husband. It’s because of Tom that I have hope for the future of this country. And despite so much of the progress that Tom has been able to make, there are still bad actors who are trying to tear him down and smear his name. That’s why I’m reaching out to you today. He has a major fundraising deadline this weekend, and hitting this goal is crucial to ensuring his re-election campaign stays healthy as it heads into the election. I believe New Jersey and Americans deserve better than the political machine that has ruled for far too long. | [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=981637250065460aa1ab9d76470b6ae4&_e=KrZguV7qFPVdqT7LPBYSM4moByKUE-DsVPD6ytEvuWIDrDaHhY4Heq-k-7Eg7J7vePkngYSVFOH0KTqwx6L8w60ojqlfU8ER6o5WOIupn9PpHOTSN0y8EPvWhksqiG2FdBkemgqfuCfgZwpsNk15yxSbP55Z4LIicyZ3WFKBisPhRkhqXOkev_6__FePBu0YYoGyoCRFPQtD89q4_VMuj5HAKnrTiRqZ36La4Eeq3Vl-SlqD3-Y1AzaT-8J6huhpJfqbyJCwbfbF9bTt0PWrTuDZl2QLMdYaKa60FOHGKZo6-vMyAtodm5ic_wYSPIwSb2TfM5Nl-QVa1m7F9bu9_r35qeixJx9vZu6APNggxDDGh2cZ9rcV0zVZPfBdGNWCq7vAjO4EIp2goXRxx1ewervFGiqL_d6NNMBZ-4amwto%3D)

Peter, my name is Curtis Bashaw.

I’m a lifelong New Jersey resident. In high school, I started working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. And I’ve been working nonstop since then.

I started a business and I’m a proud job creator, employing more than 1,000 hard-working people. It’s never been easy, but it’s always been worth it.

As an entrepreneur, I have the responsibility of making a payroll every two weeks and know that people’s car payments, rent, and mortgages depend on me effectively doing my job. And I’ve been successfully doing that for 35 years.

But the pandemic changed our business and our American way of life, Peter. Working in the tourism and hospitality industry, I saw firsthand how quickly the government can take away our freedoms - our livelihoods.

The entire industry was shut down. We lost most of our income and there was no end in sight. Hundreds of small businesses and families stood on the brink of financial disaster. When the business community and government leaders in the county wrote a plan and demanded the Governor to let us reopen, _**we were ignored.**_

**As a business owner and a product of the American dream, I’m a lifelong Republican.** [**But now I’ve decided to stand up and do something about it. I’m proudly running for the United States Senate because I believe more government equals less freedom.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=981637250065460aa1ab9d76470b6ae4&_e=KrZguV7qFPVdqT7LPBYSM4moByKUE-DsVPD6ytEvuWIDrDaHhY4Heq-k-7Eg7J7vePkngYSVFOH0KTqwx6L8w60ojqlfU8ER6o5WOIupn9PpHOTSN0y8EPvWhksqiG2FdBkemgqfuCfgZwpsNk15yxSbP55Z4LIicyZ3WFKBisPhRkhqXOkev_6__FePBu0YYoGyoCRFPQtD89q4_VMuj5HAKnrTiRqZ36La4Eeq3Vl-SlqD3-Y1AzaT-8J6huhp_IqRUMgglit5NRrRC5wdw59DjzLuUgn9wS3Vc_-ns1R8GmWy8xg0cNiv6dckCBWzuy31CLZ8QUINghMHkexhcd7xGp51PWGLw8RGS-74Y5_tHP1TQZslk6Szu5JZp-Ok6a1RKKC42BUtIuGNiEn99JRnSXYa002Nrw_bAi_qA38%3D)

[**I’m a political outsider on a mission to fix it.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=981637250065460aa1ab9d76470b6ae4&_e=KrZguV7qFPVdqT7LPBYSM4moByKUE-DsVPD6ytEvuWIDrDaHhY4Heq-k-7Eg7J7vePkngYSVFOH0KTqwx6L8w60ojqlfU8ER6o5WOIupn9PpHOTSN0y8EPvWhksqiG2FdBkemgqfuCfgZwpsNk15yxSbP55Z4LIicyZ3WFKBisPhRkhqXOkev_6__FePBu0YYoGyoCRFPQtD89q4_VMuj5HAKnrTiRqZ36La4Eeq3Vl-SlqD3-Y1AzaT-8J6huhpaU1DOWuCO3H5W23st2hULYYmrXBkLu1jC4pTiQbej8Ff1n8LdTC3_eu8g7l4Rg55kTTzZGwge_PDg18NuY4uDABgCzKTzM5PP7weQ8TjFk6gZWIk-bXd8V8TLE-PsTMgEG-Licl8pStm6cvOp7-nvwcbv9iVdvgJ18vMcKHJe0g%3D)

America is the land of opportunity, and that starts with a strong economy. The best social program is a job.

Yet too many families are struggling to pay their mortgages, buy groceries, and put gas in their cars. In New Jersey, we pay the highest taxes in the nation yet receive only 75 cents back on the dollar from the federal government.

Our families cannot afford to elect another selfish, so-called _"leader"_ who cares more about their own political ambitions than coming up with sensible solutions that actually help law-abiding American citizens. **_We deserve better than this._**

I am running for the United States Senate because I believe we need to restore freedom, security, and opportunity for all Americans. I am running to restore the American dream. | **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He’s running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May’s season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore’s most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis’ company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island’s East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

body:
#
In just three days, we’ll close the books on our quarterly fundraising and then submit a report to the FEC. After that, everyone will be able to see our fundraising numbers.
We need to raise $1.5 million for the quarter to prepare for what we know will be an extremely expensive race to keep Alexandria in Congress. In 2020, AOC’s opponent raised and spent more than $10 million. **This year, who knows what our challenger — a former Wall Street investment banker — will spend if he gets onto the ballot.**
[ Will you pitch in $5 – or any amount that is meaningful to you – to help us reach this critical goal by midnight on the 31st? Every donation will make a difference.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240328.wMbpdR&refcode=em20240328-6100-P_FND_EOQ_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6100%2E2526796%2E-sYaoG)
Alexandria is leading the fight for racial, social, economic, and environmental justice in Congress.
But she can’t do it alone. She needs this entire movement at her side to counter disinformation, defeat her Democratic and Republican opponents, and continue to work for the progressive future we know we deserve.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240328.wMbpdR&refcode=em20240328-6100-P_FND_EOQ_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=6100%2E2526796%2E-sYaoG)

Peter, There is no better time to join the fight for vaccine choice in Texas!
Earlier this month, TFVC witnessed a slew of committed vaccine choice candidates win their Primary races and advance to the General Election in November.

From judicial seats to state representatives to precinct chairs, Texans around the state made their voices heard and ousted 12 underwhelming legislative incumbents in favor of medical liberty supporters. Plus, nine TFVC-recommended candidates are entering the Primary runoff election on May 28!

We are committed to informing voters about candidates who have pledged to protect medical liberty and informed consent in the Lone Star State - but that’s not all we’ve been busy with this year.

Over the last nine years, TFVC has diligently researched and gathered medical facts on vaccines and the legal exemption rights of Texans like you. We do this so YOU can have the information you need when making important medical decisions for yourself and your children.

We provide histories of vaccine schedules, vaccine ingredient information, exemption forms, and vaccine injury guides to anybody who needs them, free of charge. The GOP came within just 10,000 votes of winning Nevada’s Senate election in 2022 — a margin of 1%. body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1280%2E135344%2E39q2Jh)

Friends --
March 31st marks the first offical FEC deadline of the year and that means if you're anything like us, your inbox is filled with requests from political campaigns and organizations asking for donations.
With your permission, I’d appreciate the chance to make the case for why a donation to my campaign for U.S. Senate is one of the most strategic contributions you can make on Sunday.
Let me start with what you probably already instinctively know: Michigan is going to be a critical state for the 2024 campaign.
There is no winning the White House without Michigan. For Democrats, there is no holding the Senate without Michigan. Even our House delegation rests on a one-seat Democratic majority.
But you were probably already sold on the importance of Michigan. So, aside from the fact that control of the U.S. Senate is at stake (!), what about my race? Why donate to my campaign?
This is one of the rare open Senate races without an incumbent running -- in fact, it’s the only competitive open seat in the entire country. That means we have A LOT of introducing of me to do across the state. A recent poll showed about 50% of the state knows me, across our 11 media markets.
Reaching those folks takes resources, and that's not something I can do without you.
Add the fact that this is going to be one of the most expensive races in the country -- not just with candidate spending, but outside spending too.
And I'll close with the news that in all of my elections, I have historically done better than Democrats usually do in the "redder" areas of the state. That means I am finding and pulling voters other races couldn't, and that is good for everyone up and down the ballot on Election Day.
So yes, this race is kind of a unicorn. It's a unique situation where control of the White House and Congress is on the line, most voters don't know the candidates yet, and the Democratic Senate candidate can help the top of the ticket, and not the other way around.
[**That's why I am asking for your support: Can I count on you to make a contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate before our March 31st FEC fundraising drive ends on Sunday? I would not ask if it were not so important.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-mar24.YRUw2h&refcode=em240328-3-700&t=2&akid=1280%2E135344%2E39q2Jh)**
